# Introduction

The **[Webkul WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multivendor-marketplace.html)** is a powerful solution designed to transform a standard WooCommerce store into a fully functional multi-vendor marketplace.

With this plugin, you can allow **multiple independent vendors** to register, create their own shops, upload products, manage orders, and track earnings – all from a dedicated vendor dashboard.

This enables you to build marketplaces similar to:

- Amazon
- Flipkart
- Etsy
- eBay

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-vendor-dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-vendor-dashboard.webp" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Vendor Dashboard" /></a>

---

## What does this plugin do?

This plugin converts your WooCommerce store into a **multi-seller platform** where:

- Each vendor gets a **separate profile page**
- Vendors can **add & manage products**
- Vendors can **generate content with AI**
- Vendors can **process orders**
- Vendors can **track sales & transactions**
- Vendors can **communicate with admin**
- Admin has **full control over marketplace**
- Vendors get a **dedicated seller dashboard**
- Vendors can **sell existing catalog items**
- Vendors can offer **store pickup with OTP**
- Vendors can **schedule carrier deliveries**
- Vendors can **manage inventory & prices inline**
- Vendors can **add staff accounts**
- Vendors can **set store hours & vacations**
- Vendors can **monitor account health**
- Vendors can **engage shop followers**

---

## Vendor Capabilities

Once registered, vendors get access to a **frontend dashboard** where they can:

- Add new products
- Edit existing products
- Delete products
- View product listings
- Track sales performance
- View transactions
- Manage orders
- Print invoices
- Update profile information
- Change passwords
- Ask questions to admin
- Generate content with AI
- Enhance images with AI
- Sell existing catalog products
- Generate & print barcodes
- Import products via CSV
- Update stock inline
- Schedule sale prices
- Schedule carrier shipments
- Verify pickup OTP codes
- Request order payouts
- Check account health
- Set store hours
- Schedule vacation mode
- Manage vendor staff
- Reach shop followers
- Switch dashboard views

---

## Admin Capabilities

Marketplace owners (admins) can:

- Manage vendor list
- Manage product list
- Approve or disapprove vendors
- Approve or disapprove vendor products
- Assign products to vendors
- Set **different commission rates** for each vendor
- Enable or disable **auto vendor approval**
- Enable or disable **auto product publish**
- Control all marketplace settings
- Enable separate seller dashboard
- Configure AI providers & vendor quotas
- Set global products for Select & Sell
- Review and approve seller offers
- Configure Store Pickup & OTP rules
- Manage approved fulfillment carriers
- Process vendor payout requests
- Set minimum withdrawal amounts
- Verify vendor KYC documents
- Monitor seller account health
- Track vendors on vacation
- Customize marketplace URL endpoints

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/general-settings.webp" alt="Admin Panel" /></a>

# Features

The WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin offers a **robust, scalable, and enterprise-ready feature set** that empowers both marketplace owners and vendors. It is designed to handle high traffic, multiple sellers, and complex order workflows with ease.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/key-features.webp"><img src="./assets/key-features.webp" alt="Key Features" /></a>

---

## Core Marketplace Features

### 1. Multi-Vendor Registration
Allow unlimited vendors to register on your platform. Vendors can sign up using the default WooCommerce registration form or a dedicated Seller Central onboarding page. This helps you easily onboard new sellers without manual intervention.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral.webp" alt="Seller Central" /></a>

---

### 2. Separate Vendor Profile Pages
Each vendor gets a **dedicated shop page** containing:
- Shop logo
- Banner image
- About section
- Product collection
- Reviews & ratings

This helps vendors build their own brand identity within your marketplace.

---

### 3. Magic AI
Supports multiple AI providers:
- OpenAI
- Anthropic
- Gemini
- xAI
- Groq
- DeepSeek
- Mistral
- Ollama
- WordPress AI Connectors

Vendors can:
- Create products using AI-powered content generation
- Enhance product images with AI

Admins can:
- Set product generation limits for individual vendors
- Generate product and category images and product descriptions using AI

---

### 4. Vendor Shipping Management
Vendors can configure their own shipping:
- Create shipping zones
- Add shipping methods
- Define shipping costs
- Manage shipping classes

This allows vendors to control logistics independently.

---

### 5. Store Pickup
Customers can:
- Select store pickup as a shipping method
- Verify their pickup using an OTP sent to their email address.

Vendors and admins can:
- Manage and track store pickup orders

Vendors can:
- Set store hours for pickup

Admins can:
- Configure Store Pickup settings

Order emails include:
- Pickup-related information and details

---

### 6. Schedule Pickup
Admins can:
- Configure Fulfilment Carriers for Free Shipping and Flat Rate Shipping orders

Vendors can:
- Select an available shipping provider or use their own
- Share shipment and tracking details with customers
- Ship an order with an admin-listed carrier or Self Ship
- View the carrier, items, and tracking number in the Shipments section of the order view

---

### 7. Featured Products
Admins can mark specific vendor products as **featured** to:
- Increase product visibility
- Boost sales
- Highlight trending products

---

### 8. Admin-like Vendor Dashboard
Admins can enable an **advanced dashboard view** for vendors that resembles the WordPress admin panel. Vendors can switch between:
- Frontend dashboard (simple)
- Admin-style dashboard (advanced)

This provides flexibility for both beginner and power sellers.

---

### 9. New Seller Panel
Vendors can:
- Access a new seller panel with a grouped sidebar menu for Catalog, Sales, Inventories, Reporting, Performance, and Settings
- Use the mobile menu on small screens
- Switch to the Classic view at any time
- Open the panel from the Go to Seller Dashboard button in My Account

---

### 10. Vendor Query System
Vendors can submit queries to admins directly from their dashboard. Admins can:
- Reply to queries
- Track conversations
- Maintain a history of communication

This ensures smooth communication and support.

---

### 11. Vendor Profile Management
Vendors can manage:
- Personal details
- Shop information
- Social media links
- Return, shipping & privacy policies

This improves transparency and customer trust.

---

### 12. Vendor Staff Management
Vendors can:
- Create and manage staff members for their stores
- Assign and manage staff permissions

Staff members can:
- Access only the features granted through their assigned permissions

Admins can:
- Manage the vendor staff permissions list.
- View every vendor staff user in one list
- Edit staff names and permissions
- Delete staff members individually or in bulk

---

### 13. Advanced Product Management
Vendors can create multiple product types:

- Simple
- Grouped
- External/Affiliate
- Variable
- Downloadable

They can manage:
- Pricing
- Inventory
- Images
- Attributes
- Variations

Vendors can also:
- Create products in a 3-step flow with product type cards
- Track a Listing Completeness score with links to each missing field
- Edit the product permalink
- Add a GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN to products and variations

Admins also retain control to edit or remove any product.

---

### 14. Bulk Upload
Vendors can:
- Import and update products in bulk using CSV files
- Add and update Select & Sell offers through CSV upload
- Download ready-made CSV templates for products and offers
- Update existing products and offers by matching SKU
- Export products to CSV, edit them, and re-upload
- Map columns and validate every row before import
- View imported, updated, skipped, and failed counts after each import
- Download a report that explains why each row failed or was skipped
- Receive an email when admin approves or rejects newly imported products

Admins can:
- Configure Bulk Upload settings under Marketplace > Settings

---

### 15. Select & Sell
Vendors can:
- Sell admin-created simple and variable products through their own stores
- Search the marketplace catalog to find a product and sell it
- Set their own price, stock, description, and status for each offer
- Manage offers from dedicated Select & Sell screens in the vendor panel

Customers can:
- View the seller list and store selector on product pages
- Choose their preferred vendor

Admins can:
- Configure Select & Sell settings under Marketplace > Settings
- Approve or reject Select & Sell offers from the Product Approval queue

---

### 16. Order Management
Vendors can:
- View order details
- Access billing & shipping info
- Update order status
- Print invoices
- Upload custom invoices
- Set the number of orders shown per page
- Request payment for completed orders

This ensures professional order handling.

---

### 17. Vendor Approval System
Admins have full control over:
- Approving new vendors
- Approving vendor products
- Blocking suspicious sellers
- Approving or rejecting vendor products and Select & Sell offers from the Product Approval queue
- Adding a reason with the decision

This protects marketplace quality.

---

### 18. Product Assignment & Transfer
Admins can:
- Assign products to vendors
- Transfer products between vendors
- Reassign ownership if required

Useful for vendor migration and management.

---

### 19. SEO-Friendly URLs
Vendor profiles and product pages use **clean URLs**, improving:
- Google ranking
- Click-through rate
- Search visibility

---

### 20. Flexible Commission System
Admins can configure:
- Global commission
- Vendor-specific commission
- Fixed commission
- Percentage commission
- Hybrid (fixed + percentage)

This allows complete revenue control.

---

### 21. Favorite Vendors & Shop Followers
Customers can:
- Follow vendors
- Receive updates
- Get notified about new products

This increases repeat sales.

---

### 22. Bulk Product Assignment
Admins can:
- Assign multiple products to vendors in bulk
- Save time on large catalogs

---

### 23. Upsell & Cross-Sell Products
Vendors can:
- Suggest premium alternatives
- Promote related products
- Increase average order value

---

### 24. WordPress Multisite Support
Fully compatible with:
- Multisite networks
- Centralized management
- Multiple stores

---

### 25. HPOS Compatibility
Optimized for:
- WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
- Faster order processing
- Large-scale stores

---

### 26. WooCommerce Blocks Support
Compatible with:
- Cart block
- Checkout block
- Latest WooCommerce UI

---

## Advanced Marketplace Features

### 27. Vendor Transactions
Admins can:
- Transfer vendor earnings
- Track payouts

Vendors can:
- View transaction history
- Monitor earnings
- View earning summary cards on the Transactions & Earnings screen
- Request payment, subject to the admin setting and withdrawal threshold

---

### 28. Vendor-wise Category Control
Admins can:
- Assign specific categories to vendors
- Control what they can sell

---

### 29. Global Product Type Control
Admins can:
- Enable/disable product types
- Maintain marketplace standards

---

### 30. Pricing Management
Vendors can:
- Manage product and variation pricing from a separate section
- Update regular prices, sale prices, and sale schedules from a single screen
- Select multiple products and apply bulk price updates
- Apply bulk updates to the regular price, sale price, or both prices
- Set a price, or use Increase By and Decrease By options
- Enter the bulk value as a fixed amount or a percentage
- Filter products from a filter drawer

---

### 31. Inventory Management
Vendors can:
- Manage product and variation inventory from a separate section
- Update stock, SKU, GTIN, and other inventory details in bulk
- Use Increase By and Decrease By options to update stock in bulk
- Manage sold individually, maximum purchasable quantity, and stock management settings
- Filter products from a filter drawer

---

### 32. Barcode Management
Vendors can:
- Generate barcodes for products and variations
- Choose from Code 128, EAN-13, and UPC-A formats
- Print barcodes in PDF format
- Generate and print barcodes in bulk
- View each variation's barcode on the Product Barcodes page
- Control barcode access through staff permissions

---

### 33. Vendor Review Moderation
Admins can:
- Approve reviews
- Remove fake reviews
- Maintain platform trust

---

### 34. Email Template Management
Supports:
- Default WooCommerce emails
- Marketplace-specific emails
- Custom branding

---

### 35. Custom Dashboard Endpoints
Admins can customize:
- Dashboard URLs
- Menu labels
- Navigation structure

---

### 36. Refund Management
Vendors can:
- Initiate refunds
- Restock products
- Track refunded amounts

---

### 37. Product Approval Notifications
Admins get real-time alerts when:
- Vendors add products
- Vendors edit products

---

### 38. Google Analytics Integration
Admins can:
- Track sales
- Monitor product performance
- Analyze customer behavior

---

### 39. Seller Dashboard
Vendors can:
- View sales, orders, and customers charts with a date range filter
- Track order status, recent orders, and Top 5 Selling Products
- Use the Action Required card for pending orders, orders to ship, low stock products, and notifications
- Monitor Total Payout, Remaining Payout, Customer Feedback, Account Health, Trends, and Profile Score

---

### 40. Reports
Provides reports on:
- Sales
- Products
- Customers

Reports include:
- Sales
- Commission
- Orders
- Tax & Tax Rates
- Refunds
- Payment methods
- Top products
- Top customers

Vendors can:
- View and analyze reports specific to their stores
- Download reports in CSV and PDF formats

---

### 41. Customers
Vendors can:
- View customer details, total revenue, order count, and last order date
- Filter customers by name, email, registered and guest accounts

---

### 42. Seller Performance
Vendors can monitor:
- Account health
- Seller reviews
- Product reviews

Account Health:
- View an overall health score out of 100 with Healthy, At Risk, and Unhealthy bands
- Track order cancellation rate, customer feedback, and flags on the store and products
- See more insights on refund rate, product reviews, and paid to completed time
- Choose a custom period to review performance
- Learn how the score is calculated from a built-in guide
- Test changes to the score with a live calculator

Seller Reviews:
- View store reviews with price, value, and quality ratings
- Check the status of each review as Pending, Approved, or Disapproved
- Search by review title and sort by newest first
- Filter by customer, email, rating, description, status, and date

Product Reviews:
- View reviews on their products with the Verified owner label
- Search, sort, and filter by customer, email, date, status, rating and description

---

### 43. WPML Multilingual Support
Supports:
- Multi-language marketplaces
- Vendor product translation
- Global audience

---

# Admin Quick Start

This guide walks you through setting up your WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace and managing day-to-day operations in the exact chronological order you will need. Each step links directly to the corresponding configuration and feature documentation.

<div class="qs-callout">
  <div class="qs-callout__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="4"></rect></svg>
  </div>
  <div class="qs-callout__content">
    <div class="qs-callout__header">
      <span class="qs-callout__title">Getting Started Checklist</span>
      <span class="qs-callout__badge">Pre-flight check</span>
    </div>
    <p class="qs-callout__text">
      Before onboarding live merchants, complete the setup steps in Part 1 and execute a test purchase using a dummy vendor account. This verifies your commission calculations, split sub-orders, and automated notifications.
    </p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="qs-phase-banner">
  <span class="qs-phase-badge">Phase 01 &bull; Platform Setup</span>
</div>

## Set Up the Marketplace

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">01</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Commission Rules</span>
  </div>

### 1. Turn on the Marketplace & Set Commissions

Ensure the marketplace module is active and configure how your platform collects revenue. You can set global platform commissions or configure specific rates per vendor and per category.

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Commission Types**: Choose between percentage commission, fixed commission per transaction, or a combination.
- **Admin vs. Vendor Share**: Define how taxes, shipping fees, and coupon discounts are split between the marketplace admin and vendors.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Installation](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/installation.html), [General Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-general-settings.html), and [Commission Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/commission-management.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">02</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Vendor Onboarding</span>
  </div>

### 2. Decide How Vendors Register & Join

Choose the onboarding flow for incoming merchants:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Approval Workflow**: Select whether new vendor accounts require manual admin approval or activate automatically upon registration.
- **Public Profiles**: Decide whether vendor profile pages and shop URLs (`/shop/vendor-slug`) are publicly visible immediately or only after verification.
- **Seller Capabilities**: Grant or restrict vendor permissions such as managing orders, publishing products, or adding staff members.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html) and [General Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-general-settings.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">03</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Catalog Control</span>
  </div>

### 3. Decide How Products Are Cataloged

Control how inventory is added to your marketplace catalog:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Product Approval**: Choose whether vendor products publish instantly or require admin review before appearing on the storefront.
- **Allowed Product Types**: Enable or disable specific WooCommerce product types for vendors (Simple, Variable, Virtual, Downloadable, Grouped, External).
- **Select & Sell**: Allow multiple sellers to list offers against existing catalog items, avoiding duplicate listings.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Product Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/product-settings.html) and [Vendor Product Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-product-management.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">04</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Storefront Page</span>
  </div>

### 4. Build Your Seller Landing Page

Create an attractive onboarding hub that invites prospective merchants to open a shop on your marketplace:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Seller Central Page**: Configure the dedicated merchant onboarding landing page with step-by-step registration steps.
- **Elementor & Shortcodes**: Use native marketplace shortcodes and Elementor widgets to highlight top vendors, showcase commission benefits, and embed registration forms anywhere on your site.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Configuration Seller Central](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-seller-central.html) and [Elementor Shortcodes](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/elementor-shortcodes.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">05</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Built-in Features</span>
  </div>

### 5. Configure Built-in Marketplace Features

Set up built-in capabilities tailored to your marketplace business model:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Withdrawal & Payout Rules**: Define minimum withdrawal balances, payment request thresholds, and payout schedules. See [Configuration Withdrawal](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-withdrawal.html).
- **Vendor Shipping Zones**: Allow sellers to configure custom table rates, flat rates, shipping classes, or store pickup with OTP verification. See [Vendor Shipping Zone Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-shipping-zone-management.html).
- **Vendor KYC Verification**: Require merchants to submit business registration, photo ID, or tax certificates before listing items or requesting payouts. See [Vendor KYC](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-kyc.html).
- **Generative AI (Magic AI)**: Connect AI providers to give sellers one-click AI product title, description, and image generation directly in their dashboard. See [Generative AI Overview](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/generative-ai-overview.html).
- **Branded Invoices**: Customize marketplace invoice prefixes, tax identification numbers, and downloadable seller PDF invoices. See [Configuration Vendor Invoice](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-vendor-invoice.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-phase-banner">
  <span class="qs-phase-badge">Phase 02 &bull; Daily Operations</span>
</div>

## Run the Marketplace

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">06</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Merchant Review</span>
  </div>

### Approve and Onboard Vendors

Review pending merchant applications from the WordPress admin panel. Verify business credentials, review submitted KYC documentation, set individual commission agreements, and approve or suspend vendor accounts with one click.

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guide**: See [Vendor Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-mangement.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">07</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Catalog Quality</span>
  </div>

### Review and Moderate Products

When product auto-approval is disabled, review vendor-submitted items before they go live on your storefront. Ensure correct categorization, high-resolution imagery, pricing compliance, and platform catalog quality.

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Product Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-product-management.html) and [Vendor Management & Product Assignment](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-management-and-product-assignment.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">08</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Order Routing</span>
  </div>

### Monitor Orders, Fulfillment & Sub-Orders

When a customer places a multi-vendor order, WooCommerce automatically generates separate sub-orders for each participating seller:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Order Tracking**: Follow fulfillment progress, tracking numbers, carrier assignments, and shipping updates entered by sellers.
- **Store Pickup with OTP**: Verify customer collections using one-time passcodes for in-store pickups.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Order Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-order-management.html) and [Customer Order Placement](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/customer-order-placement.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">09</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Vendor Payouts</span>
  </div>

### Process Vendor Payouts & Audits

Disburse merchant earnings after orders reach completed status:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Payment Requests**: Review vendor withdrawal requests, verify completed orders, and release payouts via PayPal Payouts, Stripe, or Bank Transfer.
- **Audit Trail**: Maintain transparent accounting records of all platform fees, vendor commissions, and transaction logs.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Payout Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-payout-management.html) and [Vendor Transaction Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-transaction-management.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">10</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Platform Health</span>
  </div>

### Keep the Marketplace Healthy & Connected

Maintain high platform standards and active seller relationships:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Monitor Account Health & Flags**: Review flagged products, investigate customer copyright or counterfeit reports, and monitor seller health metrics. See [Configuration Vendor Flags](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-vendor-flags.html).
- **Moderate Reviews & Ratings**: Monitor feedback left by customers on vendor shop pages and evaluate seller reliability. See [Manage Feedback and Vendor Queries](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/manage-feedback-and-vendor-queries.html).
- **Answer Seller Inquiries**: Respond to vendor inquiries and technical queries submitted through the seller dashboard. See [Ask to Admin](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/ask-to-admin.html) and [Vendor Queries Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-queries-management.html).
- **Broadcast Announcements**: Send platform-wide notices, policy updates, and holiday shipping schedules directly to all seller dashboards. See [Admin News](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-news.html) and [Admin Notifications](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-notifications.html).

</div>

</div>

# Seller Quick Start

This guide follows a new vendor through the complete journey from initial registration to receiving your first order payout on the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace. Each step provides practical instructions and links directly to the detailed configuration and operational documentation.

<div class="qs-callout">
  <div class="qs-callout__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="4"></rect></svg>
  </div>
  <div class="qs-callout__content">
    <div class="qs-callout__header">
      <span class="qs-callout__title">Seller Onboarding Checklist</span>
      <span class="qs-callout__badge">Pre-launch check</span>
    </div>
    <p class="qs-callout__text">
      Before publishing your first live product, ensure you have configured your <strong>Shipping Zones</strong> in the seller panel and added your store branding in <strong>Profile Settings</strong>. Stores with complete profiles and transparent shipping terms convert shoppers significantly faster.
    </p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="qs-phase-banner">
  <span class="qs-phase-badge">Phase 01 &bull; Account Setup &amp; Branding</span>
</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">01</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Merchant Sign-Up</span>
  </div>

### 1. Create Your Seller Account

Open the marketplace registration page or the dedicated Seller Central onboarding page on the marketplace site:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- Check the **"Become a Seller"** checkbox during customer registration, or navigate directly to the merchant sign-up form.
- Fill in your basic user details: full name, email address, password, store name, and choose a unique shop URL slug (e.g., `your-store-name` for `yourdomain.com/shop/your-store-name`).
- Read and accept the marketplace vendor terms and conditions before submitting your registration.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guide**: See [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html) and [Configuration Seller Central](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-seller-central.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">02</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Account Approval</span>
  </div>

### 2. Wait for Approval and Sign In

Depending on marketplace platform policies:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Auto-Approval**: If automatic vendor approval is active, you are immediately logged in to your new seller dashboard.
- **Admin Review**: If manual admin moderation is enabled, your account will be placed under review. Once reviewed and approved by platform administrators, you will receive an automated confirmation email containing your login credentials and dashboard access link.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guide**: See [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html) and [Email Configurations](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/email-configurations.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">03</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Profile &amp; KYC</span>
  </div>

### 3. Complete Your Shop Profile & KYC

Building a recognizable brand identity is essential for converting store visitors into loyal customers:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Store Identity**: Upload your high-resolution store banner, company avatar/logo, store name, and an engaging store description.
- **Contact & Address**: Enter your official business address, contact telephone number, and customer support email.
- **Social Profiles**: Connect your brand's social media accounts (Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube) to display follow icons on your shop header.
- **KYC Verification**: If required by the platform, submit your business registration, tax identification number, or government photo ID to unlock product publishing and payout privileges.
- **Payment & Payout Details**: Configure your preferred withdrawal payout method (PayPal email address or direct bank transfer account details) so earnings can be disbursed promptly.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Profile](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-profile.html) and [Vendor KYC](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-kyc.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">04</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Command Center</span>
  </div>

### 4. Explore the Vendor Dashboard

Sign in to your dedicated seller panel to view your centralized marketplace command center:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Live Analytics**: Monitor real-time gross revenue, net vendor earnings, total orders, and published product counts.
- **Order Overview**: Quickly see pending orders, processing shipments, and completed deliveries.
- **Recent Inquiries & Alerts**: View customer queries and important platform announcements broadcast by the marketplace administrator.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guide**: See [Vendor Dashboard Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-dashboard.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-phase-banner">
  <span class="qs-phase-badge">Phase 02 &bull; Shipping &amp; Product Catalog</span>
</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">05</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Shipping Logistics</span>
  </div>

### 5. Set Up Your Shipping Zones & Methods

Before listing physical merchandise, configure the shipping methods and geographical areas you service:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Shipping Zones**: Add custom zones based on specific countries, states, or postal code groups.
- **Shipping Methods**: Enable and price **Flat Rate**, **Free Shipping**, or **Local Store Pickup**.
- **Shipping Classes & Calculations**: Assign rates per item, per shipping class, or based on minimum order subtotal requirements.
- **Store Pickup with OTP**: Allow local customers to collect their purchases in person with secure one-time passcode verification.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guide**: See [Vendor Shipping Zone Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-shipping-zone-management.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">06</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Catalog Inventory</span>
  </div>

### 6. Add Your Products to the Catalog

Populate your storefront with merchandise across all supported WooCommerce product types:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Simple Products**: Standard physical products with defined regular prices, sale prices, inventory levels, and SKUs.
- **Variable Products**: Complex items offering customer choices across sizes, colors, and styles, with variation-specific pricing and stock tracking.
- **Virtual & Downloadable Products**: Digital eBooks, software downloads, access keys, or consulting services without physical shipping requirements.
- **Select & Sell (Existing Products)**: Join existing catalog listings already present on the marketplace to offer your items at your own price and stock without creating duplicate product listings.
- **AI Product Content (Magic AI)**: Use built-in Generative AI prompts to generate engaging product titles, long descriptions, and feature bullet points with a single click.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Product Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-product-management.html) and [Product Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/product-settings.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">07</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Storefront Go-Live</span>
  </div>

### 7. Product Review and Storefront Publishing

Ensure your product listings adhere to marketplace catalog standards:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Review Workflow**: If product approval is enabled by the platform, submitted items show a `Pending Review` status until approved by an administrator. Once reviewed, they are published directly to the public catalog.
- **Immediate Publishing**: If auto-approval is active, your products appear immediately on your shop page and in marketplace search results.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Product Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-product-management.html) and [Vendor Management & Product Assignment](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-management-and-product-assignment.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-phase-banner">
  <span class="qs-phase-badge">Phase 03 &bull; Sales, Fulfillment &amp; Growth</span>
</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">08</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Marketing &amp; Reach</span>
  </div>

### 8. Promote Your Shop and Build Followers

Drive targeted traffic to your personalized store page:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Public Shop URL**: Share your dedicated shop storefront (`yourdomain.com/shop/your-vendor-slug`) on your marketing channels and social media.
- **Store Followers**: Shoppers can follow your shop by clicking the "Favorite Shop" or "Follow Shop" button to receive automated email alerts when you publish new catalog items.
- **Coupons & Special Offers**: Create promotional discount codes or volume deals to incentivize buyers during seasonal events.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Shop Followers](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-shop-followers.html) and [Vendor Profile](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-profile.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">09</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Order Fulfillment</span>
  </div>

### 9. Receive and Fulfill Orders

When shoppers purchase items from multiple sellers in a single checkout, the platform automatically splits the cart into individual sub-orders for each participating merchant:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Order Notifications**: Receive instant email alerts and dashboard notifications the moment an order is placed.
- **Order Management**: View the buyer's shipping address, item details, customer notes, and payment status.
- **Fulfillment & Tracking**: Update order status to *Processing* or *Completed*, assign shipping carriers, and provide package tracking numbers so customers can follow their delivery.
- **Invoices & Packing Slips**: Download or print branded PDF vendor invoices and packing slips to include inside the shipment.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Order Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-order-management.html) and [Vendor Invoice](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-invoice-view.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">10</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Wallet &amp; Payouts</span>
  </div>

### 10. Track Earnings and Request Payouts

Keep total visibility over your finances and receive your earnings reliably:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Commission Transparency**: The marketplace automatically deducts its agreed platform commission and credits the remainder to your vendor wallet.
- **Transaction History**: Review a clear ledger of credited sales, commission fees, and completed payout disbursements.
- **Withdrawal Requests**: When your balance reaches the marketplace's minimum withdrawal threshold, submit a payout request directly from your dashboard to receive funds via PayPal, Stripe, or Bank Transfer.

</div>

<div class="qs-guide-footer">

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Payout Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-payout-management.html) and [Vendor Transaction Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-transaction-management.html).

</div>

</div>

<div class="qs-step-card">
  <div class="qs-step-card__top">
    <span class="qs-step-num">11</span>
    <span class="qs-step-tag">Store Reputation</span>
  </div>

### 11. Maintain High Performance, Reviews & Support

Grow a thriving, sustainable business on the marketplace:

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- **Customer Feedback & Ratings**: Encourage happy buyers to leave reviews on your shop and product pages. Maintain high rating averages to boost your storefront placement. See [Vendor Reviews & Ratings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-reviews.html).
- **Customer Pre-Sale Queries**: Respond promptly to customer questions submitted through the product page query tabs. See [Vendor Queries Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-queries-management.html).
- **Ask Admin for Support**: Reach out to the platform administration team directly through the built-in query system for assistance with policies, commissions, or account questions. See [Ask to Admin](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/ask-to-admin.html).
- **Staff Accounts**: Add team members (staff accounts) with custom role permissions to help manage inventory, customer inquiries, and order shipping. See [Vendor Staff](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-staff.html).
- **Vacation Mode**: Going away or temporarily unable to fulfill orders? Enable vacation mode to pause checkout or post a temporary notice banner without losing your products or ratings. See [Vendor Vacation](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-vacation.html).

</div>

</div>

# Installation

This guide explains how to properly install and activate the **WooCommerce Multi Vendor Marketplace plugin** on your WordPress website.

Follow each step carefully to ensure a smooth setup.

---

## System Requirements

Before installation, make sure:

| Requirement        | Minimum / Recommended Version |
|--------------------|--------------------------------|
| WordPress Version  | 6.7 or higher                  |
| WooCommerce Version| 10.0 or higher                 |
| PHP Version        | 7.4+ (recommended)             |
| Memory Limit       | 256MB or higher                |
| SSL                | Enabled (recommended)          |


---

## Step 1 – Download Plugin

After purchase, you will receive a **ZIP file** of the plugin.

Do NOT unzip the file before uploading.

---

## Step 2 – Upload Plugin

1. Login to your **WordPress Admin Panel**
2. Navigate to: **Plugins > Add New**


3. Click **Upload Plugin** (top of page)
4. Click **Choose File**
5. Select the downloaded ZIP file

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/upload-plugin.webp"><img src="./assets/upload-plugin.webp" alt="Upload Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 3 – Install Plugin

Click the **Install Now** button.

WordPress will upload and install the plugin automatically.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/install-now.webp"><img src="./assets/install-now.webp" alt="Install Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 4 – Activate Plugin

Once installed:

- You will see **Plugin installed successfully**
- Click **Activate Plugin**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/activate-plugin.webp"><img src="./assets/activate-plugin.webp" alt="Activate Plugin" /></a>

---

## Step 5 – Activate License

- To activate the license, go to **Marketplace > Settings**
- The wizard will be show to activate the license.
- Enter the **License Key** and click **Activate License**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wizard.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wizard.webp" alt="Activate License" /></a>

- **[License Activation Guide](./admin-license.html)** – Detailed step-by-step instructions on generating and activating your plugin license.

---

## Step 6 – Marketplace Menu

After activation:

- A new **Marketplace** menu appears in the admin sidebar

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/general-settings.webp" alt="Marketplace Menu" /></a>

---

## Step 7 – Update Permalinks

This step is **mandatory**.

   - Go to **Settings > Permalinks**.
   - Set **Post Name** as the permalink structure.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/flush-permalink.webp"><img src="./assets/flush-permalink.webp" alt="Update Permalinks" /></a>

## Notes

- Always ensure the plugin zip is compatible with your WooCommerce version.
- Update permalinks after installation to avoid 404 errors.

---

# Elementor Compatibility and Shortcodes

WooCommerce Marketplace is fully **compatible with Elementor**, enabling admins to easily design vendor-related pages using shortcodes.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/elementor-compatibility.webp"><img src="./assets/elementor-compatibility.webp" alt="Elementor compatibility" /></a>

## Vendor Registration and Login Page

The admin can create a vendor registration and login page using **Elementor’s Shortcode widget**.

<div class="elementor-shortcode-card">

### How to Create the Vendor Page

<div class="shortcode-steps-list">

1. Edit a page using **Elementor**.
2. Drag and drop the **Shortcode** widget onto the page.
3. Insert the following shortcode:

</div>

```text
[marketplace]
```

### This Shortcode Displays

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- Vendor registration form
- Vendor login form

</div>

### After Login, Vendors Can

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- View their profile details
- Manage their account information from the same page

</div>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-elementor.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-elementor.webp" alt="Vendor Page using Elementor" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-edit-elementor.webp"><img src="./assets/woocommerce-marketplace-seller-edit-elementor.webp" alt="Vendor Profile Page" /></a>

</div>

---

## Display Vendor Name on Single Product Page

To show the vendor’s name on the single product page, use the shortcode below:

<div class="elementor-shortcode-card">

```text
[wkmp_seller_profile_link]
```

### Functionality

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- Displays the vendor name on the product page
- Vendor name appears as a clickable link
- Redirects customers to the vendor’s profile page

</div>

### How to Use

<div class="shortcode-steps-list">

1. Edit the Single Product Page using Elementor
2. Add a Shortcode widget where the vendor name should appear
3. Paste the shortcode:

</div>

```text
[wkmp_seller_profile_link]
```

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/shortcode1.webp"><img src="./assets/shortcode1.webp" alt="Vendor Name on Product Page" /></a>

</div>

---

## Display Vendor List with Search & Product Count

To display a list of all vendors with search and product count, use the shortcode below:

<div class="elementor-shortcode-card">

```text
[wkmp-vendors-list show_search=yes show_heading=1 show_product_count=1]
```

### Displayed Features

<div class="qs-specs-list">

- List of all registered vendors
- Search bar to filter vendors
- Section heading
- Product count for each vendor

</div>

### Shortcode Parameters Table

<div class="table-modern">

| Parameter | Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `show_search` | `yes` | Show vendor search bar |
| `show_search` | `no` | Hide vendor search bar |
| `show_heading` | `1` | Show heading |
| `show_heading` | `0` | Hide heading |
| `show_product_count` | `1` | Show product count |
| `show_product_count` | `0` | Hide product count |

</div>

### How to Use

<div class="shortcode-steps-list">

1. Edit any page using Elementor or the WordPress editor
2. Add a Shortcode widget or block
3. Paste the shortcode:

</div>

```text
[wkmp-vendors-list show_search=yes show_heading=1 show_product_count=1]
```

# Configuration – General Settings

After successfully installing WooCommerce Marketplace, the admin can configure the core marketplace settings such as vendor registration, approval workflow, default vendor capabilities, and overall marketplace behavior from:

**Marketplace > Settings > General**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.png"><img src="./assets/general-settings.png" alt="Admin Panel" /></a>

---

## General Settings Options

### Default Commission

Configures the default commission structure applied to vendor sales when no custom commission is set for an individual vendor:

- **Fixed Flat Amount (`$`)**: A fixed currency amount deducted per sale for the marketplace admin (e.g., `$0`).
- **Percentage Rate (`%`)**: A percentage deducted from the product price for the marketplace admin (e.g., `12%`).
- **Combined Commission Model (`$ + %`)**: Admins can combine both fixed and percentage values (e.g., `$2 + 10%`) to create a tiered commission rule.
- **Fallback Rule**: Applied globally to all vendor products unless a vendor-specific commission override is set.

#### Calculation Examples

- **Percentage Only (`$0 + 20%`)**:
  - Product Price: **$100**
  - Admin Commission: **$20**
  - Vendor Receives: **$80**
- **Fixed + Percentage (`$2 + 10%`)**:
  - Product Price: **$100**
  - Admin Commission: **$12** ($2 fixed + $10 percentage)
  - Vendor Receives: **$88**

::: info Commission Management & Order Tracking
For detailed instructions on viewing commission breakdowns in marketplace orders, tracking admin earnings versus vendor payouts, and configuring custom vendor-specific commission overrides, see the [Commission Management](./commission-management.html) guide.
:::

---

### Deduct Discount From

Defines how promotional discounts or coupons applied by customers at checkout are deducted between the admin and vendor:

- **Both Vendor Total Amount and Admin Commission Amount**:
  - The discount amount is shared proportionately between the vendor's earnings and the admin's commission based on their commission split.
- **Vendor Total Amount**:
  - The entire discount amount is deducted solely from the vendor's total payout.
  - The admin retains their full commission amount untouched.
- **Admin Commission Amount**:
  - The entire discount amount is deducted solely from the admin's commission share.
  - The vendor receives their full standard earnings.

::: tip Extra Discount Covered by Admin
If **Admin Commission Amount** is selected and the customer's discount is higher than the admin's commission, the marketplace admin covers (pays) the remaining difference so the vendor still receives their full earnings.

**Quick Example:**
- Product Price: **$100**
- Admin Commission (10%): **$10**
- Customer Discount Coupon: **$15**
- The admin covers the full **$15** discount (absorbing the extra **$5** difference), and the vendor still receives their full **$90** payout.
:::

---

### Auto Approve Vendor

Controls the approval workflow for new vendor registrations:

- **Enabled (Checked)**:
  - Vendors are **automatically approved** immediately upon registration.
  - New vendors instantly gain access to their seller dashboard, store setup, and product creation features without waiting for admin review.
- **Disabled (Unchecked)**:
  - New vendor registrations remain in a **Pending** status.
  - The marketplace administrator must manually review and approve the vendor account from **Marketplace > Vendors** before the vendor can access seller features.

---

### Separate Vendor Dashboard

Choose whether vendors manage their store from the **WordPress Admin backend (`/wp-admin/`)** or directly from the **front of your website**:

- **Enabled (Checked)**: Vendors can log into your WordPress admin panel (`/wp-admin/`) and manage their store using dedicated WordPress backend menus.
- **Disabled (Unchecked)**: Vendors manage their products and orders entirely from the storefront (using **My Account** or the **Seller Panel**). Access to `/wp-admin/` is restricted for vendors.

::: tip Which option should you choose?
- **Keep Disabled (Recommended):** Best for most marketplaces. Vendors manage everything easily from the website storefront, keeping your WordPress admin dashboard private, clean, and secure.
- **Enable:** Turn this on only if you specifically want vendors to log into and work inside the WordPress `/wp-admin/` control panel.
:::

---

### Data Delete After Vendor Delete

Specifies how vendor data and catalog items are handled when a vendor account is deleted by the administrator:

- **Enabled (Checked)**:
  - **All vendor data is deleted**: Products, listings, and vendor records are permanently deleted when the vendor is removed.
- **Disabled (Unchecked)**:
  - **Reassign to Admin**: The vendor’s products and records are preserved and automatically assigned to the marketplace admin instead.

---

### Applicable Shipping Methods

The admin can select which shipping method will apply at checkout:

- **Admin Shipping Method**
- **Vendor Shipping Method**

---

#### More About Applicable Shipping Methods

##### Admin Shipping Method Selected

- Admin shipping rates will apply to **all products**, including vendor products.
- The shipping rate remains the same regardless of whether the cart contains admin or vendor products.

##### Vendor Shipping Method Selected

- Vendor-specific shipping rates will apply to vendor products.
- Admin shipping applies to admin products.
- Vendors configure their own delivery zones, rates, classes, and pickup counters in their seller dashboard as explained in the [Vendor Shipping Zone Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/vendor-shipping-zone-management) guide.

##### Mixed Cart (Admin + Vendor Products)

If the cart contains products from **both admin and vendor**:

- The total shipping cost will be a **combined rate** of both admin and vendor shipping.
- This applies regardless of the selected Applicable Shipping Method.

---

### Vendor Page

Select the page to be used as the **Vendor Page** (which shows the vendor listing).

⚠️ **Important Notes**:
- Updating the vendor page will **erase existing content** of the newly selected page.
- After changing the page, kindly **update permalinks**.

---

### Seller Central Page

Select the page to be used as the **Seller Central Page**.

⚠️ **Important Notes**:
- Updating a new seller central page will **erase existing content** of the newly selected page.
- After changing the page, kindly **update permalinks**.

---

### Shop Name on Registration

Controls the visibility and requirement of the **Shop Name** field on the vendor registration form:

- **Required**: Vendors must enter a **Shop Name** during registration.
- **Optional**: The Shop Name field is optional. If left empty, the module will automatically use the vendor's name instead.
- **Remove**: Completely removes the Shop Name field from the registration form. When removed, the module automatically uses the vendor's name as the shop name.

---

### Shop Slug on Registration

Controls the visibility and requirement of the **Shop Slug (Store URL)** field on the vendor registration form:

- **Required**: Vendors must enter a **Shop URL** during registration.
- **Optional**: The Shop Slug field is optional. If left empty, the module will automatically use the vendor's username instead.
- **Remove**: Completely removes the Shop Slug field from the registration form. When removed, the module automatically uses the vendor's username as the shop URL slug.

---

### Vendor Terms & Conditions Page

The admin can select a **Terms & Conditions page** that will be displayed to vendors during registration:

- **`-----Disable Terms and Conditions-----`**: Disables the terms and conditions checkbox on the vendor registration form.
- **Select Page**: Choose any published WordPress page (e.g., *Terms & Conditions*). A required terms and conditions agreement checkbox linked to this page will appear on the vendor registration form.

---

### Allow Vendor Registration on My Account

- If enabled, vendor registration fields will appear on the **WooCommerce My Account** signup form.
- If disabled, a link to the **Seller Central Registration Form** will be displayed instead.

---

### Vendor KYC Verification Settings

Admins can configure the KYC (Know Your Customer) document verification settings directly from the General tab:

- **Enable Vendor KYC Verification**: A master checkbox toggle to enable or disable vendor document verification globally. When checked, vendors can upload KYC documents to support the approval of their seller account.
- **KYC Document Types**: Admins can define the types of documents allowed (e.g., *Business License*, *Government ID*, *Utility Bill*). You can select from suggested types or type and add custom document types.
- **Allowed KYC Formats**: Restrict document uploads to specific permitted file formats by selecting the checkboxes: **PDF**, **JPG**, **JPEG**, **PNG**, and **WEBP**.
- **Restrict KYC Document Size**: Optionally enforce minimum and maximum file size limits (in **KB**) for document uploads (e.g., from `10` KB to `2048` KB).

---

### New Vendor Dashboard

The **New vendor dashboard** setting controls whether vendors access the redesigned, modern vendor dashboard interface:

- **Disabled — every vendor uses the classic dashboard**: All vendors remain on the classic seller dashboard interface.
- **Optional — each vendor chooses**: Each vendor can individually choose whether to use the classic dashboard or switch to the new redesigned dashboard UI.
- **Forced — every vendor uses the new dashboard**: Enforces the new modern vendor dashboard interface for all vendors across the marketplace.

::: tip Modern Interface Rollout
The redesigned vendor dashboard serves the updated UI on existing vendor endpoints. Vendor URLs, add-ons, and permissions remain unchanged; only the dashboard shell and migrated screens provide the modernized experience.
:::

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Dashboard](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-dashboard.html) and [Seller Panel Overview](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/seller-panel-overview.html).

---

### Seller Panel Page

The **Seller panel page** setting allows admins to designate a dedicated WordPress page that serves the vendor dashboard on its own standalone URLs:

- **`----- Disable the seller panel -----`**: Switches off the standalone seller panel URLs.
- **Select Page (e.g., Seller Panel)**: Assigns the chosen WordPress page (e.g., *Seller Panel*) to serve as the base for the standalone seller dashboard.

#### Key Features of the Seller Panel

- **Runs beside My Account**: The seller panel operates alongside the standard WooCommerce My Account dashboard rather than replacing it.
- **Consistent Endpoints**: It serves all vendor endpoints under clean, dedicated slugs (e.g., `/seller/vendor-products/` alongside `/my-account/vendor-products/`, and `/seller/orders/` alongside `/my-account/orders/`).
- **Direct Link**: When enabled, the live URL to the vendor dashboard (e.g., `https://your-domain/seller/vendor-dashboard/`) is displayed directly beneath the setting for direct access.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-panel-dashboard.png"><img src="./assets/seller-panel-dashboard.png" alt="Seller Panel Dashboard" /></a>

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Dashboard](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-dashboard.html) and [Seller Panel Overview](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/seller-panel-overview.html).

---

### Admin-Configurable Upload Restrictions

Admins can set global upload restrictions for every vendor image, including:
- Avatar
- Logo
- Fulfillment
- Banner

For each image type, admins can define:
- Allowed file types
- Optional file size limits
- Optional dimension limits (width/height)

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-upload-restrictions.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-upload-restrictions.png" alt="Upload Restrictions" /></a> -->

---

### "Sold by" Visibility Control

Admins have full control over whether the "Sold by" text is visible to customers.
- **Global Setting**: A master toggle to hide the vendor name and store links across the shop, cart, checkout, orders, emails, and invoices.
- **Per-Vendor Override**: Admins can override the global setting on a per-vendor basis if certain vendors need their names displayed or hidden.

<!-- <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/placeholder-sold-by-visibility.png"><img src="./assets/placeholder-sold-by-visibility.png" alt="Sold By Visibility Settings" /></a> -->

---

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/product-settings.html -->

# Configuration – Product Settings

The **Product Settings** allow the admin to manage how vendors add, edit, and publish products in the marketplace.

**Path:**
Marketplace > Settings > Product

---

## Vendor Product Settings

- **Allow Vendor to Publish**
  - Enable to auto-approve and publish vendor products.
  - Disable to require admin approval for all vendor-added or edited products.
  - *Flow:* Vendor adds/edits product → Status becomes **Draft** → Admin reviews and publishes.

- **Allow Vendors to Translate Products (WPML)**
  - Enables vendors to translate products from their dashboard.
  - Available only when **WPML** is installed and activated.

- **Allowed Product Types**
  - Admin selects which product types vendors can create in the marketplace.
  - Supported options:
    - **Simple product**: Standard physical or standard products with a single SKU and price.
    - **Grouped product**: A collection of related products that can be purchased together.
    - **External/Affiliate product**: Products linked to an external website for purchase.
    - **Variable product**: Products with multiple variations (e.g., different sizes or colors).
    - Downloadable / Virtual variations when simple or variable is chosen.

- **Allowed Categories**
  - Admin selects which product categories vendors can use while adding products.
  - Vendors can only assign their products to the categories selected by the administrator.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product.webp" alt="Vendor Product Settings" /></a>

---

## Minimum Order Amount Settings

The administrator can enforce a minimum purchase amount that customers must spend on a vendor's products before placing an order:

- **Enable**
  - Turn on this toggle to activate the minimum order amount requirement for vendor products across the marketplace.
- **Minimum Amount**
  - Enter the default minimum order value (e.g., `50`).
  - Customers must have at least this subtotal of items from the vendor in their cart to proceed through checkout.
- **Amount Value for Vendor**
  - When checked, individual vendors can define their own custom minimum order amount in their seller dashboard.
  - If a vendor leaves their custom amount empty, this global admin default value automatically applies.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-min-order.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-min-order.webp" alt="Minimum Order Amount Settings" /></a>

---

## Product Quantity Limit Settings

Allows the marketplace administrator to place purchase quantity limits on vendor products:

- **Enable**
  - Check this option to allow maximum purchase quantity restrictions on vendor products.
- **Default Maximum Quantity**
  - Define the global default maximum number of units of a product that a customer can purchase in a single order (e.g., `5` or `10`).
  - Helps vendors manage high-demand products, limited inventory, or wholesale purchasing restrictions.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-qty-limit.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-qty-limit.webp" alt="Product Quantity Limit Settings" /></a>

---

## Product Form Settings

Admins can customize the appearance, step-by-step guidance, and layout of the vendor product creation and edit screens:

- **Show Stepper**
  - **Show the stepper**: Displays a clear Step 1–3 progress indicator (*Step 1: Product Basics*, *Step 2: Product Details*, *Step 3: Complete Listing*) on the vendor's add and edit product screens.
  - Helps new and existing sellers complete the required product fields in a structured, guided sequence.

- **Show Listing Completeness**
  - **Show the Listing Completeness score**: Displays a visual listing completeness percentage badge on the vendor's product editing screen.
  - Shows vendors which recommended elements (such as images, descriptions, SKU, inventory, and attributes) are missing to optimize product discovery and buyer trust.

- **Form Navigation**
  - Choose how sections of the vendor edit product form are organized and navigated:
    - **Horizontal Tabs**: Organizes product data sections into horizontal top navigation tabs.
    - **Vertical Tabs**: Displays product data sections in a clean vertical left-hand navigation list.
    - **Stacked Form**: Displays all product sections in a continuous, stacked single-page layout for easy scrolling.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-form.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-form.webp" alt="Product Form Settings - Form Navigation" /></a>

- **Vendor Mode**
  - **Let vendors choose their own product form settings**: When enabled, vendors see a **Settings > Site Setting** option in their seller panel.
  - Each vendor can choose their own preferred form layout (horizontal tabs, vertical tabs, or stacked) to match their personal workflow, overriding the marketplace default for their own store.

---

## Product Fulfilment Settings

- When enabled, vendors can manage their own product fulfilment details.
- Vendors can add a fulfilment label, image, and description from their dashboard.
- Vendor-specific fulfilment information is displayed on the product page.
- When disabled, fulfilment details are managed and shown only by the admin.

- Allows buyers to see **who will fulfil product delivery**.
- **Admin can:**
  - **Enable**: Master toggle to enable product fulfillment details for marketplace vendors.
  - **Fulfillment Image**: Upload a default fulfillment or logistics partner badge icon.
  - **Fulfillment Label**: Add a default badge title (e.g., *Fulfilled by Marketplace*).
  - **Fulfillment Text**: Provide descriptive text explaining the fulfillment process shown to customers on product pages.
- **Vendor Support:**
  - Vendors can configure fulfilment details from their dashboard.
  - Vendor-specific fulfilment details appear on the product page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-full.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-full.webp" alt="Product Fulfilment Settings" /></a>

---

## Vendor Bulk Upload Settings

Enables vendors to import multiple products at once using CSV files, speeding up catalog creation for large inventories:

- **Allow Vendors to Bulk Upload**
  - Check this option to grant marketplace vendors access to the bulk product upload tool in their seller dashboard.
  - When enabled, vendors can download CSV sample files, prepare product data, and upload entire catalogs at once.

- **Maximum Rows per File**
  - Set the maximum number of product rows allowed in a single uploaded CSV file (default: `500`).
  - Limits file sizes to ensure fast, reliable processing and prevent server memory timeouts.

- **Product Images**
  - Defines how product images specified in the CSV upload are handled:
    - **Download image URLs from the file**: Automatically downloads image files from external URLs specified in the CSV file and imports them directly into the WordPress media library.
    - **Only images already in the vendor's media library**: Matches and attaches images that the vendor has already pre-uploaded to their WordPress media library by filename.
    - **No images (added later in the product editor)**: Imports product details without images, allowing sellers to upload photos manually later through the product editor.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-fullfilment.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-admin-setting-product-fullfilment.webp" alt="Vendor Bulk Upload Settings - Product Images" /></a>

---

- **Detailed Guides**: See [Vendor Product Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-product-management.html), [Bulk Upload Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/bulk-upload.html), and [Commission Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/commission-management.html).

# Configuration – Assets Visibility

The **Assets Visibility** settings allow the admin to control which vendor details and assets are visible on the **Vendor Profile** and **Vendor Dashboard**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/asset-visibility.webp"><img src="./assets/asset-visibility.webp" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Assets Visibility Settings" /></a>

---

## Assets Visibility Path

- Marketplace > Settings > Assets Visibility

---

## Vendor Profile Visibility Settings

- **Email**
  - Show or hide the vendor’s email address on the vendor profile

- **Phone Number**
  - Enable or disable the display of the vendor’s phone number

- **Address**
  - Control whether the vendor’s address is visible on the profile page

- **Social Links**
  - Show or hide vendor social media links on the vendor profile

- **Hide Customer Details From Vendor**
  - Restricts vendors from viewing customer billing details
  - Restricts vendors from viewing customer shipping details
  - Helps maintain customer privacy

- **Display "Sold by" Vendor Info to Customers**
  - Controls whether the vendor name and store links are displayed to customers across the storefront.
  - **Where it applies**: Catalog and shop pages (PLP), product detail pages (PDP), cart page, checkout page, order confirmation screens, customer account orders, and invoices.
  - **When checked (Default)**: Customers can see which vendor sells each product, with direct links to visit the vendor's storefront profile.
  - **When unchecked**: Vendor names and store links remain hidden from customers across all shop, cart, checkout, order, and invoice pages. This allows marketplace owners to present a unified, single-brand marketplace experience.
  - **Per-Vendor Override**: Store administrators can also customize this option individually for specific vendors from the vendor edit screen.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-setting-assets-options.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-setting-assets-options.webp" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Assets Settings Options" /></a>

- **Show Legacy Vendor Profile**
  - Enable to display the vendor profile using the legacy layout
  - Disable to use the new optimized layout
    - Includes Report Flag section
    - Improved UI and performance

---

## Hide Vendor Dashboard Section

Marketplace administrators can choose which analytical widgets and reporting blocks are displayed on the vendor dashboard (`Marketplace > Reports` or `/vendor-dashboard`). Checking any of these checkboxes hides the corresponding widget from all vendor dashboard views:

- **Summary**
  - Hides the top summary performance cards from the vendor dashboard.
  - Metrics include **Total Sales**, **Total Orders**, **Total Customers**, and **Average Order Value (AOV)**.
  - Useful when store administrators want to simplify the dashboard overview or keep summarized revenue numbers private.

- **Sale Order History**
  - Hides the **Sales & Order Analytics** chart and timeline graph.
  - Prevents vendors from seeing visual sales trends and graphical revenue analytics over time.

- **Total Orders & Total Products**
  - Hides the quick statistics cards showing the vendor's total order count and total product count.

- **Top Billing Country**
  - Hides the **Top Billing Countries** geographic distribution block.
  - Vendors will not see the breakdown of customer orders by country.

- **Recent Orders**
  - Hides the **Recent Orders** quick preview table on the vendor dashboard main page.
  - Vendors can still view and process their orders through the dedicated **Orders** menu if access is permitted.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-setting-assets-hide-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-setting-assets-hide-vendor.webp" alt="Hide Vendor Dashboard Section Settings" /></a>

---

## Vendor Dashboard Statistics Data Style

Customize the appearance and branding colors of the analytics cards, charts, and metric widgets displayed on the vendor dashboard:

- **Primary Color Code**
  - Defines the primary color used in vendor dashboard statistics, chart lines, and key highlights.
  - Choose a color using the color picker tool or enter a valid Hex code (e.g., `#1f2937`).

- **Secondary Color Code**
  - Defines the secondary color used in vendor dashboard statistics, subtitles, and secondary indicators.
  - Choose a color using the color picker tool or enter a valid Hex code (e.g., `#1f2937`).

- **Grids background color code**
  - Defines the background color for data metric cards, statistic boxes, and analytical grid panels on the vendor dashboard.
  - Enter a custom Hex code (e.g., `#eeeeee`) or select a color with the picker to match your marketplace branding.

# Configuration – Endpoints

The **Endpoints** configuration allows the admin to manage dynamic URL segments used across the vendor dashboard and related pages in the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace.

---

## Endpoints Overview

- Endpoints add an extra segment to a page URL
- Used to load different sections without creating separate pages
- Commonly used for:
  - Vendor dashboard pages
  - Vendor profile pages
  - Orders, settings, and other vendor actions
- Fully configurable by the admin

---

## What is an Endpoint?

- An endpoint is an additional URL segment appended to a page
- Example:
  - Base URL: `example.com/vendorprofile`
  - With endpoint: `example.com/vendorprofile/edit-vendor-profile`
- Helps display specific sections such as:
  - Edit Profile
  - Dashboard
  - Order History
  - Settings pages

---

## Admin Configuration

- Navigate to:
  - **Marketplace > Settings > Endpoints**
- The admin can configure:
  - **Endpoint** – URL slug appended to the page
  - **Title** – Menu label shown in the vendor dashboard

---

## Endpoint Customization

- Each endpoint URL can be customized
- Endpoints must be **unique** to avoid conflicts
- Any changes reflect immediately in vendor dashboard URLs
- **Hide Dashboard Sections**: Admins can easily hide individual vendor dashboard sections directly from the Endpoints settings by disabling their respective endpoints.
- Recommended practice:
  - Use a prefix such as **`vendor-`** to avoid collisions

---

## Examples

- **Dashboard**
  - Endpoint: `dashboard`
  - Title: `Dashboard`

- **Order History**
  - Endpoint: `order-history`
  - Title: `Order History`

---

## Vendor Dashboard Menu

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="Vendor Dashboard Endpoints" /></a>

- Endpoint **Titles** appear as menu items in the vendor dashboard
- Clicking a menu item loads the corresponding page using its endpoint

---

## Hide Customer WooCommerce Endpoints

- Admin can hide **customer-related WooCommerce endpoints** from the vendor dashboard
- Prevents vendors from seeing irrelevant customer menu items
- Improves vendor dashboard clarity and usability

### Already Registered WooCommerce Endpoints

- `dashboard`
- `orders`
- `downloads`
- `edit-address`
- `payment-methods`
- `edit-account`
- `customer-logout`
- `order-pay`
- `order-received`
- `view-order`
- `lost-password`
- `add-payment-method`
- `delete-payment-method`
- `set-default-payment-method`

### Behavior

- These customer endpoints can be hidden across **all vendor endpoint pages**
- Only vendor-relevant endpoints remain visible in the dashboard
- **Re-show Logout Endpoint**: If customer endpoints are hidden, admins can use a specific option to keep the **Logout** endpoint visible, ensuring vendors can still log out easily.

---

## Customer Endpoint Visibility Controls

At the top of the **Endpoints** settings screen, the administrator can manage whether standard WooCommerce customer navigation items appear alongside vendor management links:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/endpoints.webp"><img src="./assets/endpoints.webp" alt="Customer Endpoint Visibility Settings" /></a>

- **Hide Customer endpoints on all vendor endpoints pages**
  - **Default**: Enabled (Checked)
  - **How it works**: Hides standard customer account endpoints (such as *Downloads*, *Addresses*, *Payment Methods*, and default customer *Orders*) from the vendor navigation menu across all vendor endpoint screens.
  - **Benefit**: Keeps the seller interface focused purely on commercial store management and reduces navigation clutter.

- **Show Logout endpoint on vendor dashboard (when customer endpoints are hidden)**
  - **Default**: Disabled (Unchecked)
  - **How it works**: When customer endpoints are hidden, the native WooCommerce logout link might also be hidden from the sidebar. Enabling this setting ensures a dedicated **Logout** button remains visible in the vendor dashboard menu so sellers can log out with one click.

---
