## Searching and Filtering Store Pickup Orders

To help marketplace administrators efficiently navigate large volumes of pickup orders across hundreds of sellers, the Store Pickup Orders interface includes robust search and dual filtering controls.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-store-pickup-filter.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-store-pickup-filter.webp" alt="Filtering Store Pickup Orders" /></a>

### 1. Keyword & Order Search
The **Search orders** input field is located at the top right of the list table:
- Enter an **Order ID** (e.g., `1171`), a **Customer Name** (e.g., `Demo Customer`), or a **Customer Email** (e.g., `demo_customer@nexora.test`).
- Click **Search orders** (or press <kbd>Enter</kbd>).
- The system uses WooCommerce's high-performance `wc_order_search()` engine to quickly locate matching orders.

### 2. Filter by Vendor
The **Filter by vendor** dropdown (`wkmp_vendor`) allows administrators to isolate orders belonging to a specific seller:
- Select **All vendors** to display orders from across the entire marketplace.
- Select a specific registered vendor (e.g., *Aurora Athletics*, *Copperleaf Kitchen*, *Lumen Beauty*, *Maison Terra*, *Norden Supply*, *Paperfold Studio*, *Thread & Grain*, *Volt & Vine*).
- Click **Filter**. The table refreshes to show only pickup orders that contain items from the selected seller.

### 3. Filter by Order Status
The **Filter by order status** dropdown (`wkmp_status`) allows filtering orders according to their WooCommerce fulfillment lifecycle:
- **All statuses**: Displays orders in any status.
- **Pending payment** (`pending`): Orders created but waiting for payment completion.
- **Processing** (`processing`): Paid orders ready for item packing and customer collection.
- **On hold** (`on-hold`): Orders awaiting offline payment confirmation or administrative review.
- **Completed** (`completed`): Orders where customer collection, OTP validation, and order fulfillment are 100% complete.
- **Cancelled** (`cancelled`): Orders cancelled by the customer, vendor, or administrator.
- **Refunded** (`refunded`): Orders where funds were returned to the buyer.
- **Failed** (`failed`): Orders with failed payment transactions.
- **Draft** (`checkout-draft`): Incomplete checkout sessions.

### Combined Filter Logic & Resetting
- **Combined Filtering**: The vendor filter and order status filter can be combined simultaneously. For example, selecting **Aurora Athletics** and **Processing** isolates only those active orders currently waiting for pickup at Aurora Athletics' retail counter.
- **Resetting Filters**: To clear active filters and return to the complete orders list, reset both dropdowns to **All vendors** and **All statuses**, clear any text in the search box, and click **Filter**.

---

## Admin Order Screen Integration & Handover Meta Box

In addition to the central registry, marketplace administrators have full operational control over individual store collections directly inside the WooCommerce order edit screen (`wp-admin/admin.php?page=wc-orders&action=edit&id={order_id}` in HPOS or `wp-admin/post.php?post={order_id}&action=edit`).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-store-pickup-metabox.png"><img src="./assets/admin-store-pickup-metabox.png" alt="WooCommerce Order Screen Store Pickup Meta Box" /></a>

### Features of the Store Pickup Meta Box:
1. **Pickup Location Summary**: Displays each participating seller's registered shop name and physical collection address (e.g., *Aurora Athletics · 1420 SE Water Avenue, Suite 3, Portland, OR 97214*).
2. **Pickup Verification Box**: If **Require Pickup Code** is active, a dedicated verification box appears for each vendor:
   - Displays clear instructions: *"The order must be verified before it can be completed. Send the customer a one-time code by email and ask for it at the store."*
   - Includes a **Send code** button that allows administrators to trigger a 6-digit OTP email on behalf of any vendor.
   - Once dispatched, a live countdown timer displays the remaining validity window (based on your configured Code Expiry in minutes).
   - An input field allows the administrator or staff to enter the customer's 6-digit PIN and click **Verify OTP**.
3. **Completed Status Guardrail**:
   - The marketplace enforces an automatic security guardrail on the order completion lifecycle.
   - If an administrator or vendor attempts to change the order status to **Completed** while a Store Pickup vendor package remains unverified, the system blocks the update and displays an explicit error message:
     > *"Verify the pickup code before completing this order."*
4. **Permanent Audit Trail**:
   - When OTP verification is successful, the system records an immutable timestamped note in the WooCommerce order history:
     > *"Store pickup verified by [Admin/Vendor/Staff Name] on [Date/Time]."*

---

## Vendor Staff Permissions for Store Pickup

Marketplace vendors often employ store assistants, cashiers, or warehouse personnel to manage front-desk handovers. Marketplace administrators manage staff accounts and permissions from:

**Marketplace > Vendor Staffs** (`wp-admin/admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-vendor-staffs`)

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-staffs-store-pickup.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-staffs-store-pickup.png" alt="Admin Vendor Staffs Management" /></a>

### Store Pickup Staff Capabilities:
In **Marketplace > Settings > Staffs** (`wp-admin/admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-settings&tab=staff`), administrators configure which capabilities vendors are permitted to delegate:

| Capability Name | Internal Slug | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **View store pickup orders** | `store_pickup_view` | Enables the staff member to access the **Store Pickup Orders** list in their seller dashboard to review arriving customers and pending pickups. |
| **Send and verify pickup codes** | `store_pickup_verify` | Authorizes counter staff to click **Generate OTP**, dispatch the verification code to the customer, and validate the customer's 6-digit PIN during physical handovers. |

::: tip Whitelist Enforcement
Staff members can only be assigned these capabilities if the marketplace administrator has checked them in the global permissions matrix under **Marketplace > Settings > Staffs**. For a full guide on staff quotas and role privileges, see the [Admin Staff Settings Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/admin-staff-setting.html).
:::

---

## Step-by-Step Counter Handover Workflow

Marketplace administrators, sellers, and authorized counter staff follow a secure 5-stage progression to verify customer identity and fulfill in-store collections:

| Step | Handover Stage | Responsible Party | Operational Action & System Rule |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | **Customer Arrival** | Store Staff | Locate the order in the **Store Pickup Orders** registry using customer name, email, or order ID. |
| **02** | **Code Dispatch** | Store Staff | Click **Send code** (or **Generate OTP**) in the order view to email a secure 6-digit PIN to the buyer. |
| **03** | **PIN Presentation** | Customer | Customer opens their billing email on mobile and presents the 6-digit verification code at the desk. |
| **04** | **OTP Validation** | Store Staff | Staff enters the code and clicks **Verify OTP**. The system validates the code against the active hash. |
| **05** | **Order Completion** | Store Staff / Admin | System marks pickup verified, records the audit timestamp, and unlocks the **Completed** status. |

### Operational Procedure Details:

1. **Order Identification & Counter Check-In**:
   When the customer arrives at the retail store desk, the staff member opens the **Store Pickup Orders** list and quickly searches by customer name, order number, or email to pull up the customer's package record.

2. **Trigger Verification PIN Dispatch**:
   The staff member opens the order details and clicks **Send code** (or **Generate OTP**). A temporary 6-digit one-time code is instantly emailed to the customer's billing email address, and a live countdown timer begins in the order view.

3. **Customer Code Presentation**:
   The customer retrieves the 6-digit PIN from their inbox and shows it to the counter attendant. If the code expires before validation, the **Resend OTP** button becomes active as soon as the countdown timer reaches zero.

4. **Security Validation & Authentication**:
   The counter assistant enters the 6-digit PIN into the verification field and clicks **Verify OTP**. The marketplace system verifies the code, transitions the status badge to `<mark class="wkmp-store-pickup-admin-status--picked_up">Picked up</mark>`, and permanently logs the staff member's name, user ID, and verification timestamp into the order history notes.

5. **Package Handover & Final Order Completion**:
   With verification validated, the staff member hands over the packaged merchandise. The marketplace Completed Guardrail clears, allowing the order status to transition to **Completed**.

---

## Best Practices & Administrative Checklist

1. **Verify Vendor Shop Addresses**:
   - Ensure all marketplace vendors have complete physical shop addresses (Street, City, State, Postcode, and Country) configured in their vendor profile.
   - If a vendor's profile lacks an address, Store Pickup cannot calculate correctly at checkout.
2. **Review Code Expiry Durations**:
   - A setting of **2 to 5 minutes** is optimal for high-traffic retail counters, ensuring tight security without keeping customers waiting.
3. **Check Spam Filters for OTP Delivery**:
   - If a customer reports not receiving their code, remind them to check their spam or promotions folder. Once the timer reaches zero, click **Resend OTP** to generate a fresh PIN.
4. **Audit Multi-Vendor Orders**:
   - In orders containing products from multiple sellers, remember that each seller independently verifies their own package pickup. The overall order can only move to Completed once all vendor parts are satisfied.
5. **HPOS Compatibility**:
   - The Store Pickup Orders registry and order edit meta box are fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) as well as traditional WordPress post tables.

---

::: important Essential Prerequisite: Enabling Store Pickup & Shipping Zones
For customer orders to appear in the **Store Pickup Orders** registry, the Store Pickup fulfillment method must first be activated in the marketplace settings and added to your WooCommerce shipping zones:

- **Enable Store Pickup**: Navigate to **Marketplace > Settings > Store Pickup** (`wp-admin/admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-settings&tab=store_pickup`) and enable the **Enable Store Pickup** checkbox. You can also configure the **Require Pickup Code** security guardrail and the **Code Expiry** duration (1–60 minutes).
- **Add to Shipping Zones**: Navigate to **WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping** (`wp-admin/admin.php?page=wc-settings&tab=shipping`), open your target zone, and add **Store Pickup** as an active shipping method.

For a full step-by-step walkthrough on configuring these options, refer to the **[Store Pickup Settings Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/store-pickup-settings.html)**.
:::

---

# Vendors Payout Management

Admins can now review pending payouts, filter and search by vendor or status, and run bulk Mark-as-Paid or CSV Export in one click — backed by six dedicated REST routes.

This also ships:
- **Category Filter**: Inline product count and product search on the seller profile.
- **Frontend Bulk Actions**: Assign Categories and Publish actions directly on the seller product list.
- **Data-Driven Seller-Profile Tabs**: Optimized profile tabs for addons.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendors-payout-management.webp"><img src="./assets/vendors-payout-management.webp" alt="Vendors Payout Management" /></a>

---

## Vendors Payout Dashboard Features

The new Vendors Payout Management dashboard provides a centralized view for admins to track vendor orders, commissions, payment methods, and seller payouts.

### Dashboard Highlights

- **Payable Withdrawals & Unpaid Amounts**: View total pending payable requests and total unpaid payout amounts at a glance.
- **Total Commission Earned**: Monitor total marketplace commission earnings.
- **Unpaid Vendors**: Track the number of vendors with unpaid payouts.

### Payout Management Capabilities

- **Review Pending Payouts**: Easily review all requested withdrawals from vendors.

#### Filter and Search

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-payout-filter.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-payout-filter.webp" alt="Vendor Payout Filters" /></a>

Admins can use the advanced filtering and searching tools to locate specific payout records quickly:
- **Filter by Vendor**: Select a specific vendor from the dropdown (e.g., "Blue Heaven's Store" or "ElectroMart") to view only their pending or completed payout requests.
- **Filter by Status**: View payouts by their current status, such as "Pending", to isolate pending requests.
- **Search by Withdrawal ID**: Quickly find a specific withdrawal request by entering its unique ID in the search bar.

#### Bulk Actions

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-payout-bulk-actions.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-payout-bulk-actions.webp" alt="Vendor Payout Bulk Actions" /></a>

For efficient management of multiple withdrawal requests, admins can utilize the bulk actions menu:
- **Mark as Paid**: Select multiple pending withdrawals using the checkboxes on the left, then run the "Mark as Paid" bulk action to clear them all in a single click.
- **Export CSV**: Download a comprehensive CSV file containing the selected payout records for offline accounting and external record-keeping.

#### Individual Payouts

- **Pay Now**: Admins can also manage transactions individually by clicking the **Pay Now** button located next to any withdrawal request to quickly process a specific payout.


- **User Permissions**: Accessible to users with the `manage_options` administrative capability (Marketplace Administrators and authorized Shop Managers).
- **Fast Asynchronous Interface**: Built using modern WordPress React components for real-time filtering, instant status updates, and interactive confirmations without page refreshes.

Bookmark this screen in your browser for quick access during weekly accounting, billing cycles, and month-end seller settlements.

## Dimension 1: Financial Metric Stat Cards

At the top of the Vendors Payout dashboard, four real-time summary cards provide an instant snapshot of your marketplace's financial obligations and commission earnings:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-overview.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-overview.png" alt="Vendors Payout Overview and Metrics Cards" /></a>

| Metric Card | Value Display | Business Meaning & Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Payable Withdrawals** | Integer Count (e.g., `9`) | Total number of withdrawal requests submitted by sellers currently in pending review. |
| **Unpaid Payout Amount** | Formatted Currency (e.g., `$5,646.72`) | Total monetary sum of funds owed to marketplace vendors across all pending withdrawal requests. |
| **Total Commission Earned** | Formatted Currency (e.g., `$881.63`) | Cumulative commission revenue earned by the marketplace platform on the orders associated with pending payouts. |
| **Unpaid Vendors** | Ratio (e.g., `8 / 8`) | Number of individual sellers who have pending payout requests compared to the total active vendors in the marketplace. |

### Dynamic Recalculation
- **Real-Time Recalculation**: When an administrator clicks **Pay Now** or applies the bulk **Mark as Paid** action, the stat cards automatically recalculate in the background.
- **Smooth Loading**: When switching filters or querying specific IDs, placeholder skeletons keep the page layout stable.

## Dimension 2: Multi-Filter & Search Controls

The filter bar is positioned between the summary cards and the payout data table. It gives administrators full control to locate and audit specific payout entries:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-filters.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-filters.png" alt="Vendors Payout Filter Bar Breakdown" /></a>

### Filter Controls Overview

| Control | Input Type | Available Options | How It Works |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bulk Actions** | Dropdown Selector | `Bulk actions`, `Mark as Paid`, `Export CSV` | Prepares a batch operation for selected rows. The **Apply** button activates once at least one row checkbox is ticked. |
| **Filter by Vendor** | Dropdown Selector | `Filter by Vendor` (All) + Alphabetical vendor list | Dynamically lists only those marketplace vendors who currently have pending withdrawal requests. Selecting a vendor isolates their records. |
| **Status Filter** | Dropdown Selector | `Pending` (default), `Paid`, `All` | • **Pending**: Isolates actionable requests awaiting payment.<br>• **Paid**: Shows settled historical payouts.<br>• **All**: Displays complete payout logs. |
| **Date Preset Filter** | Dropdown Selector | `All` (default), `Today`, `Last 7 days`, `Last 30 days`, `This month` | Filters payout records by request submission date. |
| **Filter Button** | Primary Button | *Submit* | Applies the chosen vendor, status, and date filters, resetting the table to Page 1. |
| **Search by Withdrawal ID** | Text Input + Button | Numeric ID (e.g., `7`, `13`, `22`) | Allows instant numerical lookup of an exact withdrawal request ID. |

### Common Filter Combinations

- **Reviewing Month-End Obligations**: Select **Status: Pending** and **Date Preset: This month**, then click **Filter**.
- **Auditing a Single Vendor's Full History**: Select the vendor name from **Filter by Vendor** and set **Status: All**, then click **Filter**.
- **Investigating a Specific Transaction**: Enter the exact withdrawal number into **Search by Withdrawal Id** and click **Search**.

## Dimension 3: Bulk Actions (Batch Operations)

To manage high volumes of withdrawal requests quickly, administrators can execute batch settlements and generate accounting exports with a single click.

### 1. Bulk Mark as Paid Workflow

When funds have been transferred offline or through scheduled bank payment files to multiple vendors:

1. **Select Records**: Check the boxes next to the withdrawal requests you want to clear. Check the header checkbox to select all visible rows.
2. **Choose Action**: Select **Mark as Paid** from the bulk actions dropdown.
3. **Click Apply**: The **Apply** button becomes clickable.
4. **Confirm Dialog**: A confirmation modal displays the number of selected withdrawals and the combined total amount:
   ```text
   Pay {N} withdrawals totaling ${total}?
   ```
5. **Batch Processing**: Confirming the prompt updates all selected records to `Paid`, records matching financial ledger entries, recalculates the metric cards, and displays a success notification confirming how many payouts were settled.

### 2. Bulk CSV Export Workflow

For external bookkeeping, tax preparation, or spreadsheet reconciliations:

1. **Select Records**: Select the desired rows, or filter the table by date range or vendor.
2. **Choose Action**: Choose **Export CSV** from the bulk dropdown.
3. **Click Apply**: The system compiles the selected payout data.
4. **Instant Download**: A formatted `.csv` file downloads automatically to your computer.

## Dimension 4: Payout Data Table & Column Structure

The central table displays all withdrawal requests with clear, sortable financial columns:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-paid-records.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-paid-records.png" alt="Vendors Payout Historical Paid Records" /></a>

### Table Column Directory

| Column Header | Data Format | Sortable | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Checkbox]** | Checkbox Control | No | Selects rows for bulk settlement or CSV export. |
| **Withdrawal Id** | Numeric ID | Yes | Unique reference number assigned to the withdrawal request. |
| **Date ↓** | Date & Time | Yes (Default Desc) | Exact timestamp (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`) when the vendor requested the withdrawal. |
| **Vendor Name** | Text / Link | Yes | Registered shop name of the seller requesting payout (e.g., *Volt & Vine*, *Lumen Beauty*). |
| **Product Total** | Currency (`$X.XX`) | No | Gross item sales total for the orders included in this payout request. |
| **Tax** | Currency (`$X.XX`) | No | Total tax collected on the vendor's items. |
| **Shipping** | Currency (`$X.XX`) | No | Total shipping charge allocated to the seller for order fulfillment. |
| **Total Commission** | `$X.XX (Y%)` | No | Marketplace commission retained by the platform, showing both the currency amount and rate (e.g., `$113.20 (10%)`). |
| **Total Amt** | Currency (`$X.XX`) | Yes | **Net payable amount** due to the seller after deducting commissions and adding eligible shipping/tax: `(Product Total + Shipping + Tax) - Commission`. |
| **Payment Mode** | Badge / Label | No | Payout method requested by the seller: `bank` (Bank Transfer), `paypal` (PayPal), or `upi` (Unified Payments Interface). |
| **Withdrawal** | Status Badge | No | Visual status indicator:<br>• `<span class="wkmp-status-badge is-pending">Requested</span>` (Pending)<br>• `<span class="wkmp-status-badge is-paid">Paid</span>` (Settled) |
| **Action** | Button / Label | No | • If Pending: Displays a blue **Pay Now** button.<br>• If Paid: Displays a muted, disabled **Paid** badge. |

### Table Navigation & Pagination
- **Total Count Indicator**: Shows the total number of records matching the current filter (e.g., `9 items`).
- **Pagination Controls**: Provides `‹ Prev`, current page indicator (`1 / 1`), and `Next ›` buttons for easy navigation across large transaction archives.

## Dimension 5: Individual Payout Workflow (Pay Now)

When handling payouts individually, administrators can review each request with an explicit confirmation step before committing the ledger update.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-confirm-modal.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-payout-confirm-modal.png" alt="Confirm Payment Modal Dialog" /></a>

### Step-by-Step Walkthrough

1. **Locate Request**: Under the `Pending` filter, locate the vendor's withdrawal row.
2. **Click Pay Now**: Click the primary blue **Pay Now** button in the Action column.
3. **Review Confirm Payment Dialog**: A modal dialog appears containing exact transaction details:
   ```text
   Confirm payment
   Pay $998.42 to Volt & Vine via bank?
   ```
4. **Confirm or Cancel**:
   - Click **Cancel** (or the close `✕` icon) to dismiss the dialog without making changes.
   - Click **Pay Now** to proceed with settlement.
5. **Settlement Confirmation**:
   - The status badge updates immediately from **Requested** to **Paid**.
   - The action button changes to a disabled **Paid** indicator.
   - A success notification confirms: `Withdrawal #N paid`.
   - The summary metric cards at the top dynamically recalculate.

::: note Record-Only Payout Clarification
The Vendors Payout Management dashboard serves as the administrative settlement ledger. Clicking **Pay Now** or **Mark as Paid** updates the marketplace ledger, deducts the seller's available balance, and flags the withdrawal as settled. Administrators should execute the actual monetary transfer through their external banking portal, PayPal account, or UPI interface as indicated by the vendor's chosen **Payment Mode**.
:::

---

## Dimension 6: Payout Lifecycle & Commission Settlement

Vendor funds progress through a clear lifecycle from customer purchase to final disbursement:

### Payout Lifecycle Stages

1. **Customer Places Order**:
   - The buyer checks out on the storefront.
   - Payment is captured in the marketplace administrator's payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, offline transfer).

2. **Order Marked as Completed**:
   - The marketplace commission is automatically calculated and recorded in the commission ledger.
   - The vendor's net earnings are added to their available marketplace balance.

3. **Vendor Submits Withdrawal Request**:
   - The seller initiates a withdrawal from their seller dashboard using an approved payout method (Bank, PayPal, or UPI).
   - A new request appears in the admin dashboard with the status **Requested** (Pending).

4. **Admin Review in Vendors Payout**:
   - The administrator inspects the order totals, tax, shipping, and commission fee.
   - The administrator verifies the vendor's payout credentials.

5. **External Disbursement & Settlement**:
   - The administrator transfers the funds via the requested payment method (external bank wire, PayPal, or UPI).
   - The administrator clicks **Pay Now** (or uses **Mark as Paid** for batches).
   - The status changes to **Paid**, updating the marketplace ledger and finalizing the seller's balance.

::: tip Net Payout Calculation Formula
**Net Vendor Payout (`Total Amt`)** = `(Product Total + Eligible Shipping + Eligible Tax) − Admin Commission`

- **Product Total**: Gross sales value of the vendor's line items.
- **Admin Commission**: Platform fee configured under [Commission Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/commission-management.html).
- **Shipping & Tax**: Distributed according to the marketplace's configured shipping and tax policies.
:::

---

## Dimension 7: Exported CSV Schema Specification

When clicking **Export CSV**, the generated spreadsheet contains complete financial and operational fields for your records:

| CSV Column Header | Example Data | Field Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Withdrawal ID` | `7` | Unique reference number of the withdrawal. |
| `Date` | `2026-10-04 09:12:00` | Timestamp when the withdrawal was submitted. |
| `Seller Name` | `Volt & Vine` | Display name of the marketplace seller. |
| `Product Total` | `$1132.00` | Gross subtotal of products sold in the associated orders. |
| `Tax` | `$0.00` | Tax allocated to the vendor. |
| `Shipping` | `$0.00` | Shipping fees allocated to the vendor. |
| `Total Commission` | `$113.20 (10%)` | Admin marketplace commission fee deducted. |
| `Total Amount` | `$998.42` | Net amount disbursed to the seller. |
| `Payment Mode` | `bank` | Requested payment method (`bank`, `paypal`, `upi`). |
| `Status` | `pending` / `paid` | Current fulfillment status of the withdrawal record. |


- Admin receives notifications for key marketplace actions, including:
  - New orders
  - Order status changes
  - Product creation or updates
  - Product approval requests
  - Vendor-related activities

## Notification Area

- All notifications are displayed in the **admin notification area**.
- Notifications help the admin take quick actions without navigating through multiple sections.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications.webp"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications.webp" alt="Admin Notifications" /></a>

### Administrative Interface Structure

The Admin Notifications interface consists of three primary functional zones:

1. **Top Header & Tab Bar**: Displays the notification bell icon, page title, and primary navigation buttons (**Orders**, **Product**, **Vendor**).
2. **Sub-Navigation Filter Bar** *(Orders Tab)*: A sub-filter bar (`subsubsub`) that isolates orders by lifecycle state (**All**, **Processing**, **Completed**).
3. **Notification Activity Feed**: An ordered list (`.mp-notification-list`) displaying each notification item with hyperlinks, contextual descriptions, and relative time counters.
4. **Pagination Navigation Bar**: A standard pagination bar (`.mp-notification-pagination`) allowing store administrators to page through older records.

- **Products**
  - New product added by vendor

  - Order status updated
- **Vendors**
  - Vendor registration
  - Vendor-related updates

## Tab 1: Orders Notifications (`tab=orders`)

The **Orders** tab is the default landing screen of the Admin Notifications module (`page=wk-marketplace-notifications`). It records every vital order-related transaction across the marketplace.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications-orders.png"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications-orders.png" alt="Admin Notifications - Orders Tab Dashboard" /></a>

### Sub-Filter Sections

The Orders tab provides sub-filters to narrow down high-volume order feeds:

| Filter Name | Query Parameter | What It Displays |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **All** | `section=all` *(Default)* | Displays all order events in reverse chronological order, including new order placements, status changes to processing, completion events, and refund updates. |
| **Processing** | `section=processing` | Filters the feed exclusively for orders whose status transitioned to **Processing** (e.g., successful payment received). |
| **Completed** | `section=completed` | Filters the feed exclusively for orders whose status transitioned to **Completed** (e.g., packages dispatched or fulfilled). |

#### Processing Section View

When clicking **Processing**, the system filters the table to show orders requiring fulfillment or currently in preparation:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications-orders-processing.png"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications-orders-processing.png" alt="Admin Notifications - Orders Processing Filter" /></a>

#### Completed Section View

When clicking **Completed**, the admin can review all orders that reached terminal fulfillment:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications-orders-completed.png"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications-orders-completed.png" alt="Admin Notifications - Orders Completed Filter" /></a>

### Order Notification Message Formats

Each order notification row contains structured information:

| Notification Trigger | Event Text Format | Target URL / Drilldown |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **New Customer Order** | `#<Order_ID> Order has been placed by <Customer_Name> <X> days ago.` | Opens the WooCommerce Order Edit screen (`wp-admin/post.php?post=<ID>&action=edit` or HPOS equivalent) in a new browser tab. |
| **Status to Processing** | `#<Order_ID> Order status has been changed to Processing <X> days ago.` | Opens the WooCommerce Order Edit screen in a new browser tab. |
| **Status to Completed** | `#<Order_ID> Order status has been changed to Completed <X> days ago.` | Opens the WooCommerce Order Edit screen in a new browser tab. |
| **Order Refunded** | `#<Order_ID> Order status has been changed to Refunded <X> days ago.` | Opens the WooCommerce Order Edit screen in a new browser tab. |

## Tab 2: Product Notifications (`tab=product`)

The **Product** tab tracks inventory milestones, catalog approvals, and product updates submitted by marketplace vendors.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-notifications-product-tab.png"><img src="./assets/admin-notifications-product-tab.png" alt="Admin Notifications - Product Tab Dashboard" /></a>

### Product Notification Formats

| Notification Type | Trigger Event | Display Format | Admin Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Product Approval** | Vendor product status transitions from pending/draft to published | `#<Product_Title> has been approved <X> days ago.` | Clicking `#<Product_Title>` opens the WooCommerce Product editor in a new tab. |
| **Product Rejection** | Admin rejects a vendor's submitted product | `#<Product_Title> has been rejected by the admin. Open the product to see the reason.` | Informs admin and vendor of the rejection event. |
| **Deleted Product Fallback** | Product was approved but later permanently deleted from WooCommerce | `#(deleted-item) has been approved <X> days ago.` | Safely displays historical record without broken links (links to `#`). |
| **Low Stock Alert** | Product inventory falls below the WooCommerce low stock threshold | `Product is low in stock. There are <Qty> left <X> days ago.` | Alerts admin to restock or remind vendor to update quantity. |

---

## Pagination & Display Configuration

The Admin Notifications list table includes a built-in pagination control at the bottom of the feed:

- **Pagination URL Parameter**: `n-page=<number>` (e.g., `admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-notifications&n-page=2`).
- **Items Per Page**: The number of notifications displayed per page is controlled by the standard WordPress setting:
  - Navigate to **Settings > Reading** in your WordPress dashboard.
  - Locate **Blog pages show at most**.
  - Update the numeric value (default is `10` items).

---

## Admin vs. Vendor Notification Comparison

The WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace distinguishes between the administrative notification center and the seller dashboard notification area:

| Feature Dimension | Admin Notification Center | Vendor / Seller Notification Area |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Location** | WordPress Admin (`Marketplace > Notifications`) | Front-end Vendor Dashboard or Separate Vendor Backend (`/seller/notifications/`) |
| **Visibility Scope** | **Global**: Oversees all vendors, all orders, all customer reviews, and all catalog items marketplace-wide. | **Restricted**: Only displays notifications where `author_id` matches the logged-in seller. |
| **Read Status Tracking** | Acts as an immutable historical activity log; records remain visible for auditing. | Includes read/unread tracking (`read_flag = 0` vs `1`) with unread badge counters. |
| **Action Drilldowns** | Links to native WordPress/WooCommerce admin post editor screens (`wp-admin/post.php?post=<ID>&action=edit`). | Links to vendor-facing order views and vendor product management screens. |

---

This system ensures the admin stays updated on all **critical marketplace events** and can manage operations efficiently.

- Helps maintain review quality and build customer trust.

### Navigation Path

- Product name
- Rating

- Approval status

## Admin Navigation & Access

- **Screen Title**: **Manage Feedback**
- **Direct Admin URL**:
  ```text
  https://your-domain.com/wp-admin/admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-feedback
  ```
- **User Access**: Available to Marketplace Administrators and authorized Store Managers.

::: tip Fast Navigation
Bookmark the **Reviews & Rating** page in your browser for quick access when conducting routine customer feedback moderation and vendor reputation audits.
:::

---

## Multi-Dimensional Rating Criteria (Each Dimension Explained)

Rather than relying on a single, generalized star rating, the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace evaluates vendor reputation using a **three-dimensional rating framework**. When a customer submits a store review, they rate the vendor across three distinct performance aspects:

```
                          ┌───────────────────────────┐
                          │   Customer Store Review   │
                          └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                                        │
           ┌────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┐
           ▼                            ▼                            ▼
  ┌─────────────────┐          ┌─────────────────┐          ┌─────────────────┐
  │  Price Rating   │          │  Value Rating   │          │ Quality Rating  │
  │     (1 to 5)    │          │     (1 to 5)    │          │     (1 to 5)    │
  └────────┬────────┘          └────────┬────────┘          └────────┬────────┘
           │                            │                            │
           └────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┘
                                        ▼
                          ┌───────────────────────────┐
                          │   Overall Seller Score    │
                          │ (Price + Value + Quality) │
                          │ ───────────────────────── │
                          │             3             │
                          └───────────────────────────┘
```

### 1. Dimension 1: Price Rating (Price)
- **Scoring Range**: 1 to 5 Stars
- **Evaluation Scope**: Measures buyer satisfaction regarding pricing fairness, competitive rates, and affordability relative to comparable products on the marketplace.
- **Admin Display**: Rendered as a score out of 5 (e.g., `5/5`, `4/5`).

### 2. Dimension 2: Value Rating (Value)
- **Scoring Range**: 1 to 5 Stars
- **Evaluation Scope**: Measures the perceived value-for-money delivered by the vendor. It assesses whether the purchased goods fulfilled customer expectations for the price paid.
- **Admin Display**: Rendered as a score out of 5 (e.g., `5/5`, `4/5`).

### 3. Dimension 3: Quality Rating (Quality)
- **Scoring Range**: 1 to 5 Stars
- **Evaluation Scope**: Assesses product craftsmanship, material condition, packaging care, and match with the listed product description.
- **Admin Display**: Rendered as a score out of 5 (e.g., `5/5`, `3/5`).

### Overall Vendor Rating Calculation

The marketplace calculates the vendor's overall storefront score by averaging all three approved criteria:

$$\text{Overall Vendor Rating} = \frac{\text{Average Price} + \text{Average Value} + \text{Average Quality}}{3}$$

- **Automatic Recalculation**: The overall score updates automatically whenever an administrator approves or disapproves reviews in the moderation queue.
- **Storefront Display**: The calculated average is presented as star graphics on the vendor's public store banner, vendor badge, and customer-facing store profile.

---

## Review Management Table Columns & Reference

The **Manage Feedback** table organizes customer reviews into a clear, structured view. Below is a detailed breakdown of every column displayed on the screen:

| Column Header | Display Format | Description & Functional Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Checkbox** | Selection Checkbox | Selects one or more reviews for bulk actions (Approve, Disapprove, or Delete). Use the top header checkbox to select all reviews on the page. |
| **Shop Name** | Hyperlinked Text | Displays the vendor's shop name and vendor ID (e.g., **Aurora Athletics (#2)**). Clicking the link opens the vendor details page. Displays `(Deleted Shop)` if the vendor account was removed. |
| **Given By** | Customer Name | The name of the registered customer who submitted the review. |
| **Value** | Score (`X/5`) | The star rating given for the store's value-for-money out of 5 stars. |
| **Price** | Score (`X/5`) | The star rating given for pricing fairness and affordability out of 5 stars. |
| **Quality** | Score (`X/5`) | The star rating given for product craftsmanship and packaging out of 5 stars. |
| **Summary** | Text Headline | The short review title or headline summary entered by the customer (e.g., *"Great maker to buy from"*, *"Will order again"*). |
| **Description** | Text + Preview Link | The detailed customer feedback text. Longer messages show a **`... See More`** link to view the complete comments in a popup window. |
| **Status** | Status Badge | The current review status:<br>• **Approved**: Published live on the vendor's public shop profile.<br>• **Disapproved**: Hidden from public view; does not affect the seller's score.<br>• **Pending**: Newly submitted review awaiting admin moderation.<br>*(Click the column header to sort reviews by status).* |
| **Date Created** | Date & Time | The date and time when the customer submitted the review (e.g., `August 10, 2026 10:26 am`). *(Click the column header to sort reviews chronologically).* |

---

## Detailed Review Inspection (Modal Preview)

To keep the table easy to read and browse, customer review descriptions are presented cleanly:

- **Short Reviews (10 words or fewer)**: Display in full directly inside the **Description** column.
- **Longer Reviews (more than 10 words)**: Automatically truncate with a **`... See More`** link.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/manage-feedback-modal.webp"><img src="./assets/manage-feedback-modal.webp" alt="Review Description Modal Preview" /></a>

### How the Preview Works

1. Click **`... See More`** on any truncated review.
2. A popup window opens directly on your screen titled **"Review Description"**.
3. Read the complete, unabridged customer commentary to verify compliance with store guidelines without leaving the page or losing your place.
4. Close the window using the <kbd>✕</kbd> button or by pressing <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

---

## Searching, Sorting, and Filtering Feedback

The feedback screen includes search and sorting tools to help administrators quickly find and manage customer reviews:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/manage-feedback-search-filter.webp"><img src="./assets/manage-feedback-search-filter.webp" alt="Feedback Search and Filters" /></a>

### 1. Keyword Search by Summary
Located in the upper-right corner of the table:
- **Search Box**: Type keywords into the **Search By Summary** field (such as *"quality"*, *"shipping"*, or *"service"*).
- **Find Results**: Click **Search** to filter the list and display only reviews containing those terms in their headline summary.

### 2. Status Column Sorting
The **Status** column header is interactive:
- Click **Status** to group and sort reviews by approval state (**Approved**, **Disapproved**, or **Pending**).
- Clicking again reverses the order, making it easy to bring all pending reviews to the top for quick moderation.

### 3. Date Created Sorting
The **Date Created** column header is interactive:
- Click **Date Created** to switch between newest-first and oldest-first view.
- This helps you quickly inspect the latest incoming customer feedback or check older records.

---

## Bulk Moderation Workflow & Administrative Actions

Administrators can moderate reviews individually or in batches using the bulk action menu.

### Step-by-Step Moderation Procedure

1. **Select Reviews**: Check the boxes next to the reviews you want to moderate, or click the header checkbox to select all visible rows.
2. **Choose Action**: Open the **Bulk actions** dropdown selector at the top or bottom of the table:
   - **Approve**: Approves selected reviews. Approved reviews appear immediately on the vendor's storefront profile and contribute to their average rating.
   - **Disapprove**: Disapproves selected reviews. Disapproved reviews are hidden from the storefront and excluded from the vendor's public rating.
   - **Delete**: Permanently removes selected reviews from your marketplace.
3. **Apply**: Click the **Apply** button next to the dropdown menu.

### System Notices

The screen displays a clear confirmation notice after each action:

| Action Taken | Notice Style | Confirmation Message |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Reviews Approved** | Success (Green) | `Feedback has been approved successfully.` |
| **Reviews Disapproved** | Success (Green) | `Feedback has been disapproved successfully.` |
| **Reviews Deleted** | Success (Green) | `Feedback has been deleted successfully.` |
| **No Rows Selected** | Alert (Red) | `Please select atleast one feedback.` |

::: warning Permanent Action
Deleting a review permanently removes it from your marketplace and cannot be undone. If you only want to hide a review from customers, choose **Disapprove** instead.
:::

---

## Storefront & Seller Integration Flow

Customer feedback submitted across the marketplace connects the storefront and vendor experience:

### 1. Customer Review Submission
- Customers visit the vendor's public store profile on the marketplace storefront.
- Under the **Write your review** section, buyers rate their experience:
  - Choose 1 to 5 stars for **Price**.
  - Choose 1 to 5 stars for **Value**.
  - Choose 1 to 5 stars for **Quality**.
  - Add a short review **Summary**.
  - Enter full feedback comments in the review **Description**.
- Once submitted, the review enters your admin moderation list with **Pending** status.

### 2. Moderation Gatekeeper
- Customer reviews remain hidden from the public store until approved.
- Only reviews approved by the administrator appear on the vendor's public **Shop Reviews** tab.

### 3. Vendor Dashboard Visibility
- Vendors can view their approved customer reviews directly from their **Vendor Dashboard**.
- Vendors cannot edit or remove customer feedback, keeping ratings honest, balanced, and transparent.
- High star ratings build buyer trust and help vendors grow their store reputation.

---

## Best Practices for Feedback Moderation

To maintain a credible and trustworthy multi-vendor marketplace:

1. **Review Regularly**: Check the feedback moderation screen regularly so genuine customer reviews are published without long delays.
2. **Stay Fair and Objective**: Only disapprove reviews that violate marketplace rules (such as spam, offensive language, or false claims). Honest customer opinions help shoppers make better buying choices.
3. **Monitor Low Scores**: If a vendor consistently receives low scores in Price or Quality, reach out to help them improve their products, pricing, or shipping standards.
4. **Boost Store Visibility**: Verified reviews provide helpful details for shoppers and boost search engine visibility for vendor stores.

---

## Summary – Marketplace Reviews & Ratings

- Centralized control over customer reviews and ratings
- Approval-based visibility ensures quality content
- Vendors can view feedback related to their products
- Improves marketplace transparency and credibility

- Click the **Reply** button against a specific query.
- The response is sent to the vendor for further communication or clarification.
- **Threaded View**: Both the vendor and admin can view the entire back-and-forth conversation as a threaded chat history to easily track the context of the issue.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-answered-to-query.png"><img src="./assets/admin-answered-to-query.png" alt="Admin Answered to Query Thread" /></a>

## Summary – Vendor Queries Management

- Vendors can communicate directly with the admin
- Admin can view and manage all vendor queries from a single location
- Enables faster resolution of vendor issues
- Improves vendor–admin communication within the marketplace

## Admin Navigation & Console Access

Marketplace administrators and store managers can access the vendor query helpdesk directly from the WordPress administration menu:

- **Menu Route**: **Marketplace → Queries**
- **Screen Heading**: **Queries List**
- **Direct Admin URL**:
  ```text
  https://your-domain.com/wp-admin/admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-queries
  ```
- **Authorized Roles**: Administrator, Store Manager, or custom administrative staff with Marketplace capabilities.

::: tip Fast Daily Triage
Bookmark the **Marketplace → Queries** URL in your web browser. Setting up a morning and afternoon triage routine ensures all newly opened vendor questions receive timely responses within your platform's target SLA (Service Level Agreement).
:::

## Query Lifecycle & Communication Flow

The marketplace provides a two-way ticketing system connecting the vendor front office with the admin back office. The flowchart below illustrates the complete lifecycle of a vendor inquiry from submission to resolution:

```
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │       Vendor (Seller Dashboard)        │
    │  Submits query via "Ask to Admin" tab  │
    └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │       Automated Email Dispatch         │
    │    Admin receives alert notification   │
    └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │      Marketplace → Queries List        │
    │  Query appears with status: "Open"     │
    └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │    Admin Clicks "View & Reply"         │
    │  Interactive ThickBox modal opens with │
    │    complete message thread history     │
    └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │      Admin Types Message & Sends       │
    │ • Reply added to conversation thread   │
    │ • Status updates to "Answered"         │
    │ • Last Reply timestamp refreshed       │
    │ • Notification sent to vendor          │
    └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │          Vendor Follow-up              │
    │ Vendor reads answer; can reply further │
    │ or consider the inquiry resolved       │
    └────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Query Status Views & Filter Dimensions

The queries console organizes vendor communications into three distinct status tabs located above the data table. Each tab provides an immediate count badge displaying the total number of inquiries in that state.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-queries-all-view.png"><img src="./assets/admin-queries-all-view.png" alt="All Queries List View" /></a>

### Status Tabs Breakdown

| Tab Label | URL Parameter & Route | Status Filter | Purpose & Operational Scope |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **All** | `admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-queries` | All records | Displays the complete chronological record of all vendor inquiries regardless of their current resolution state. |
| **Answered** | `admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-queries&status=answered` | `status=answered` | Displays all inquiries where the administrator has submitted an official response to the vendor. |
| **Open** | `admin.php?page=wk-marketplace-queries&status=open` | `status=open` | Filters exclusively for pending inquiries that require an administrator's attention and response. |

### 1. Open Queries View (`status=open`)

The **Open** tab is the primary operational queue for support staff. It isolates active vendor requests that are waiting for an initial response or follow-up clarification.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-queries-open-view.png"><img src="./assets/admin-queries-open-view.png" alt="Open Queries View" /></a>

- **Key Objective**: Identify pending questions quickly without scrolling through resolved conversations.
- **Priority Indicator**: Inquiries listed here have not received a response since the vendor's last message.
- **Action**: Click **View & Reply** to inspect the vendor's query and send an answer.

### 2. Answered Queries View (`status=answered`)

The **Answered** tab maintains a historical log of all inquiries where an administrator has already replied.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-queries-answered-view.png"><img src="./assets/admin-queries-answered-view.png" alt="Answered Queries View" /></a>

- **Key Objective**: Review past answers, verify commitments made to merchants, and reference previous guidance on store policies or technical settings.
- **Continuous Conversation**: Administrators can still open any answered query via **View & Reply** to append additional notes or provide further clarification.

---

## Table Columns & Field Reference

The Queries table displays comprehensive metadata for each inquiry, allowing administrators to assess urgency and context at a glance.

| Column Header | Database / Attribute Key | Sortable | Description & Behavioral Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Checkbox** | `cb` (`Select All`) | No | Checkbox used to select individual or multiple query records for bulk deletion. |
| **Vendor** | `seller` (`column-seller`) | No | Displays the public store name of the vendor who submitted the inquiry (e.g., *Aurora Athletics*, *Maison Terra*, *Volt & Vine*). |
| **Date Created** | `date_created` | **Yes** (Asc / Desc) | The date and time when the vendor first submitted the query ticket. Click the column header to toggle ascending or descending order. |
| **Subject** | `subject` | **Yes** (Asc / Desc) | The subject title entered by the vendor summarizing the issue (e.g., *Vacation dates not showing on my store page*, *Shipping rates for EU orders*). |
| **Message** | `message` | No | A preview excerpt of the inquiry body text providing immediate context without opening the ticket modal. |
| **Last Reply** | `last_reply` (`last_reply_at`) | **Yes** (Asc / Desc) | Timestamp indicating when the most recent response was posted by either the vendor or administrator. Useful for tracking conversation recency. |
| **Status** | `status` | No | Resolution badge indicating either **Open** (unanswered / awaiting admin action) or **Answered** (admin has responded). |
| **Action** | `action` | No | Contains the **View & Reply** primary button that launches the interactive conversation modal dialog. |

---

## Search, Filtering & Sorting Tools

To handle high volumes of vendor correspondence across large multi-vendor catalogs, the interface provides targeted search, sorting, and bulk management controls.

### 1. Subject Search Filter

The search bar is located at the top right of the data table:

- **Input Field**: Text box with placeholder `Search by subject` (`input[name="s"]`).
- **Execution**: Enter any keyword or phrase contained in query subjects and click **Search by subject** (or press <kbd>Enter</kbd>).
- **URL Parameter**: Appends `&s=your_keyword` to the current admin URL, maintaining any active status filter tab.
- **Use Case**: Quickly find past inquiries regarding specific topics such as "shipping", "commission", "payout", "vacation", or "tax".

### 2. Multi-Column Sorting

Administrators can sort table rows dynamically by clicking the hyperlinked headers:

- **Sort by Date Created**: Orders records by submission timestamp (`orderby=date_created&order=asc|desc`).
- **Sort by Subject**: Sorts records alphabetically by inquiry subject line (`orderby=subject&order=asc|desc`).
- **Sort by Last Reply**: Orders records by the most recently updated conversation (`orderby=last_reply_at&order=asc|desc`), ensuring recent vendor replies are reviewed first.

### 3. Bulk Actions (Delete)

The interface includes a bulk action mechanism at both the top and bottom of the table:

1. Select one or more queries using the row checkboxes, or click the **Select All** checkbox in the table header.
2. Open the **Bulk actions** dropdown selector.
3. Choose **Delete**.
4. Click **Apply** to permanently remove selected inquiries from the database.

::: warning Irreversible Deletion
Deleting a query permanently removes the ticket record and its entire back-and-forth conversation history from both the admin console and the vendor's dashboard. Ensure that resolved issues are retained if you require audit trails for vendor compliance.
:::

---

## Interactive Query Detail & Reply Modal (ThickBox)

When an administrator clicks the **View & Reply** button on any query row, the system launches an interactive WordPress ThickBox modal window (`#TB_inline?width=1100&height=720&inlineId=meta-box-[id]`). This allows full review and response without leaving the queries list page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-query-thread-modal.png"><img src="./assets/admin-query-thread-modal.png" alt="Interactive Query Thread and Reply Modal" /></a>

### Elements of the Query Modal

The modal dialog is structured into three clean functional zones:

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  [Subject Title]                                   with [Vendor Name]  │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐      │
│  │ [Vendor Store Name]                 October 4, 2026 3:12 pm  │      │
│  │ I set my closure for 28 September to 9 October...            │      │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘      │
│                                                                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐      │
│  │ Admin                               October 5, 2026 9:40 am  │      │
│  │ The banner you are seeing on the product page is tied to...  │      │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘      │
│                                                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Reply Message                                                         │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Type your response to the vendor here...                         │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  [ Send Reply ]                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### 1. Header Bar
- **Subject Heading**: Highlights the exact query subject submitted by the vendor.
- **Vendor Attribution**: Displays the vendor's store name (e.g., `with Maison Terra`) confirming the communication partner.

#### 2. Thread Message Stream
- **Chronological History**: All messages exchanged between the vendor and administration are listed chronologically from top to bottom.
- **Vendor Messages (`.wkmp-msg-seller`)**: Left-aligned conversation bubbles showing the vendor's shop name, submission timestamp, and message body.
- **Admin Messages (`.wkmp-msg-admin`)**: Formatted reply bubbles indicating **Admin**, the response timestamp, and the exact guidance provided.

#### 3. Reply Composer Box
- **Textarea (`Reply Message`)**: A multi-line text input field where administrators compose their message to the seller.
- **Send Reply Button (`.seller-query-revert`)**: Submitting the reply instantly:
  - Appends the message to the conversation thread.
  - Updates the ticket's resolution status to **Answered**.
  - Refreshes the `Last Reply` timestamp in the list table.
  - Triggers an email alert to the vendor's registered contact address.

---

## Vendor-Side Integration: "Ask to Admin"

Vendors interact with this communication channel directly from their merchant dashboard without needing access to the WordPress admin panel:

1. **Access Point**: The merchant logs into their storefront account and navigates to **Seller Dashboard → Ask to Admin**.
2. **Raising a Query**: The vendor clicks **Add**, enters an inquiry **Subject**, types their message into the query box, and clicks **Ask**.
3. **Tracking Responses**: The vendor's dashboard displays a history of all questions asked, their current status, and full threaded responses from the marketplace administrator.
4. **Follow-Up Questions**: If the vendor needs additional clarification after reading the admin's answer, they can submit another message in the same thread.

For comprehensive vendor-facing instructions, refer to the [Ask to Admin User Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/ask-to-admin.html).

---

## Automated Email Notifications

The query system is integrated with the marketplace's automated email notification engine to keep both administrators and merchants informed of ticket activity:

- **New Query Raised by Vendor**: When a merchant submits a new ticket through "Ask to Admin", the platform sends an automated notification email to the marketplace administrator containing the vendor name, subject, and question summary.
- **Admin Reply Dispatched**: When the admin clicks **Send Reply** in the modal dialog, an email notification is immediately dispatched to the vendor's registered email address with the administrator's reply text and a link to view the thread.

::: note Email Template Customization
Administrators can configure sender names, email headers, and notification settings under **WooCommerce → Settings → Emails** and the marketplace's [Email Configurations](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/email-configurations.html) panel.
:::

---

## Best Practices for Query Management

To maintain high merchant satisfaction and ensure operational efficiency across your marketplace:

1. **Daily SLA Adherence**: Check the **Open** tab at least twice daily. Aim to resolve standard inquiries within 24 business hours.
2. **Clear & Actionable Guidance**: When answering questions regarding marketplace policies, include direct links to relevant documentation pages (such as commission structures, shipping setups, or payout schedules).
3. **Categorize by Subject**: When composing replies, encourage vendors to use specific subjects (e.g., "Payout Issue - Order #1042" instead of generic words like "help") to simplify future reference.
4. **Periodic Queue Cleanup**: Use the bulk delete tool quarterly to purge obsolete, resolved conversations after verifying that financial and compliance data has been recorded.

# Admin News

The **Admin News** feature allows the admin to create and publish news updates for vendors.
Admins can also control the **visibility of news for sellers** based on marketplace requirements.

Through this module, marketplace administrators can broadcast critical announcements, policy updates, fee revisions, scheduled maintenance alerts, and seasonal campaign guidelines directly to vendor dashboards.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/all-news.webp"><img src="./assets/all-news.webp" alt="All News List" /></a>

---

## Access Path

Marketplace administrators can access the Admin News module directly from the WordPress administrative dashboard:

- **Marketplace → Admin News**

From this section, administrators can configure global news visibility settings, manage existing announcements, and create new posts for vendors.

---

## Admin News Settings

When navigating to **Marketplace → Admin News**, the administrator lands on the **Admin News Settings** configuration page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-news-settings-live.png"><img src="./assets/admin-news-settings-live.png" alt="Admin News Settings" /></a>

### Quick Action Header Buttons

At the top of the settings page, two primary action buttons provide instant navigation:

- **See All News**: Opens the complete news management list to view published, draft, and trashed news.
- **Add a New News**: Opens the announcement creation screen to write a new news article.

---

### Configuration Fields

The settings form allows administrators to manage news visibility across the entire vendor base:

| Setting Field | Field Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hide News from Vendors** | Multi-select dropdown | None | Select specific vendors who should **not** see the news section on their vendor dashboard. |
| **Show news to Vendors** | Dropdown | From last 30 days | Define the historical date range of news visible on vendor dashboards. |
| **Select the custom date** | Date picker | None | Visible only when "From a custom date" is chosen. Specifies an exact cutoff date. |

#### 1. Hide News from Vendors
- Uses a searchable multi-select dropdown listing all registered marketplace vendors.
- Allows administrators to exclude specific vendor accounts from accessing the Admin News section entirely.
- Selected vendors will not see the news section or announcements on their dashboard.
- Helpful when running targeted news campaigns or restricting communication to specific vendor tiers.

#### 2. Show news to Vendors
- Controls how far back vendors can see published announcements.
- Available duration presets:
  - **From last 7 days**: Displays only news published within the past week.
  - **From last 30 days** *(Default)*: Displays news published within the past month.
  - **From last 3 months**: Extends visibility to announcements from the previous 90 days.
  - **From last 6 months**: Extends visibility to announcements from the previous 180 days.
  - **From last 1 year**: Displays announcements published within the last 365 days.
  - **From a custom date**: Enables an exact cutoff date picker.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-news-custom-date.png"><img src="./assets/admin-news-custom-date.png" alt="Admin News Custom Date Filter" /></a>

#### 3. Select the custom date
- Appears dynamically when **From a custom date** is selected.
- All news items published **on or after** this chosen date are displayed on the vendor dashboard.
- Useful for milestone releases, new contract periods, or calendar-year transitions.

After adjusting these fields, click **Save Changes** to apply the configuration.

---

## Create News

- Click on **Add New News** to create a new announcement.
- Enter the required news details such as:
  - News title
  - Description/content
  - Visibility options

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/settings.webp"><img src="./assets/settings.webp" alt="Admin News Settings" /></a>

- Click **Publish** to make the news live.
- Admin can also **edit previously published news** at any time.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-news-create-new-live.png"><img src="./assets/admin-news-create-new-live.png" alt="Add New News Screen" /></a>

### Step-by-Step Announcement Creation Process

To publish a clear and engaging announcement for vendors:

1. Go to **Marketplace → Admin News** and click **Add a New News** (or click **See All News → Add New News**).
2. **Enter News Title**: Add a concise, informative headline into the title field (e.g., *"Scheduled Maintenance on Saturday Night"* or *"Updated Commission Rates for Q4"*).
3. **Compose Content**: Write the announcement body using the rich WordPress content editor:
   - Use the **Visual** tab for standard WYSIWYG formatting (headings, lists, bold text, links, alignment).
   - Use the **Text** tab to insert custom HTML formatting or embedded media.
   - Click **Add Media** if you need to attach relevant diagrams, PDF policy documents, or banners.
4. **Configure Publish Box**:
   - **Save Draft**: Saves the current progress without showing it to sellers.
   - **Status**: Toggle between `Draft`, `Pending Review`, and `Published`.
   - **Visibility**: Keep as `Public` for regular vendor visibility, or use `Password protected` / `Private` for restricted administrative testing.
   - **Publish Immediately / Schedule**: Set an immediate publication timestamp or schedule a future date and time.
5. **Slug Box**: Review and customize the URL slug if necessary.
6. Click **Publish** to push the announcement live to eligible vendors.

---

## News Visibility Options

While creating or editing news, the admin can control which sellers can see the announcement using the following options:

### Show News to Sellers

- When this option is enabled:
  - The news is visible to **all sellers** in the marketplace.
  - Sellers can view the news from their **Vendor Account Panel**.
- Suitable for:
  - General marketplace announcements
  - Policy updates
  - Feature releases
  - Maintenance notifications

---

### Hide News from Sellers

- When this option is enabled:
  - The news is **hidden from sellers**.
  - Only the admin can view the news in the admin panel.
- Useful for:
  - Draft announcements
  - Internal testing
  - Temporarily disabling outdated or irrelevant news
  - Preparing announcements for future publishing

> **Note:** The admin can toggle these options anytime by editing the news item.

---

## View All News

- Click on **See All News** to view the complete list of created news.
- Displays:
  - Active news
  - Hidden news
  - Previously published announcements

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-news-all-posts-live.png"><img src="./assets/admin-news-all-posts-live.png" alt="All News List" /></a>

### News Management Interface Dimensions

The **All News** screen provides comprehensive management tools for maintaining announcements:

#### 1. Status Filter Tabs (Views)
At the top of the table, administrators can quickly switch between different post states:

- **All**: Displays all news items regardless of status (with total item count).
- **Published**: Shows only active announcements currently eligible for vendor visibility.
- **Draft**: Lists saved drafts that are not yet visible to vendors.
- **Trash**: Contains temporarily deleted items that can be restored or permanently removed.

#### 2. Search & Filtering Dimensions

- **Filter by Date**: A dropdown menu grouping posts by month and year (e.g., *All dates*, *October 2026*, *September 2026*). Select a month and click **Filter** to isolate announcements.
- **Search Posts**: Enter keywords into the search input box and click **Search Posts** to find specific announcements by title or content snippet.
- **Bulk Actions**: Select multiple news items using table checkboxes, choose an action from the dropdown (**Bulk edit** or **Move to Trash**), and click **Apply**.

#### 3. Table Columns & Row Actions

| Table Column | Details Displayed | Available Actions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Checkbox** | Selection box for individual or bulk actions | Select all or individual records |
| **Title** | News title and status indicator (e.g., `— Draft`) | Hover over row to reveal: <br>• **Edit**: Opens full edit screen<br>• **Quick Edit**: Opens inline editor<br>• **Trash**: Moves post to trash |
| **Date** | Publication state (`Published` or `Last Modified`) with exact date and time | Click column header to sort ascending or descending |

#### 4. Quick Edit Capabilities

Clicking **Quick Edit** on any news row opens an inline editing drawer without leaving the page. Administrators can rapidly modify:

- **Title**: Update the headline.
- **Slug**: Modify the permalink slug.
- **Date**: Adjust publication date, month, year, hour, and minute.
- **Password / Private**: Set a access password or toggle private status.
- **Status**: Change post status between `Published`, `Pending Review`, and `Draft`.

---

## Vendor Visibility

- Published and visible news appears in the vendor’s **Vendor Account Panel**.
- Sellers can:
  - View the announcement title
  - Read the full news content

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-admin-news-table-live.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-admin-news-table-live.png" alt="Vendor News View" /></a>

### Vendor Dashboard Interface

Vendors access announcements from their dedicated vendor panel:

1. The vendor logs in to their marketplace vendor account.
2. Under the dashboard navigation menu, they click **News & Notifications → Admin News** (or access the **Admin News** section in their vendor dashboard).
3. The **Admin News** feed displays a structured table containing:
   - **Title**: The headline of the news announcement (clickable link).
   - **Description**: A short preview excerpt of the news content.
   - **Published On**: The exact date the announcement was published.
4. **Reading Full News Details**: The vendor clicks on the news headline to open the dedicated article view with full text, guidelines, embedded images, and links.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-new.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-new.webp" alt="Vendor News View" /></a>

---

## Use Cases

- **Marketplace-wide announcements**: Share platform milestones, holiday shipping guidelines, or promotional events.
- **Vendor onboarding updates**: Provide new sellers with helpful tips, policies, and marketplace standards.
- **Policy or commission changes**: Announce revisions to seller commission structures, payouts, or return policies.
- **New feature releases**: Educate vendors on new tools such as compare features, shipping addons, or reporting enhancements.
- **Scheduled maintenance notifications**: Give advance warning before server updates or marketplace downtime.

---

## Best Practices & Troubleshooting

### Best Practices for Administrators

- **Keep Headlines Clear and Actionable**: Use direct titles so vendors immediately understand the topic (e.g., *"Urgent: Update Shipping Policies Before Dec 1"*).
- **Use Drafts for Review**: Prepare announcements in **Draft** status so team members can review copy before publishing.
- **Schedule in Advance**: Use the WordPress scheduling feature to publish news at optimal vendor business hours.
- **Review Date Cutoffs Regularly**: Ensure the **Show news to Vendors** duration in Admin News Settings covers all relevant historical announcements.

### Troubleshooting Common Questions

| Issue | Probable Cause | Recommended Resolution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vendors cannot see an announcement** | The news post status is set to Draft. | Go to **Marketplace → Admin News → See All News**, edit the post, and click **Publish**. |
| **Vendor reports news table is empty** | The post publication date is older than the configured timeframe in settings. | Go to **Marketplace → Admin News** and increase **Show news to Vendors** (e.g., from 30 days to 90 or 180 days, or choose *From a custom date*). |
| **Specific vendor cannot see any news** | The vendor is listed under **Hide News from Vendors**. | Go to **Marketplace → Admin News**, remove the vendor from the **Hide News from Vendors** multi-select field, and click **Save Changes**. |
| **Accidentally deleted news post** | News was moved to Trash. | Go to **Marketplace → Admin News → See All News**, click the **Trash** tab, hover over the item, and click **Restore**. |

---

## How it works

<ol class="feature-steps feature--ai">
  <li>
    <span class="feature-steps__title">You set it up</span>
    Connect an AI provider, switch Generative AI on for sellers, and choose the model, the limits and the fields it may fill.
  </li>
  <li>
    <span class="feature-steps__title">The seller describes the product</span>
    On their product's edit page, the seller clicks <strong>Generate with AI</strong>, writes what they sell and can attach photos.
  </li>
  <li>
    <span class="feature-steps__title">The seller decides</span>
    Each suggestion is shown next to the current value. The seller keeps the ones they want, applies them to the form and saves the product.
  </li>
</ol>

## Who uses it

- **Admins** set it up under **WooCommerce Marketplace >> Settings >> Generative AI** and control it per seller on the seller's record. See [Usage Limits](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/usage-limits.html) and [Product Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/product-settings.html).
- **Sellers** use it on the edit page of the products they own, in the Seller Panel. Team members need the **Generate Content With Magic AI** permission in their role. See [Vendor Staff](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-staff.html).
- **Customers** don't see it. They see the product once the seller has saved it and, if required, you have approved it.

## What it does not do

Generative AI fills in the product form when the seller asks for it, and stops there:

- **It doesn't save, submit or publish a product**, and it doesn't change stock or approval.
- **It doesn't create fake images**. Photos the seller attaches can be added to the product as they are.
- **It isn't available when a seller sells an existing catalog product** via *Select & Sell* or uses bulk upload.
- **It doesn't act on its own**. Each suggestion comes from one request the seller explicitly starts.

::: warning Note on Model Accuracy
AI models can occasionally hallucinate details. Sellers should always verify technical specifications, sizing, warranties, and prices before applying and saving suggestions.
:::

## Generative AI in the rest of your store

The marketplace's Magic AI foundation integrates seamlessly with broader WordPress and WooCommerce AI capabilities:

- **Admin Catalog Moderation**: Platform administrators can run Magic AI to polish product titles, enhance descriptions, or generate missing specifications during product review before approval.
- **WordPress Ecosystem Compatibility**: Built using native WordPress transients and background processing, letting store owners integrate smoothly without site slowdowns.
- **Zero-Cost Self-Hosted AI via Ollama**: Run private, open-weight models (such as Llama 3 or Mistral) on your own server with 100% data privacy and zero API token billing.

---
