# License Management & Activation

Activating the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** license verifies your software purchase, unlocks all marketplace features, enables seamless plugin updates, and ensures access to official Webkul technical support and security patches.

Webkul provides a dedicated self-service **License Validator Portal** where you can register your purchase, manage your domains, and generate cryptographic license keys on demand.

::: tip Quick Access Links
- **License Validator Portal:** [license.aureuserp.com](https://license.aureuserp.com/)
- **Registration Page:** [license.aureuserp.com/register](https://license.aureuserp.com/register)
- **Sign In Page:** [license.aureuserp.com/login](https://license.aureuserp.com/login)
- **Supported Domains:** Up to **2 domains per license** (1 Production site + 1 Staging / Development site)
:::

---

## 1. Purchase Verification & Credentials

Before generating your license key, identify where you purchased the plugin and gather the required verification details:

| Purchase Channel | Required Verification Credentials | Where to Locate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Envato / CodeCanyon** | • **Envato Username**<br>• **36-Character Purchase Code** (`xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx`) | Log in to **CodeCanyon → Downloads → WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace → Download → License certificate & purchase code** (PDF or text file). |
| **Webkul Store** | • **Webkul Store Order ID** (e.g., `#123456`)<br>• **Registered Email Address** | Check your Webkul Store order confirmation email or log in to **store.webkul.com → My Account → My Orders**. |

---

## 2. Account Registration on the License Portal

If you are a first-time user, you must register your purchase on the [License Validator Portal](https://license.aureuserp.com/register).

### Option A: Registration via Envato (CodeCanyon)

If you purchased the plugin through Envato / CodeCanyon:

1. Navigate to the **[License Portal Registration Page](https://license.aureuserp.com/register)**.
2. Select the **Envato** option tab.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-account-select-envato.webp"><img src="./assets/license-account-select-envato.webp" alt="Select Envato Option on License Portal" /></a>

3. Enter your **Envato Username** and your **36-character Purchase Code**.
4. Click **Verify User** to validate your purchase.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-account-envato-details.webp"><img src="./assets/license-account-envato-details.webp" alt="Enter Envato Username and Purchase Code" /></a>

5. Once verified, provide your active administrative email address.
6. A One-Time Password (OTP) will be sent to your email inbox. Enter the OTP to finalize your account registration.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-account-envato-email.webp"><img src="./assets/license-account-envato-email.webp" alt="Enter Email Address and OTP Verification for Envato" /></a>

::: warning Permanent Email Notice
The registered email address can only be changed **once** from your user profile. Always use a permanent company or store administrative email address.
:::

---

### Option B: Registration via Webkul Store

If you purchased directly from the [Webkul Store](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multivendor-marketplace.html):

1. On the registration page, select the **Webkul Store** option tab.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-account-select-webkul.webp"><img src="./assets/license-account-select-webkul.webp" alt="Select Webkul Option on Registration Page" /></a>

2. Enter your **Order ID** and the **Email address** used during checkout.
3. Click **Submit** / **Verify User**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-account-webkul-details.webp"><img src="./assets/license-account-webkul-details.webp" alt="Enter Webkul Order ID and Email" /></a>

4. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your registered email to verify ownership and complete registration.

---

## 3. Signing In to the License Portal

The License Portal uses secure, passwordless authentication via Email and One-Time Password (OTP):

1. Go to the **[License Portal Sign In Page](https://license.aureuserp.com/login)**.
2. Enter your registered email address and click **Send OTP**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-sign-in-email.webp"><img src="./assets/license-sign-in-email.webp" alt="Enter Registered Email on Sign In Page" /></a>

3. Check your email inbox for a 6-digit verification code.
4. Enter the 6-digit OTP into the verification form and click **Verify & Access**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-sign-in-otp.webp"><img src="./assets/license-sign-in-otp.webp" alt="Sign In OTP Verification Screen" /></a>

5. You will immediately be redirected to your personal **User Dashboard**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-user-dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/license-user-dashboard.webp" alt="License Portal User Dashboard" /></a>

---

## 4. User Dashboard & Purchase History

The User Dashboard serves as the central hub for your licenses and purchases:

- **Consolidated Purchases:** View both Envato (CodeCanyon) and Webkul Store purchases side-by-side in a single view.
- **Licenses Tab:** Access your generated license keys, check assigned domains, and view validation status.
- **Status Indicators:** Instantly see whether a license is **Active**, **Pending**, or **Expired**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-portal-licences-tab.webp"><img src="./assets/license-portal-licences-tab.webp" alt="License Portal Dashboard Licenses Tab" /></a>

## 5. Generating Your License Key

Generate your plugin license key on demand without waiting for manual support approval:

### Step 1 – Select Your Purchase

1. In your dashboard, locate **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** in your purchases list.
2. Click **Create License** or select the purchase record.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-select-purchase.webp"><img src="./assets/license-select-purchase.webp" alt="Select Purchase Record from List" /></a>

---

### Step 2 – Configure Domain & Environment

In the license configuration screen:

1. **Domain Name:** Enter your store domain (for example, `yourstore.com` or `staging.yourstore.com`).
   - Do **NOT** prefix with `http://` or `https://`.
   - Do **NOT** include a trailing slash (`/`).
2. **Environment Support:** Select the environment for this key:
   - **Production:** For your live, customer-facing store.
   - **Development / Staging:** For your local, sandbox, or staging server.
   - The system allows you to create keys for both staging and production environments simultaneously.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-domain-configuration.png"><img src="./assets/license-domain-configuration.png" alt="Domain and Environment Configuration" /></a>

3. Click **Generate Key** / **Submit**.

---

### Step 3 – Retrieve and Copy the License Key

1. Once generated, your new cryptographic license key appears in the **License Keys List**.
2. Click **View Details** to inspect full configuration parameters (assigned domain, environment, issue date, and support status).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-keys-list.webp"><img src="./assets/license-keys-list.webp" alt="License Keys List in Portal" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-view-details.webp"><img src="./assets/license-view-details.webp" alt="View Detailed License Configuration" /></a>

3. Copy the full license key to your clipboard.

---

## 6. Activating the License in WordPress Admin

After copying your license key from the portal, log in to your WordPress administrative dashboard to complete plugin activation.

### Method 1: Via Marketplace Settings (First-Time Setup)

1. Log in to your **WordPress Admin Panel**.
2. In the left navigation menu, go to **Marketplace → Settings**.
3. If the license is not yet activated, the license wizard modal will appear automatically.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wizard.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wizard.webp" alt="Marketplace Settings License Wizard Modal" /></a>

4. Paste the generated **License Key** into the text field.
5. Click **Activate License**.

---

### Method 2: Via Webkul WC Addons

1. In WP Admin, navigate to **Webkul WC Addons → Marketplace** (or your module's specific settings page).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wp-module-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wp-module-settings.webp" alt="Webkul WC Addons Module Settings Screen" /></a>

2. Locate the **License Key** field under the settings tab.
3. Paste the generated key into the field.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wp-enter-key.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wp-enter-key.webp" alt="Enter License Key in WordPress Admin" /></a>

4. Click **Validate** / **Save Changes**.

---

### Successful Activation Confirmation

Once the license key is validated with Webkul's authentication server:

- The status updates immediately to **Approved** (indicated with a green status badge).
- The full multi-vendor marketplace administration interface, seller central, commission engine, and configuration tabs become fully operational.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-wp-activated.webp"><img src="./assets/license-wp-activated.webp" alt="WordPress Module Successfully Activated" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-status-approved.webp"><img src="./assets/license-status-approved.webp" alt="License Status Badge Approved" /></a>

## 7. Licensing Rules & Domain Limits

Webkul's licensing architecture is designed to accommodate both development and live production setups while protecting software integrity.

### Two Domains Supported Per License

Each standard plugin license allows up to **two concurrent domains**:
- **1 Production / Live Domain:** (e.g., `mystore.com`)
- **1 Staging / Development Domain:** (e.g., `staging.mystore.com` or `dev.local`)

### Activating on a Third Domain (Domain Switching)

If you attempt to activate a key on a third domain:
1. The licensing portal will detect that both domain slots are currently occupied.
2. The system displays a list of your recently assigned domains.
3. You can choose to **remove / unlink** an older or inactive domain (e.g., a decommissioned staging site).
4. Once unlinked, the freed slot is immediately reassigned to your new domain.

---

### Behavior When Support is Expired

Your purchase grants **lifetime usage** of the plugin version you have downloaded. 

- Even if your technical support period has expired, you can still activate the plugin on your store using your valid license key.
- Upon activation, the plugin activates successfully and all marketplace functionality operates normally.
- The admin badge will indicate **Support Expired** or **Expired**, reminding you that automatic updates and priority helpdesk tickets require renewal.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/license-expired-support-status.webp"><img src="./assets/license-expired-support-status.webp" alt="Module License with Support Expired Status" /></a>

To renew support or download the latest major release, visit your purchase account on CodeCanyon or the Webkul Store.

---

## 8. Troubleshooting License Activation

If you encounter an issue during registration or validation, review these solutions:

| Issue | Probable Cause | Recommended Solution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **"Invalid License Key"** | • Trailing or leading spaces copied.<br>• Entered the Envato purchase code instead of the generated license key. | Make sure to enter the **cryptographic key** generated in the License Portal (`license.aureuserp.com`), not the 36-character Envato purchase code. Check for hidden spaces when pasting. |
| **"Domain Mismatch"** | • Registered domain differs from site URL.<br>• Mismatch in `www` vs non-`www` or subdomains. | Verify your site URL in **WordPress Admin → Settings → General**. Ensure the exact domain name matches the one configured during key generation on the portal. |
| **"Could Not Connect to Validation Server"** | • Server firewall or security plugin blocking outbound HTTPS cURL requests. | Ensure your hosting server allows outbound HTTPS requests on port 443 to `license.aureuserp.com` and `webkul.com`. Whitelist these hostnames in Wordfence/Sucuri if installed. |
| **"Domain Limit Reached"** | • Both domain slots (production and staging) are already registered. | Sign in to [license.aureuserp.com](https://license.aureuserp.com/), locate your license, and release/unlink the inactive domain. |
| **"OTP Not Received"** | • Verification email filtered into Spam or Junk folder.<br>• Corporate email domain firewall blocking transactional messages. | Check your Spam/Junk folder. Ensure `no-reply@webkul.com` is whitelisted. Wait 2 minutes before requesting a resend. |

---

# Vendor Registration Process

Vendors can register on the marketplace using multiple methods provided by the WooCommerce Marketplace plugin.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/Registration.webp"><img src="./assets/Registration.webp" alt="Vendor Registration" /></a>

---

## Method 1: Registration via Vendor Menu

- Vendor clicks on the **Vendor** menu item.
- The page displays two options:
  - **Login Here**
  - **Register**

  <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-login.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-login.webp" alt="Vendor Menu" /></a>

- Clicking **Login Here** redirects to the vendor login page.
- Clicking **Register** redirects to the vendor registration page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-menu.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-menu.webp" alt="Vendor Menu" /></a>

---

## Method 2: Registration via Seller Central Page

- Vendor visits the **Seller Central** page.
- Clicks on the **Become a Seller** button.


<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral.webp" alt="Seller Central" /></a>

- The vendor registration form opens.
- Vendor completes and submits the registration form.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellercentral-registration-form.webp"><img src="./assets/sellercentral-registration-form.webp" alt="Seller Central Registration Form" /></a>

::: tip Dedicated Onboarding Endpoint
Vendors can also access the dedicated onboarding registration portal directly using the clean storefront endpoint:
```text
https://your-domain.com/sellercentral/become-vendor/
```
This dedicated page presents the complete vendor onboarding form with password confirmation, live store URL check, and KYC document uploads.
:::

---

## Method 3: Registration via My Account Page

If the admin enables **Allow Vendor Registration on My Account**:

- A **vendor registration option** is available on the **My Account** sign-up page.
- The user selects the **“I am a Vendor”** radio button during registration.
- Additional **vendor-specific registration fields** are displayed automatically.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-registration-page.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-registration-page.webp" alt="Seller Registration Page" /></a>

---

## Vendor Registration Form Fields

The vendor must enter the following details:

- Email Address
- Password
- First Name
- Last Name
- Shop Name
- Shop URL
- Phone Number
- Accept Terms & Conditions

After entering the details, click the **Register** button.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/registration-details.webp"><img src="./assets/registration-details.webp" alt="Registration Details" /></a>

### Additional Registration Form Fields & KYC Verification

Depending on your marketplace configuration, the registration form also includes:

- **Confirm Password**: Ensures the applicant enters their password accurately during sign-up.
- **KYC Document Type**: If KYC verification is enabled, applicants select their document type from a dropdown menu (e.g., *Business License*, *Government ID*, or *Utility Bill*).
- **KYC Document Upload**: An optional or mandatory file upload field supporting common file formats (*PDF*, *JPG*, *JPEG*, *PNG*, *WEBP*) within configured file size limits.
- **Terms & Conditions Agreement**: When a Terms & Conditions page is selected in admin settings, a checkbox prompt (`I have read and agree to the vendor signup terms and conditions`) is required before form submission.

::: tip Customizing Registration Form Attributes & Labels
Admins can easily customize registration form subtitles, field labels, placeholder texts, and call-to-action button text without touching any code. For full details on all registration attributes and landing page settings, please visit the [Configuration – Seller Central](./configuration-seller-central.html#registration-section) documentation page [here](./configuration-seller-central.html#registration-section).
:::

---

## Shop URL Availability Check

- The **Shop URL** field uses an **AJAX-based availability check**.
- Displays **“Available”** if the URL is unused.
- Displays **“Already Exists”** if the URL already exists.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/registration-details.webp"><img src="./assets/registration-details.webp" alt="Shop URL Availability" /></a>

### Real-Time Validation Feedback

When the vendor types a shop slug into the **Shop URL** input field, the marketplace performs an instant real-time AJAX check:

- **If the slug is free**: Displays `This shop URl is available, kindly proceed.` in green confirmation text.
- **If the slug is already registered**: Displays `This shop URl already EXISTS, please try different shop url.` in warning text.

::: tip Automatic Fallback for Shop Name & Slug
If the marketplace admin sets **Shop Name on Registration** or **Shop Slug on Registration** to *Optional* or *Remove*, applicants do not need to choose a URL manually. The plugin automatically generates a clean URL slug using the vendor's registered username or shop name.
:::

---

## Registration Using Email & Password

- Vendor registration is completed using **email and password**.
- Vendor access is granted based on admin approval settings.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/register-as-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/register-as-vendor.webp" alt="Register as Vendor" /></a>

---

## Become a Vendor from Customer Account

- Existing customers can upgrade to a vendor account.
- A **Become a Vendor** option is available in the **My Account** panel.
- Clicking it initiates the vendor registration process.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-account-become-vendor.webp"><img src="./assets/customer-account-become-vendor.webp" alt="Become Vendor from Account" /></a>

### Customer-to-Vendor Upgrade Experience

When registered customers want to sell products on your marketplace:

1. The customer logs into their **My Account** dashboard (`/my-account/`).
2. A prominent **Become a Vendor** banner card invites them to register as a seller with the message:
   > *"Submit the request form in the next step and get approval to list and sell your products."*
3. Clicking **Become a Vendor** opens the vendor registration form with the customer's existing name and email address already filled in.
4. The customer provides their **Shop Name**, **Shop URL**, contact telephone number, and optional KYC documents.
5. All previous customer purchase history, billing addresses, and order details are safely retained while adding vendor capabilities to the account.

---

## Admin Settings Controlling Vendor Registration

Marketplace administrators have full control over the vendor sign-up experience. These settings are located in the WordPress Admin dashboard under:

**Marketplace > Settings > General**

| Setting Label | Type | Options / Values | How It Affects Registration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Allow Vendor Registration on My Account** | Checkbox | Enabled / Disabled | When enabled, adds the **I am a Vendor** radio button to the standard WooCommerce My Account registration form. When disabled, vendor signups only occur through Seller Central or the Become Vendor endpoint. |
| **Shop Name on Registration** | Dropdown | `Required`, `Optional`, `Remove` | Controls whether applicants must enter a store name. If set to *Remove* or left empty, the marketplace automatically uses the vendor's user name. |
| **Shop Slug on Registration** | Dropdown | `Required`, `Optional`, `Remove` | Controls whether the public store URL slug is mandatory. If removed or empty, the system automatically uses the vendor's username as the shop URL slug. |
| **Auto Approve Vendor** | Checkbox | Enabled / Disabled | If checked, newly registered vendors are automatically approved and can access their seller dashboard immediately. If unchecked, new registrations remain pending until manual admin approval. |
| **Vendor Terms & Condition Page** | Dropdown | Page Selector | Selects a published WordPress page for marketplace vendor terms. When set, a mandatory agreement checkbox appears on the registration form. |
| **Enable Vendor KYC Verification** | Checkbox | Enabled / Disabled | Adds KYC document type selection and document upload fields directly to the vendor registration form. |
| **KYC Document Types** | Multi-Select | Business License, Government ID, Utility Bill | Configures which verification document options applicants can select during registration. |
| **Allowed KYC Formats** | Checkbox Group | PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP | Defines the permitted document file extensions for vendor uploads. |
| **Restrict KYC Document Size** | Number Input | Max Size in KB | Sets maximum file upload limits to prevent large files from slowing down the server. |

---

## Vendor Account Approval Workflow

Once a vendor submits the registration form, the account follows one of two approval workflows depending on the **Auto Approve Vendor** setting:

| Workflow Stage | Instant Approval Flow (`Auto Approve = ON`) | Manual Review Flow (`Auto Approve = OFF`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Initial Status** | Active / Approved Immediately | Pending Review |
| **On-Screen Confirmation** | *"Congratulations!! Your request has been accepted. Now you are a vendor on the site..."* | *"Your request has been successfully sent to Administrator. You will be notified via Email once it is processed."* |
| **Admin Action Needed** | None (Automated) | Administrator manual review and approval under **Users > All Users** |
| **Vendor Access** | Immediate redirection to the **Seller Dashboard** (`/seller/vendor-dashboard/`) | Login restricted until approved by email notification |
| **Email Triggers** | Welcome / Activation email sent to vendor | Notification sent to Admin (`New Vendor Request`), followed by approval email to vendor upon activation |

### 1. Instant Approval Flow (Auto Approve Enabled)
- The vendor account is activated immediately upon submission.
- A confirmation notice appears:
  > *"Congratulations!! Your request has been accepted. Now you are a vendor on the site. You will be redirected to your vendor dashboard soon..."*
- The vendor is automatically logged in and redirected to their **Seller Dashboard** (`/seller/vendor-dashboard/`).

### 2. Manual Review Flow (Auto Approve Disabled)
- The vendor account is placed into a pending status.
- A notice is displayed to the applicant:
  > *"Your request has been successfully sent to Administrator. You will be notified via Email once it is processed."*
- Marketplace administrators receive an email notification (`New Vendor Request`) and can approve or decline the vendor under **Users > All Users** (filtered by the `Seller` role).
- Once approved by the admin, the vendor receives an approval email and can log in to access the seller panel.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-profile.html -->

# Vendor Profile

The **Vendor Profile** displays essential information about a vendor's shop, helping buyers learn about the store, view products, review store policies, and verify vendor credibility.

In the modern seller dashboard, vendor profile management is handled on the **Store Edit** page (`/seller/vendor-profile/`). Unlike older tab-based layouts, the new setup organizes all profile configurations into a **single, scrollable two-column card layout**. Vendors can view and manage their entire store configuration in one unified workspace without clicking between tabs.

::: tip Using the classic layout?
If your marketplace uses the older **My Account** tabbed layout (**My Account → My Profile**), please refer to the [Classic Vendor Profile](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/classic-vendor-profile.html) guide. You can switch between layouts using the dashboard view options configured by the marketplace administrator.
:::

---

## Store Edit Layout Overview

Vendors can access their profile editor directly from the seller dashboard sidebar by clicking **Store Edit** (`/seller/vendor-profile/`).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-overview.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-overview.png" alt="Store Edit Page Overview" /></a>

---

## Main Column Cards

The main column contains the core store configurations, media assets, business hours, compliance verification, storefront layout selection, and search engine optimization.

---

### 1. Images Card

The **Images** card manages the visual branding of the vendor's store across both the seller dashboard and customer-facing pages.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-images-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-images-card.png" alt="Store Edit Images Card" /></a>

- **Allowed File Formats**: Supports `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`, and `gif`.
- **User Image**: The personal profile avatar of the vendor. Includes **Upload** and **Remove** buttons with instant image preview.
- **Shop Logo**: The official brand logo for the store, visible on the vendor's storefront, product pages, and invoice headers.
- **Panel Header**: A dropdown setting that configures the branding area in the top-left corner of the seller dashboard:
  - **Logo with shop name**: Displays both the store logo and the store name together.
  - **Logo only**: Displays only the logo image in the top-left navigation panel.
- **Banner Image**: A wide header banner displayed across the top of the vendor's public store page.
  - **Show banner on vendor page**: Checkbox toggle to show or hide the banner on the public storefront.
  - Includes **Upload** and **Remove** controls to update or clear the banner image anytime.

---

### 2. Shop Configuration Card

The **Shop** card contains store contact details, payout preferences, analytics tracking, tax compliance, geographical location, and public store policies.

#### Store Information & Payouts:
- **Shop Name**: The public display name of the store.
- **Shop Slug**: The URL slug representing the store (for example, `/vendor/aurora-athletics`). This field is read-only after initial creation to protect permanent store links and SEO indexing.
- **Phone Number**: Customer service or store contact telephone number (accepts 4 to 15 characters).
- **Payment Information**: Vendor payout details (such as direct bank account numbers, SWIFT/IBAN codes, or PayPal address) used by the admin to disburse earnings after deducting commission.

#### Google Analytics Tracking:
Vendors can track customer traffic and engagement on their own store pages:
- **Google Analytics Account ID**: Enter your Google Analytics Measurement ID (e.g., `G-XXXXXXXXXX`).
- **Enable Tracking Events**:
  - **Enable view item event**: Fires when a customer views any product belonging to the vendor.
  - **Enable purchase event**: Fires when a customer completes an order containing the vendor's products.

#### Tax System Compliance:
- **Choose Tax System**: Select the applicable tax registration authority from the dropdown:
  - **GSTIN** (Goods and Services Tax Identification Number)
  - **SSN** (Social Security Number)
  - **VAT** (Value Added Tax)
- **Tax Identification Number**: Input field corresponding to the selected tax system (e.g., GSTIN number, VAT registration, or SSN). This ID is displayed on store receipts and verified by the marketplace.

#### Store Address & Interactive Location Map:
- **Country**: Dropdown list to choose the country of operation.
- **Shop Address**: Street address and office/building number.
- **Interactive Map**: Vendors can search their location or drag the map pin to mark their physical shop.
- **Shop Latitude & Longitude**: Automatically populated by the map pin, ensuring the store appears accurately on marketplace store locator maps.
- **City, State, and Postal Code**: Specific regional address details.

#### Store Policies & Bio:
Each policy section includes a rich-text / WYSIWYG editor allowing text formatting, links, and bullet points:
- **About Shop**: A detailed description of the store, brand story, craftsmanship, or specialty shown in the "About this Vendor" section on the storefront.
- **Return Policy**: Guidelines and timelines for product returns, warranty claims, and refunds.
- **Shipping Policy**: Information on handling times, domestic/international carriers, and delivery expectations.
- **Privacy Policy**: How customer personal data is handled and protected by the vendor.

---

### 3. Store Hours Card

The **Store Hours** card allows vendors to define their weekly operating schedule and control whether buyers can purchase products outside business hours.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-store-hours-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-store-hours-card.png" alt="Store Edit Store Hours Card" /></a>

#### General Store Hours Controls:
- **Enable Store Hours**: Switch toggle to turn the store schedule on or off. When active, opening hours appear on the vendor's store page.
- **Disable Purchase During OFF Time**: Switch toggle to block the "Add to Cart" button on the vendor's products whenever the store is closed.
- **Store Off Time Message**: A customizable notice displayed to shoppers on store and product pages when the shop is closed (e.g., *"Our workshop is currently closed. Orders placed outside operating hours will be processed the next business morning."*). Basic HTML formatting is supported.

#### Weekly Schedule:
- Each day from **Monday to Sunday** has an independent **Open / Closed** toggle.
- For open days, vendors can define operating time slots (**Start Time** and **End Time**).
- Vendors can click **+ Add Slot** to set split shifts or multiple open intervals within the same day (such as morning and evening hours).

---

### 4. KYC Verification Card

The **KYC** (Know Your Customer) card provides identity and compliance verification with the marketplace administration.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-kyc-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-kyc-card.png" alt="Store Edit KYC Verification Card" /></a>

- **Verification Status Badge**: Displays the current verification state of the vendor's documents:
  - **Not uploaded**: No documents have been submitted yet.
  - **Pending**: Document is uploaded and awaiting administrator review.
  - **Approved**: Document is verified by the admin.
  - **Rejected**: Document was not accepted (the vendor must re-upload a valid file).
- **KYC Document Type**: Dropdown selection specifying the type of submitted proof:
  - **Business License**
  - **Government ID**
  - **Utility Bill**
- **KYC Document File**: File upload input. Supported document formats include `pdf`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, and `png`.

---

### 5. Profile View Card

The **Profile View** card lets vendors customize how their public storefront is styled and laid out for shoppers, with an embedded **Live Preview**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-profile-view-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-profile-view-card.png" alt="Store Edit Profile View Card" /></a>

#### Storefront Layout Options:
- **Storefront**: A clean, structured store layout featuring a dedicated information sidebar displaying store hours, contact details, map location, and a grid product gallery.
- **Spotlight**: A visually driven layout with a full-width hero banner, prominent product showcases front and center, and an expanded "About this Vendor" story section.

#### Live Preview:
- Directly underneath the options, an embedded **Live Preview frame** loads the vendor's store page in real time. Switching between **Storefront** and **Spotlight** instantly updates the live frame so vendors can verify their design before saving.

---

### 6. SEO Information Card

The **SEO Information** card optimizes how the vendor's shop appears on search engines (like Google, Bing) and AI search summaries.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-seo-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-seo-card.png" alt="Store Edit SEO Information Card" /></a>

- **Live Search Snippet Preview**: A real-time Google search result preview box showing the page title, clean store URL (`/vendor/[slug]`), and meta description as searchers will see it in search engine result pages (SERPs).
- **Meta Title**: The title tag shown in search engine results and browser tabs. Recommended length is 50–60 characters.
- **Meta Keywords**: Keywords describing the vendor's store, categories, and specialty products. Multiple keywords must be separated by commas (e.g., `running shoes, trail footwear, sports apparel`).
- **Meta Description**: A concise summary of the store and offerings (recommended 150–160 characters). A well-crafted description improves click-through rates from search results.

---

## Sidebar Column Cards

The right column of the Store Edit page displays personal vendor details, connected social media channels, and administrative permissions.

---

### 7. General Card

The **General** card contains basic personal profile details for the vendor account.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-general-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-general-card.png" alt="Store Edit General Details Card" /></a>

- **Username**: The account login handle (read-only; set during initial registration).
- **First Name**: The vendor's first name.
- **Last Name**: The vendor's last name.
- **E-Mail**: The primary email address for notifications, order alerts, and account communications.

---

### 8. Social Profile Card

The **Social Profile** card connects the vendor's external social media presences to their marketplace store page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-social-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-social-card.png" alt="Store Edit Social Profile Card" /></a>

Vendors can enter full profile URLs (`https://...`) for the following platforms:
- **Facebook Profile ID**
- **Instagram Profile ID**
- **X (Formerly Twitter) Profile ID**
- **Linkedin Profile ID**
- **Youtube Profile**
- **Pinterest Profile**

Connected profiles appear as clickable social media icons on the public vendor storefront.

---

### 9. Shop Information Card (Read-Only Admin Settings)

The **Shop Information** card provides a clear, read-only summary of the marketplace permissions, commission rate, and capabilities assigned to the vendor by the administrator.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-store-edit-shop-info-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-store-edit-shop-info-card.png" alt="Store Edit Shop Information Card" /></a>

- **Applied Commission**: The current commission percentage deducted by the marketplace on the vendor's sales (e.g., `12%`). If no vendor-specific rate is set, the global marketplace rate applies.
- **Allowed Categories**: Tags/chips showing which product categories the vendor is authorized to list products under (e.g., *Sports & Outdoors*, *Clothing*, *Accessories*).
- **Allowed Product Types**: Tags/chips listing permitted product types (e.g., *Simple product*, *Grouped product*, *External/Affiliate product*, *Variable product*).
- **Payment Methods**: Payout channels enabled by the admin for disbursing seller earnings (e.g., *Direct bank transfer*, *Check payments*, *Cash on delivery*).
- **Shipping Methods**: Shipping carriers and delivery options permitted for the vendor (e.g., *Flat rate*, *Free shipping*, *Store Pickup*).

::: note Read-Only Permissions
The settings in the Shop Information card are configured by the marketplace admin. If you need additional categories, product types, or custom commission rates, contact the marketplace administrator.
:::

## Saving Profile Changes

Once you have updated your store information across any of the cards:
1. Review the entered details and live previews.
2. Click the **Save** button located at the **top-right** corner of the Store Edit page.
3. A success confirmation notice confirms that all updated fields have been saved.

## Vendor Purchase Restriction

To ensure marketplace trust, prevent fraudulent transactions, and comply with review integrity:
- Vendors are **restricted from purchasing their own products**.
- If a logged-in vendor views one of their own products on the storefront, the standard "Add to Cart" button is disabled or replaced with an **Edit Product** link.
- The **Edit Product** shortcut allows vendors to quickly jump straight from the customer storefront into the seller catalog editor.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-restriction.webp"><img src="./assets/seller-restriction.webp" alt="Vendor Purchase Restriction" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-public-storefront-view.png"><img src="./assets/seller-public-storefront-view.png" alt="Public Vendor Storefront View" /></a>

### Public Storefront Elements:
- **Store Banner & Logo**: Branded header imagery and store logo.
- **Vendor Badges**: Verified maker, on-time delivery, and excellence badges assigned by the administrator.
- **Deals in Categories**: Interactive category badges highlighting product lines offered by the store.
- **Store Location & Hours**: Physical street address, interactive map, and real-time open/closed status.
- **About this Vendor**: Store biography and brand story.
- **Store Policies**: Dedicated tabs displaying the vendor's Return Policy, Shipping Policy, and Privacy Policy.
- **Product Catalog**: Paginated grid of all published products with search, sorting, and price filtering.
- **Customer Reviews & Inquiry**: Review submission form, average customer rating, and "Ask a Question" / "Report Vendor" links.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

<details>
<summary><strong>Can I change my Shop Slug after setting up my store?</strong></summary>

In the Store Edit interface, the **Shop Slug** field is read-only after creation. This protects your store URL (`/vendor/[slug]`), prevents broken backlinks, and maintains search engine rankings. If you need an exceptional change to your store slug, request a slug update from the marketplace administrator.
</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Where do I find my applied commission rate?</strong></summary>

Your current commission rate is displayed in the **Shop Information** card in the right sidebar column of the Store Edit page. This rate is set by the marketplace administrator.
</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>What happens to my products when Store Hours are closed?</strong></summary>

If the **Disable Purchase During OFF Time** toggle is enabled, customers cannot add your items to their cart while your store is closed. A friendly off-time notice (configured in your **Store Off Time Message** field) is displayed on your store and product pages.
</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>What file formats are accepted for Images and KYC documents?</strong></summary>

- **Store Images** (User avatar, Shop logo, Banner): `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`, and `gif`.
- **KYC Verification Documents**: `pdf`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, and `png`.
</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Do I need to save each section individually?</strong></summary>

No. The new Store Edit layout features a unified **Save** button in the top-right corner of the page. Clicking this button saves changes across all cards at once.
</details>

# Vendor Dashboard Guide

The **Vendor Dashboard** is the primary command center where sellers manage their daily marketplace business—including catalog creation, order fulfillment, inventory management, customer communications, and financial tracking.

WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace provides **two flexible dashboard types** to accommodate different merchant workflows and theme requirements:

1. **Separate Dashboard (Dedicated Workspace at `/seller/vendor-dashboard/`):** A full-screen, standalone merchant workspace featuring an independent collapsible sidebar, top navigation bar, real-time KPI metric cards, interactive performance charts, and an operational Action Required queue.
2. **Default Dashboard (Integrated My Account at `/my-account/vendor-dashboard/`):** A dashboard integrated natively within the store's standard WooCommerce My Account menu, blending seamlessly into your active WordPress theme.

Vendors can switch between both dashboard presentations at any time. For a high-level UI navigation walkthrough, see the [Seller Panel Overview](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/seller-panel-overview.html).

---

## Admin Configuration: Enabling the Vendor Dashboard

Marketplace administrators can configure how vendors access their dashboard from the WordPress administrative backend:

Navigate to: **Marketplace > Settings > General**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/general-settings.png"><img src="./assets/general-settings.png" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace General Settings - Vendor Dashboard Configuration" /></a>

### Key Dashboard Settings

| Setting Option | Description & Best Practice |
|---|---|
| **New vendor dashboard** | Check this box to enable the modern dedicated full-screen seller workspace under `/seller/vendor-dashboard/`. When enabled, vendors logging in are routed directly to this console. |
| **Separate Vendor Dashboard** | Controls whether vendor management activities are isolated from customer storefront screens. |
| **Seller panel page** | Displays the live URL where the dedicated dashboard is hosted (default: `https://your-domain.com/seller/vendor-dashboard/`). |
| **Vendor Page** | Selects the public page where all approved marketplace vendors are indexed in the store directory. |
| **Seller Central Page** | Selects the public landing page that introduces prospective sellers to joining your multi-vendor platform. Learn more in [Seller Central Configuration](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-seller-central.html). |

### Configuring URL Endpoints

To customize the URL slugs used across both dashboard variations, navigate to:

**Marketplace > Settings > Endpoints**

- **Seller Panel Endpoint:** The base URL slug for the dedicated dashboard (default: `seller`).
- **Dashboard Endpoint:** The home screen endpoint for the dashboard (default: `vendor-dashboard`).

::: tip Permalink Notice
After updating any marketplace endpoint slug in [Endpoint Configuration](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/configuration-endpoints.html), always navigate to **Settings > Permalinks** in WordPress and click **Save Changes** to flush rewrite rules and prevent 404 errors.
:::

---

## Understanding the Two Dashboard Modes

The marketplace provides two distinct presentation experiences designed for different operational workflows:

<div class="modes-showcase">
<div class="modes-grid">

<div class="mode-card mode-card--separate">
<div class="mode-card__badge-wrap">
<span class="mode-card__badge mode-card__badge--primary">Dedicated Workspace</span>
<code class="mode-card__endpoint">/seller/vendor-dashboard/</code>
</div>
<div class="mode-card__header">
<div class="mode-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M9 3v18"/><path d="M14 9h4"/><path d="M14 15h4"/></svg>
</div>
<div class="mode-card__titles">
<p class="mode-card__title">Separate Dashboard</p>
<p>Full-screen standalone merchant console</p>
</div>
</div>

## Separate Dashboard

The Separate Dashboard delivers an expansive, distraction-free environment tailored for high-volume store operations.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Separate Seller Dashboard Workspace" /></a>

### 1. Top Navigation Bar

The top bar remains pinned across all seller screens for quick navigation:

- **Sidebar Toggle:** Collapses or expands the navigation sidebar to maximize screen space for tables and charts.
- **Store Identity:** Displays the vendor's store logo and shop name (e.g., *Aurora Athletics*).
- **Global Search:** Allows searching orders, products, and customer queries from anywhere in the panel.
- **Notifications Bell:** Displays real-time alerts for incoming orders, customer inquiries, and administrator announcements.
- **User Account Menu:** Direct dropdown to edit profile details, change passwords, or log out.

---

### 2. Collapsible Sidebar Navigation

The sidebar organizes all marketplace operations into logical functional groups:

- **Dashboard:** Executive performance overview, KPI cards, charts, and operational queues.
- **Store Edit:** Public storefront profile, banner upload, store hours, social links, and [KYC verification](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-kyc.html).
- **Catalog:**
  - *List Your Product:* Quick access to product creation.
  - *Products:* Catalog management grid, 12-criteria filter drawer, and barcode actions.
  - *Add Product:* Structured 3-step product creation wizard.
  - *Bulk Upload:* CSV spreadsheet imports for products and catalog offers.
  - *Search Products (Select & Sell):* Search and sell existing catalog products.
- **Inventories:**
  - *Manage Inventory:* Inline stock quantity, SKU, GTIN, and stock status editing.
  - *Manage Pricing:* Inline regular price, sale price, and calendar date scheduler.
- **Sales:**
  - *Order History:* Vendor order ledger, filter drawer, and dispatch scheduling.
  - *Transactions & Earnings:* Payout transaction ledger and remaining balance.
  - *Store Pickup Orders:* Store pickup order list and customer OTP code verification.
- **Performance:**
  - *Account Health:* Health score (Healthy, At Risk, Unhealthy) and cancellation rate metrics.
  - *Seller Reviews:* Customer reviews and feedback ratings for your store.
  - *Product Reviews:* Customer ratings left on your products.
- **Reporting:**
  - *Sales Reports:* Visual revenue, commission, and vendor earnings charts.
  - *Product Reports:* Best-selling products and stock depletion rates.
  - *Customer Reports:* Buyer statistics and repeat purchase metrics.
- **Customers:**
  - *All Customers:* Comprehensive customer directory with lifetime spend totals.
  - *Shop Followers:* Manage followers and broadcast in-app notifications or emails.
- **Communication:**
  - *Ask Admin:* Support ticketing system between the vendor and the marketplace administrator.
  - *Admin News:* Official announcements published by the marketplace administrator.
- **Vendor Staff:** Sub-account management with a 40-item delegatable permissions matrix. See the full [Vendor Staff Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-staff.html).
- **Vacation:** Schedule temporary store closings and configure purchase blocking. See [Vacation Mode](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-vacation.html).
- **Settings:**
  - *General:* Account credentials and password updates.
  - *Site Setting:* Product form navigation layouts (Horizontal Tabs, Vertical Tabs, Stacked Form).
  - *Graph Setting:* Custom color palette picker for charts and graphs.

---

### 3. Dashboard Widgets & Key Metrics

The home screen (`/seller/vendor-dashboard/`) presents actionable data to help vendors make informed merchandising decisions:

#### Overall Details (KPI Metric Cards)
Eight real-time summary cards provide an immediate snapshot of your business:
- **Total Sales:** Lifetime gross sales value generated by your items.
- **Total Orders:** Total number of customer orders received.
- **Total Customers:** Unique buyers who have purchased from your store.
- **Average Order Sell:** Average order value across completed transactions.
- **Total Payout:** Total amount disbursed to you by the marketplace administrator.
- **Remaining Payout:** Net earnings currently available for withdrawal.
- **Customer Feedback:** Your store's average customer review rating (e.g., 4.8 / 5.0).
- **Account Health:** Operational standing badge (e.g., *Healthy · 98/100*).

---

#### Action Required Queue
Surfaces pressing operational roadblocks that require immediate attention:
- **Pending Orders:** Orders waiting for seller review or payment confirmation.
- **Orders to Ship:** Processing orders ready for packing and dispatch.
- **Low Stock:** Products that have reached or dropped below their low-stock threshold.
- **Notifications:** Unread administrative notices or customer queries.

Clicking any item in the queue filters and displays those records instantly.

---

#### Profile Score Banner
An interactive circular SVG progress gauge that calculates your profile completeness percentage:
- Evaluates essential store assets: logo, banner, store hours, return policy, shipping policy, privacy policy, and social links.
- Click **Complete Your Profile** to jump directly to any missing sections under [Vendor Profile](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-profile.html).

---

#### Interactive Performance Charts
Visualizes sales, orders, and customer acquisition over time:
- **Chart Mode Switching:** Toggle between **Line**, **Bar**, and **Area** charts for sales and commission data.
- **Order Status Distribution:** View order statuses (*Completed*, *Processing*, *On Hold*, *Canceled*) as an interactive **Doughnut**, **Pie**, or **Bar** chart.
- **Date Range Presets:** Filter data by *Today*, *Yesterday*, *Last 7 Days*, *Last 30 Days*, *This Month*, *Last Month*, or choose custom start and end dates.

---

#### Trends & Comparative Analytics
Compares current performance against the preceding period (e.g., *October* vs. *September*), providing visual trendlines and percentage delta badges for revenue, orders, and new customers.

---

#### Recent Orders & Top Selling Products
- **Recent Orders Table:** Quick overview of the latest orders with Order ID, customer name, placement date, order total, status, and direct view links.
- **Top 5 Selling Products:** Highlights your best-performing products by units sold and revenue.

---

## Customizing Form Layouts (Site Settings)

Vendors using the separate dedicated dashboard can customize how their product editing forms are presented by navigating to:

**Settings > Site Setting** (`/seller/seller-site-setting/`)

### Form Navigation Layout Options

| Layout Mode | Description | Recommended For |
|---|---|---|
| **Horizontal Tabs** | Displays product sections (General, Inventory, Shipping, Attributes, etc.) as horizontal tabs across the top of the form. | Standard desktop displays and widescreen monitors. |
| **Vertical Tabs** | Displays product sections in a vertical sidebar navigation menu on the left side of the form. | Rapid switching between complex variable product configurations. |
| **Stacked Form** | Displays all sections as vertically stacked, expandable accordion cards on a single scrollable page. | Streamlined, continuous editing without tab switching. |

Additional display options:
- **Product Stepper:** Show or hide the 3-step progress bar on product creation forms.
- **Listing Completeness:** Show or hide the real-time listing completeness score meter on the product edit screen.

---

## Customizing Chart Colors (Graph Settings)

Vendors can personalize the color palette used in dashboard charts and visual reports:

Navigate to: **Settings > Graph Setting** (`/seller/seller-graph-setting/`)

Vendors can select a module and pick custom accent colors using the interactive color picker:
1. **Dashboard:** Customize line, bar, and accent colors for sales, commission, and order status charts.
2. **Reports:** Customize series colors for Sales, Product, and Customer reports.
3. **Transactions:** Customize colors for withdrawal and payout charts.
4. **Performance:** Customize Account Health gauge and rating breakdown charts.
5. **Products:** Customize stock level and completeness graphs.

---

## Default Dashboard

When the separate dedicated dashboard is not enabled—or when a vendor prefers the native theme layout—the vendor dashboard is accessed directly from WooCommerce My Account:

**My Account > Vendor Dashboard** (`/my-account/vendor-dashboard/`)

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-dashboard.webp" alt="Default WooCommerce My Account Vendor Dashboard View" /></a>

The **Default Dashboard** allows vendors to manage marketplace activities and access core management features directly within your store's native WordPress theme.

### Core Sections & Menu Links

The default dashboard menu provides direct access to all essential merchant operations:

- **Reports**: View quick infographic reports, lifetime sales, total payouts, remaining balance, and refunded totals.
- **Order History**: Track complete customer order history, view order details, and follow dispatch statuses.
- **Transactions**: Review detailed transaction records including Transaction IDs, dates, and disbursed amounts.
- **Notifications**: Stay updated on order alerts, product status updates, and administrative announcements.
- **Shop Followers**: View your shop's follower list and broadcast updates to interested buyers.
- **My Profile**: Update vendor store details, shop banners, opening hours, policies, and KYC verification documents.
- **Ask to Admin**: Direct ticketing system to submit queries to the marketplace administrator and track responses.

### Features of the Default Dashboard

- **Native Theme Compatibility:** Renders directly within your theme's layout, maintaining your site's header, footer, and styling.
- **My Account Navigation:** Vendor links appear alongside standard customer account tabs (*Orders*, *Downloads*, *Addresses*, *Account Details*).
- **Tabular Summaries:** Clean tabular summaries of recent orders, products, and commission totals.
- **Full Capabilities:** Every core marketplace capability—product management, order fulfillment, inventory management, and payouts—remains fully accessible.

---

## How to Switch Between Dashboard Views

Vendors can switch between the two dashboard views seamlessly:

- **Switching to Default Dashboard:** From the Separate Dashboard (`/seller/`), click the **Classic view** button at the bottom of the sidebar. You will be redirected immediately to the Default My Account vendor view (`/my-account/vendor-dashboard/`).
- **Switching to Separate Dashboard:** From the Default My Account view, click the dedicated dashboard banner or link to return to the full-screen console (`/seller/vendor-dashboard/`).

# Separate WP-Admin Dashboard

The **Separate WP-Admin Dashboard** provides marketplace sellers with a dedicated, isolated WordPress backend environment. When enabled, vendors manage their products, orders, transactions, store profile, and customer communication directly within a secure, custom-tailored WordPress administration interface.

This separate interface keeps vendor operations completely independent from platform administration, ensuring that sellers only access features relevant to their store.

---

## Enabling Separate Vendor Dashboard

Marketplace administrators can easily enable or disable the separate backend dashboard from the WordPress administration panel:

1. Navigate to **Marketplace > Settings > General**.
2. Locate the **Separate Vendor Dashboard** setting checkbox.
3. Check the box to activate the separate dashboard for all registered marketplace vendors.
4. Click **Save Changes** at the bottom of the page.

---

## Access Control & Security Isolation

The Separate WP-Admin Dashboard is designed specifically for marketplace vendors. To protect marketplace security and keep the workspace simple and focused, menu options are automatically filtered:

### Hidden Administrative Areas
To prevent accidental changes to core site configuration, general site settings are hidden from vendors:
- **Tools**
- **Global Media Library**
- **Standard WordPress Posts & Pages**
- **WooCommerce Core Settings & Store Reports**
- **Plugins, Themes, and Site User Management**

### Available Vendor Menus

Vendors have access only to the store-specific tools required for day-to-day operations:

- **Dashboard**: Welcome screen and high-level store overview.
- **Products**: Catalog management restricted to the vendor's own items:
  - **All Products**: View, search, and edit published products.
  - **Add new product**: Create new physical, variable, virtual, or downloadable products.
- **Marketplace**: The core vendor management suite, containing the following dedicated sections:
  - **Reports**: Main analytics dashboard displaying total sales, orders, customer metrics, performance graphs, and recent store activity.
  - **Order History**: Complete order ledger to inspect customer details, monitor fulfillment status, and enter tracking numbers.
  - **Transactions**: Financial statement tracking gross earnings, platform commission deductions, and payout disbursements.
  - **Notifications**: Real-time activity log for new orders, customer reviews, and marketplace announcements.
  - **Shop Followers**: Directory of customers following your shop, with options for direct audience outreach.
  - **My Profile**: Storefront profile manager to customize store logo, banner, biography, contact info, social links, and payout methods.
  - **Ask to admin**: Direct inquiry channel to send support questions to marketplace administrators and view conversation history.
  - **Select And Sell**: Quick catalog tool to claim and sell pre-existing marketplace products without creating listings from scratch.
- **Comments**: Product reviews and ratings submitted by buyers.
- **Profile**: Personal user account settings, email address, and password management.

---

## Managing Products for Vendors

Vendors can manage their approved products directly from the WordPress administration panel using WooCommerce's native product editor. The catalog is strictly isolated, ensuring sellers only see and edit their own merchandise under **Products > All Products** and **Products > Add new product**.

::: tip Official WooCommerce Product Guides for New Vendors
To help new vendors quickly learn how to create and manage their store items, refer to the official WooCommerce documentation:

- **[Overview: Managing Products in WooCommerce](https://woocommerce.com/document/managing-products/)**  
  Learn the foundations of product management, including catalog visibility, inventory status, product categories, and attributes.

- **[Step-by-Step: Adding a Simple Product](https://woocommerce.com/document/managing-products/add-product/#adding-a-simple-product)**  
  A detailed walkthrough covering product titles, descriptions, regular and sale pricing, inventory tracking (SKU and stock status), shipping dimensions, and product gallery images.
:::
