# Ask To Admin

The **Ask To Admin** feature allows vendors to directly communicate with the marketplace admin for queries, clarifications, or support.

Clear communication between vendors and marketplace administrators is essential for smooth store operations. Whether a vendor needs help with payouts, order processing, commission rates, or account settings, the **Ask To Admin** module provides a dedicated helpdesk system right inside the vendor dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-asktoadmin-list-view.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-asktoadmin-list-view.png" alt="Vendor Ask To Admin Dashboard" /></a>

---

## Ask To Admin Overview

- Vendors can inquire about anything related to the marketplace.
- This option is available in the **vendor dashboard** under **Communication → Ask Admin** (accessible directly at `/seller/vendor-asktoadmin/`).

### Quick Navigation Path

1. Log into your **Vendor Account**.
2. Open the **Seller Dashboard**.
3. In the sidebar navigation menu, locate the **Communication** section.
4. Click on **Ask Admin**.

---

## Queries List Management

The main **Ask Admin** dashboard displays an organized table containing all previous and ongoing inquiries raised by the vendor.

### Search Queries by Subject

At the top of the table, vendors can use the **Search by subject** input field. Simply type a keyword or subject title and press enter to quickly locate specific past conversations without scrolling through the entire list.

### Queries Table Columns

| Column | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Date** | Displays the date and time when the query was initially created. Click the column heading to sort chronologically in ascending or descending order. |
| **Subject** | The title of the inquiry submitted by the vendor. Clicking on the subject link opens the full conversation thread. |
| **Message** | A preview snippet of the initial query text submitted by the vendor. |
| **Status** | Shows the current resolution state of the query (such as **Open** or **Answered**). |
| **Last Reply** | Indicates the date and time of the latest reply from either the admin or the vendor. Click to sort queries by latest activity. |

::: tip Quick Access to Query Details
Vendors can open any query conversation by clicking directly on either the **Date** or the **Subject** link in the table row.
:::

---

## How Vendors Ask a Query

- Navigate to **Ask To Admin** from the vendor dashboard.
- Click on the **Ask Query** button to raise a new query.

---

## Submit a Query

When clicking the **Ask Query** button, a clean popup modal appears with the intro message: *"Send your question to the store admin and we will get back to you shortly."*

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-ask-query-modal.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-ask-query-modal.png" alt="Vendor Ask Query Modal Popup" /></a>

Vendors need to fill in two required fields:

1. **Subject**: Enter a clear, concise title that summarizes your inquiry (e.g., *"Payout has not arrived"* or *"Shipping zone rate inquiry"*).
2. **Message**: Write a detailed explanation of your question or issue. Include helpful details such as order numbers, payout references, or product names so the admin can assist you faster.
3. Click on the **Ask** (or **Submit**) button to send the query.

::: warning Form Validation
Both **Subject** and **Message** are mandatory. If a vendor attempts to submit an empty form, the system highlights the missing fields with an error message to prevent accidental blank submissions.
:::

---

## Admin Notification & Threaded Chat

- Once the vendor submits the query:
  - The **admin receives an email notification** regarding the vendor’s query.
- **Threaded "Ask a Question to Admin"**: Vendor and admin replies form a chat-style thread on both the storefront and the admin panel, keeping the conversation history organized and easy to track.

---

## Threaded Conversation & Replying to Queries

Clicking on any query from the table opens the dedicated conversation view (`?view_query=<query_id>`). This interface offers a chat-like messaging experience that keeps the communication history intact.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-asktoadmin-thread-view.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-asktoadmin-thread-view.png" alt="Vendor Ask to Admin Conversation Thread View" /></a>

### Features of the Thread View

1. **Back Navigation**: Click the **Back** button at the top header to return to the queries list at any time.
2. **Admin Profile Header**: The top of the thread displays the admin card with the marketplace logo, name (**Admin**), and designated role (**Marketplace Admin**).
3. **Date Dividers**: Messages are automatically grouped by date dividers (such as *September 19, 2026*, *October 12, 2026*) so you can easily follow the timeline of events.
4. **Chat Bubbles & Role Identification**:
   - **Vendor Messages**: Appear on the vendor's side with your store name, exact time (e.g., *8:55 am*), and your question.
   - **Admin Replies**: Appear on the administrator's side with the Admin label, exact time (e.g., *2:20 pm*), and the response.

### Sending Follow-up Replies

If you need more details or wish to continue the conversation:

1. Scroll to the bottom of the conversation thread.
2. Locate the **Your Reply** text box with the placeholder *"Type your reply..."*.
3. Type your response or answer to the admin's question.
4. Click the **Send Reply** button.
5. Your reply is added immediately to the bottom of the active conversation thread without creating a separate new inquiry.

---

## Query Status Lifecycle

The query status gives vendors transparency into the progress of their inquiries:

| Status | Meaning | Recommended Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| <span class="wkmp-v2-badge wkmp-v2-badge--warning">Open</span> | The query has been submitted and is awaiting administrator review or an ongoing conversation is active. | No action required; wait for admin response or add helpful updates if new information arises. |
| <span class="wkmp-v2-badge wkmp-v2-badge--info">Answered</span> | The marketplace admin has reviewed the query and posted a reply. | Check the response in the thread. If the issue is solved, no further action is needed; otherwise, reply in the thread. |
| <span class="wkmp-v2-badge wkmp-v2-badge--success">Closed / Resolved</span> | The inquiry has been fully addressed and completed. | If you encounter a new, unrelated issue, raise a fresh query via **Ask Query**. |

---

## Best Practices for Vendors

To ensure fast and effective responses from the marketplace admin, keep these tips in mind:

- **Use Descriptive Subjects**: Instead of generic titles like *"Help"* or *"Issue"*, use specific topics like *"Tax document request for Order #1042"* or *"Payout reference clarification"*.
- **Include Reference Numbers**: Whenever discussing orders, commission discrepancies, or payouts, mention the specific reference numbers or order IDs.
- **Keep Discussions in One Thread**: If an issue requires multiple follow-ups, reply inside the existing thread rather than creating multiple separate queries for the same topic.
- **Check Spam / Notifications**: Ensure your account email is up to date so you do not miss email alerts when the admin responds.

---

## Benefits

- Direct communication channel between vendor and admin.
- Helps vendors resolve issues or doubts quickly.
- Improves overall marketplace support and transparency.
- Maintains a clean, permanent audit trail of all questions and solutions for future reference.

# General Setting

The **General Setting** screen allows marketplace vendors to manage their personal user account credentials, login email address, profile avatar, and account password within the dedicated seller panel.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-general-settings-overview.png"><img src="./assets/seller-general-settings-overview.png" alt="Vendor General Setting Overview in Seller Panel" /></a>

::: tip Account Settings vs. Store Edit
It is important to understand the difference between **General Setting** and **Store Edit**:
- **Settings > General (`/seller/edit-account/`)**: Controls your **personal user account** (your login email, account password, personal name, and profile picture).
- **Store Edit (`/seller/vendor-profile/`)**: Controls your **public storefront** (your shop logo, store banner, shop description, business address, store hours, payment payout methods, and return policies).
:::

---

## Accessing General Settings

To open your personal account settings in the seller panel:

1. Sign in to your **Vendor Account** on the marketplace.
2. From the left sidebar navigation, locate the **Settings** menu.
3. Click **General** from the submenu.
4. You will arrive at the **General Setting** page (`/seller/edit-account/`).

You can also track your exact location using the breadcrumb trail displayed at the top of the workspace:  
`Dashboard > Settings > General`

---

## Managing Your Account Details

The account details form lets you keep your personal contact information accurate and up to date.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-general-settings-form.png"><img src="./assets/seller-general-settings-form.png" alt="Vendor Edit Account Form" /></a>

### 1. Profile Avatar Image

At the top of the form, you can personalize your merchant profile with an avatar picture:

- **Add an Avatar**: If no photo is set, click the circular **Add Image** icon (with the camera symbol) to select an image from your computer.
- **Update Existing Photo**: Hover over your current profile picture and click the **Delete (Bin)** icon to remove it, then click **Add Image** to upload a replacement photo.
- **Accepted Formats**: Standard web image formats (`JPG`, `PNG`, `WebP`).
- **Recommended Dimensions**: A square image (for example, `256 × 256 px` or `512 × 512 px`) ensures your photo displays cleanly across circular badges and headers.

### 2. Account Information Fields

The account form contains the following required fields:

| Field | Required | Description | Best Practice |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **First name** | Yes (`*`) | Your given first name. | Use your legal or business primary contact name. |
| **Last name** | Yes (`*`) | Your family surname. | Ensures clear identity verification on customer receipts and administrative records. |
| **Display name** | Yes (`*`) | How your name appears publicly in account headers, review responses, and comments. | Choose a recognizable name for buyers and marketplace staff. |
| **Email address** | Yes (`*`) | The primary email address linked to your user account. | Used for signing in, receiving order alerts, low stock notices, and password reset links. Ensure this inbox is monitored daily. |

::: warning Updating Your Email Address
Changing your email address updates your primary login username for future sign-ins. Make sure you enter a valid, active email address so you do not miss critical customer inquiries or order updates.
:::

---

## Updating Your Password

You can change your password at any time directly from the **Password change** section located on the same page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-general-settings-password.png"><img src="./assets/seller-general-settings-password.png" alt="Password Change Section" /></a>

### Step-by-Step Password Update:

1. Scroll down to the **Password change** fieldset.
2. Enter your credentials into the three password fields:
   - **Current password (leave blank to leave unchanged)**: Type your existing password. *(Required only when setting a new password).*
   - **New password (leave blank to leave unchanged)**: Type your desired new password.
   - **Confirm new password**: Re-type the exact same new password to verify there are no typographical errors.
3. Click the **Save changes** button at the bottom of the form.

::: tip Password Security Best Practices
To keep your store secure from unauthorized access:
- Use at least **10 to 12 characters**.
- Combine uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols (such as `@`, `#`, `$`, `%`).
- Avoid using common phrases, your shop name, or predictable personal dates.
- If you do not wish to update your password when changing your name or email, simply leave all three password fields empty.
:::

---

## Saving Changes & Confirmation

Once you have filled out your updated information:

1. Click the primary **Save changes** button at the bottom left of the form.
2. The page reloads and displays a green confirmation message at the top:
   > *"Account details changed successfully."*
3. If any required information is missing (such as an empty First name or an invalid email format), the browser alerts you immediately to correct the field before saving.

---

## Global Search & Header Navigation

While on the **General Setting** screen, you also have access to the seller panel's top navigation utilities:

- **Quick Search Bar (`Search Orders/Products`)**: Located in the upper header bar. You can type any product title, SKU, or order ID and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to jump straight to filtered results in your product catalog or order history without navigating away.
- **Sidebar Navigation**: Easily switch to other settings categories such as **Graph Setting** (for customizing chart colors) or **Site Setting** (for choosing product form navigation styles).
- **Classic View Switcher**: Click the **Classic view** button at the bottom of the left sidebar if you prefer using the traditional WooCommerce My Account layout instead of the full-screen panel.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Does changing my display name here change my public shop name?
No. Your public shop name and brand identity are configured under **Store Edit** (`/seller/vendor-profile/`). The display name in General Settings only applies to your personal user profile, review replies, and account navigation.

### What should I do if I forget my current password?
If you cannot remember your current password to complete the change form, log out of your account, click the **Lost your password?** link on the login screen, and follow the email reset link sent to your registered email address.

### Can staff members edit my General Settings?
Only users with granted permissions can access account settings. By default, vendor team sub-accounts cannot access sensitive owner credentials. For details on customizing team capabilities, see the [Vendor Staff Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/vendor-staff).

# Graph Setting

The **Graph Setting** page (`/seller/seller-graph-setting/`) allows vendors to personalize the appearance and visual styling of dashboard charts, analytics widgets, financial sparklines, and reporting graphs.

Vendors can navigate to this screen from the vendor panel menu under **Settings → Graph Setting**.

---

## Overview

Marketplace vendors often rely on charts and graphs to quickly monitor their store performance, sales revenue, customer growth, and product catalog quality. With **Graph Setting**, each vendor can customize color palettes and chart types to fit their personal visual preferences or brand colors.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-graph-setting-overview.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-graph-setting-overview.png" alt="Vendor Graph Setting Cards Overview" /></a>

The Graph Setting hub organizes all customizable visual elements into five dedicated cards:

| Section Card | Associated Endpoints | Total Graphs | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Dashboard** | `vendor-dashboard` | 15 | Sales vs. commission, trends, customer comparisons, order statuses, country map, profile score, and stat card sparklines. |
| **Reports** | `seller-reporting-sales`, `seller-reporting-products`, `seller-reporting-customers` | 10 | Comprehensive reporting graphs for revenue, taxes, payment methods, units sold, and customer metrics. |
| **Transactions** | `vendor-transactions` | 5 | Micro sparkline graphs displayed across payout, withdrawal, and refund summary cards. |
| **Performance** | `seller-account-health` | 1 | The Account Health Score gauge meter and status thresholds. |
| **Products** | `vendor-edit-product` | 1 | The Listing Completeness progress bar displayed on the product edit screen. |

---

## Common Features Across Graph Setting Cards

Each card page is designed with an intuitive two-column layout:
- **Left Column (Live Preview)**: Displays an interactive, real-time preview of the actual card or chart widget as it appears in the seller panel.
- **Right Column (Graph Settings)**: Provides chart type selections and individual color pickers.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-graph-setting-dashboard.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-graph-setting-dashboard.png" alt="Vendor Graph Setting Dashboard Configuration" /></a>

### Key Controls & Actions:

- **Chart Type Switcher**: Choose your preferred data visualization mode where available (for example, **Bar**, **Line**, or **Area** for trend charts; **Doughnut**, **Pie**, or **Bar** for status breakdowns).
- **Interactive Color Pickers**: Click any color box to open the native color selector, or type any valid HEX color code directly.
- **Default Color Label**: Each color setting clearly displays its original default HEX value (e.g., `Default #a1b5f5`) for easy reference.
- **Single Color Reset (`↻`)**: Click the rotate icon button next to any color picker to instantly revert that single color back to its factory default without reloading the page.
- **Save Changes**: Click the primary **Save Changes** button at the bottom of the section to save your adjustments.
- **Reset section to default**: Click the ghost button to reset all chart styles and color pickers in that card back to their default theme settings after confirming the prompt.
- **Back Button**: Located at the top right of the page header to quickly return to the main Graph Setting hub.

---

## 1. Dashboard Graphs

Vendors can access this section by selecting **Dashboard** on the hub or visiting `/seller/seller-graph-setting/?wkmp_card=dashboard`.

This section controls the 15 visual elements shown on the main vendor dashboard:

### Comparison & Trend Charts
- **Sales vs Commission**: Compare gross sales volume against marketplace commission. Vendors can switch between **Bar (default)**, **Line**, and **Area** formats, and customize the **Sales** and **Commission** colors.
- **Customers vs Orders**: Track customer growth alongside order frequency using **Bar (default)**, **Line**, or **Area** layouts with separate colors for **Customers** and **Orders**.
- **Trends: Sales**: View daily, weekly, or monthly sales trajectories using **Bar (default)**, **Line**, or **Area** graphs.
- **Trends: Orders**: Monitor order count trends over time with customizable **Bar (default)**, **Line**, or **Area** representations.

### Order Status Distribution
- **Order Status Chart**: Displays the breakdown of store orders by fulfillment status.
- **Supported Layouts**: **Doughnut (default)**, **Pie**, or **Bar**.
- **Customizable Status Colors**:
  - **Completed** (Default `#34d298`)
  - **Pending** (Default `#fdc700`)
  - **Processing** (Default `#8ec5ff`)
  - **Cancelled** (Default `#cad5e2`)
  - **Refunded** (Default `#7c86ff`)
  - **Failed** (Default `#ff6467`)
  - **Other statuses** (Default `#dddddd`)

### Geographic & Profile Analytics
- **Top Billing Countries Map**: Interactive world map illustrating where store orders originate. Vendors can configure:
  - **With sales**: Highlight color for countries generating orders (Default `#0a0a0a`).
  - **Without sales**: Base land color for countries without orders (Default `#f5f5f5`).
- **Profile Score**: Circular arc meter showing vendor profile completion percentage:
  - **Score Progress**: Arc indicator fill color (Default `#a1b5f5`).
  - **Track Background**: Arc background circle color (Default `#ebebeb`).

### Stat Card Sparklines (8 Metric Cards)
Each summary card at the top of the vendor dashboard contains a subtle sparkline curve:
- **Total Sales**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Total Orders**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Total Customers**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Average Order Sell**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Total Payout**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Remaining Payout**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Customer Feedback**: Sparkline stroke color.
- **Account Health**: Sparkline stroke color.

### How It Works on the Product Edit Page:
- When a vendor creates or edits a product (`vendor-edit-product`), the **Listing Completeness** card appears near the top of the form.
- The progress bar dynamically calculates the product completeness score (e.g., 35%, 60%, 100%) based on vital fields like product title, featured image, categories, price, short description, and attributes.
- Vendors can expand the missing details checklist to see exactly which fields need attention to optimize their product visibility in marketplace search and category filters.
- The colors customized in **Graph Setting → Products** reflect directly on this progress bar across all product edit screens.

## Summary of Graph Settings Workflow

1. Navigate to **Settings → Graph Setting** from the vendor sidebar menu.
2. Select the card section you wish to customize: **Dashboard**, **Reports**, **Transactions**, **Performance**, or **Products**.
3. Choose your preferred **Chart Type** (Bar, Line, Area, Doughnut, Pie) for supported graphs.
4. Select desired hues using the **Color Pickers**, or click the **Reset (`↻`)** button next to any color to revert it individually.
5. Click **Save Changes** at the bottom of the page to apply the updates immediately.
6. To restore an entire card back to default settings at any time, click **Reset section to default** and confirm the prompt.

# Site Setting

The **Site Setting** page (`/seller/seller-site-setting/`) allows vendors to personalize their product authoring workflow, selecting between stepper wizards and single-page forms, and adjusting layout modes when enabled by marketplace administrators.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-site-setting-overview.png"><img src="./assets/seller-site-setting-overview.png" alt="Vendor Site Setting Overview in Seller Panel" /></a>

::: tip Personal Workflow Preferences
The options configured on the **Site Setting** screen apply exclusively to your personal vendor dashboard session. Adjusting these settings tailors your product editing workspace to match your preferred data-entry style without altering how products appear to buyers on the live storefront.
:::

---

## Overview of Site Settings

Every merchant manages their product inventory differently. Some sellers prefer a guided step-by-step process that verifies required details before moving forward, while others prefer having all fields visible on one continuous page for fast editing.

The **Site Setting** module provides three primary controls:

1. **Product Stepper**: Toggles a guided 3-stage progress indicator across product creation and editing screens.
2. **Listing Completeness**: Displays an interactive listing health gauge that scores your product content from 0% to 100% and points out missing information.
3. **Form Navigation**: Changes the structural layout of the product editor between **Horizontal Tabs**, **Vertical Tabs**, and a continuous **Stacked Form**.

---

## Administrator Governance (Vendor Mode)

The availability of the **Site Setting** menu depends on marketplace-wide governance set by the store administrator:

- **When Vendor Mode Is Enabled**: Marketplace administrators enable the *Vendor Mode* setting in the central store configuration. As a result, the **Settings > Site Setting** menu appears in your vendor sidebar. Your personal selections override the marketplace default layout for your account.
- **When Vendor Mode Is Disabled**: If the administrator manages product layouts globally, the **Site Setting** menu is hidden from the seller panel. In this scenario, all marketplace vendors share the standardized form layout and stepper mode set by the administrator.

::: note Admin Configuration Reference
Marketplace administrators can configure default form presentations and activate vendor customization under **Marketplace > Settings > Product > Product Form Settings**. For complete administrative instructions, refer to the [Admin Product Settings Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/product-settings).
:::

---

## Accessing Site Setting

To open and manage your product form preferences:

1. Log in to your **Vendor Account** on the marketplace.
2. In the left-hand navigation sidebar, click the **Settings** menu.
3. Select **Site Setting** from the submenu.
4. You will arrive at the **Site Setting** workspace (`/seller/seller-site-setting/`).

The breadcrumb trail at the top of your screen will confirm your location:  
`Dashboard > Settings > Site Setting`

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-site-setting-card.png"><img src="./assets/seller-site-setting-card.png" alt="Vendor Site Setting Product Form Options" /></a>

---

## Configuring Product Form Options

The **Product Form** configuration panel includes three distinct settings. Below is a detailed description of each control and how it influences your workflow.

### 1. Product Stepper

- **Control Type**: Toggle Switch (`On` / `Off`).
- **Default Status**: Enabled.
- **Description**: Displays the guided 3-stage milestone indicator at the top of both the **Add Product** and **Edit Product** screens.

The stepper breaks the listing creation process into three logical milestones:

1. **Step 1: Product Basics** – Enter the product name, select product type (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External), assign categories, and set base pricing.
2. **Step 2: Product Details** – Define inventory SKU, manage stock levels, configure shipping dimensions/weight, and specify tax classes.
3. **Step 3: Complete Listing** – Provide short and long descriptions, upload product and gallery images, assign attributes, configure tags, and set catalog visibility.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Step1["Step 1: Product Basics\n(Title, Type, Category, Price)"] --> Step2["Step 2: Product Details\n(SKU, Stock, Shipping, Tax)"]
    Step2 --> Step3["Step 3: Complete Listing\n(Images, Description, Attributes, Status)"]
```

::: tip When to Keep the Stepper Enabled
- **Recommended for New Vendors**: The milestone bar ensures no essential sales details (such as weight, SKU, or return policies) are overlooked.
- **When to Disable**: Experienced merchants managing rapid inventory updates often disable the stepper to maximize vertical screen space.
:::

---

### 2. Listing Completeness

- **Control Type**: Toggle Switch (`On` / `Off`).
- **Default Status**: Enabled.
- **Description**: Displays an interactive quality score card and progress bar on the **Edit Product** screen.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-listing-completeness-gauge.png"><img src="./assets/seller-listing-completeness-gauge.png" alt="Vendor Listing Completeness Score Card and Missing Fields Jump Links" /></a>

The **Listing Completeness** widget acts as a real-time listing assistant:

- **Visual Score Bar**: Displays an exact completion percentage (for example, `35%` or `100%`) alongside a color-coded status bar.
- **Collapsible Checklist (`Missing Details`)**: Clicking the summary reveals an itemized list of unfulfilled elements required for an optimal listing, such as:
  - Short description
  - Primary product image
  - Product image gallery
  - Product tags
  - Regular price
  - Inventory SKU
  - Shipping weight
  - Shipping dimensions
- **Interactive Quick-Jump Links**: Each missing item functions as a direct jump button. Clicking any listed item automatically scrolls the page and focuses your cursor directly into that input field.

::: tip Commercial Benefit of 100% Completeness
Complete product listings achieve higher organic rankings in marketplace searches, provide complete product specifications for search engine rich snippets, and significantly reduce buyer inquiries and return rates.
:::

---

### 3. Form Navigation

- **Control Type**: Dropdown Selection Menu.
- **Options**:
  - `Horizontal Tabs` *(Default)*
  - `Vertical Tabs`
  - `Stacked Form`
- **Description**: Controls how different product configuration sections (such as General, Inventory, Shipping, Attributes, and Variations) are arranged on screen.

Below is an in-depth breakdown of how each layout option behaves in practice.

---

## Product Form Navigation Layouts

Choosing the right navigation mode streamlines your day-to-day listing workflow. You can switch between these three layouts at any time without losing saved product data.

### Option A: Horizontal Tabs (Default)

In **Horizontal Tabs** mode, product sections are organized into a row of horizontal tabs across the top of the editor.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-product-edit-horizontal.png"><img src="./assets/seller-product-edit-horizontal.png" alt="Product Edit Screen with Horizontal Tabs Layout" /></a>

- **Visual Arrangement**: Tabs (`Edit`, `Inventory`, `Shipping`, `Linked Products`, `Attributes`, `Tags & Brand`, `Status`) sit horizontally above the active card. Previous (`<`) and Next (`>`) arrow buttons allow easy scrolling across wide tab lists.
- **Display Behavior**: Only the selected section card is visible at any given moment. Clicking another tab smoothly swaps the visible container.
- **Best Suited For**: Standard widescreen desktop displays and laptops where vertical screen space is precious.

---

### Option B: Vertical Tabs

In **Vertical Tabs** mode, product navigation tabs are arranged into a vertical column on the left side of the product editor.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-product-edit-vertical.png"><img src="./assets/seller-product-edit-vertical.png" alt="Product Edit Screen with Vertical Tabs Layout" /></a>

- **Visual Arrangement**: The navigation menu stays fixed along the left margin, while the active section content occupies the main workspace on the right.
- **Display Behavior**: Clicking a vertical tab instantly loads the corresponding panel in the main content card.
- **Best Suited For**: Ultrawide monitors and desktop workstations where horizontal room is plentiful, providing rapid one-click navigation between deep attribute and variation settings.

---

### Option C: Stacked Form

In **Stacked Form** mode, all tab bars are removed. Every product section is rendered continuously down a single, scrollable page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-product-edit-stacked.png"><img src="./assets/seller-product-edit-stacked.png" alt="Product Edit Screen with Stacked Form Layout" /></a>

- **Visual Arrangement**: All section cards (`Edit`, `Inventory`, `Shipping`, `Status`, `Linked Products`, `Attributes`, `Tags & Brand`, `Variations`) are fully visible and stacked sequentially.
- **Display Behavior**: You can scroll through the entire product definition from top to bottom without clicking tabs.
- **Best Suited For**: Tablet devices, touchscreen monitors, or vendors who prefer reviewing and editing all product parameters in a continuous linear document.

---

### Form Navigation Comparison Matrix

| Feature / Criteria | Horizontal Tabs | Vertical Tabs | Stacked Form |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tab Position** | Top of the form card | Left column beside form | None (Tabs disabled) |
| **Sections Displayed** | Single active section | Single active section | All sections visible |
| **Page Scrolling** | Minimal vertical scrolling | Minimal vertical scrolling | Full-page vertical scroll |
| **Recommended Display** | Standard Laptops / Desktops | Ultrawide / Desktop monitors | Tablets / Touchscreens |
| **Switching Speed** | Quick tab click | Instant one-click jump | Fast mouse-wheel scroll |

---

## Step-by-Step Configuration Guide

Follow these steps to update and verify your product authoring settings:

1. Navigate to **Settings > Site Setting** in your seller panel.
2. To enable or disable the 3-step creation wizard, toggle the **Product stepper** switch.
3. To display or hide the quality progress bar, toggle the **Listing Completeness** switch.
4. Select your preferred layout from the **Form navigation** dropdown (`Horizontal Tabs`, `Vertical Tabs`, or `Stacked Form`).
5. Click the primary **Save Changes** button at the bottom of the form.
6. A confirmation notice will verify that your preferences are updated.
7. Open **Catalog > Products** and click **Edit** on any product to experience your updated layout immediately.

---

## Connecting Site Setting with Catalog Management

Your choice in **Site Setting** works together with the main **Vendor Products** catalog screen (`/seller/vendor-products/`), where you manage existing items and use the advanced filter drawer.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-products-filter-drawer.png"><img src="./assets/seller-products-filter-drawer.png" alt="Vendor Products Catalog with Slide-out Filter Drawer" /></a>

### Using the Slide-Out Filter Drawer

When managing a growing inventory, the product catalog provides an advanced slide-out filter panel to help you pinpoint specific items quickly.

Click the **Filter** button located above the products table to open the filter drawer. You can filter by any combination of the following criteria:

| Filter Field | Input Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | Text Input | Search products by exact or partial product name. |
| **SKU** | Text Input | Search items by Stock Keeping Unit code. |
| **Status** | Dropdown | Filter by publication status (`Draft`, `Waiting for Approval`, `Private`, `Published`). |
| **Is Approved** | Dropdown | Filter by marketplace administrator approval status (`Yes`, `No`, `Rejected`). |
| **Draft Status** | Dropdown | Filter items saved as temporary drafts (`Yes`, `No`). |
| **Type** | Dropdown | Filter by WooCommerce product type (`Simple product`, `Grouped product`, `External/Affiliate product`, `Variable product`). |
| **Category** | Dropdown | Filter by assigned product categories (e.g., Clothing, Accessories, Decor). |
| **Price (Min / Max)** | Dual Numeric Inputs | Specify a minimum and maximum retail price threshold. |
| **Product Number** | Text Input | Search by variation-specific SKU or vendor reference number. |
| **ID** | Numeric Input | Filter directly by the system product identification number. |
| **Barcode Value** | Text Input | Search by GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN barcode number. |

After configuring your desired criteria, click **Apply Filters**. To reset your view and display the full catalog again, click **Clear all**.

::: tip Sorting & Bulk Actions
- **Sort By**: In addition to filters, you can use the **Sort By** dropdown on the catalog bar to sort products by *Price - Low to high*, *Price - High to low*, or *Newest First*.
- **Bulk Operations**: Select multiple filtered products using the table checkboxes to apply bulk actions such as *Delete*, *Assign Categories*, *Publish*, or *Generate/Print Barcodes*.
:::

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Why can't I see "Site Setting" under the Settings menu?
If **Site Setting** is missing from your sidebar, the marketplace administrator has not enabled **Vendor Mode** in the global marketplace settings. When Vendor Mode is disabled, all vendors automatically inherit the administrator's default form layout. You can contact marketplace support or your platform administrator to request access.

### Does changing my form layout affect existing products?
No. Form navigation layouts only change how information is organized on your editing screen. Switching between Horizontal Tabs, Vertical Tabs, and Stacked Form will never alter, overwrite, or delete your product descriptions, pricing, images, or inventory data.

### Can I hide the Listing Completeness score if I don't need it?
Yes. Simply toggle the **Listing Completeness** switch to `Off` in **Site Setting** and click **Save Changes**. The score gauge and missing details checklist will be removed from your product edit screens.

### Does disabling the Product Stepper prevent me from publishing products?
No. Disabling the stepper simply removes the 3-step milestone bar from the top of the editor. All required product fields remain accessible and fully functional on the form.

### Which layout is best for mobile or tablet editing?
If you frequently manage products on tablets or touch devices, the **Stacked Form** layout is recommended because it allows smooth vertical finger scrolling without needing to tap small navigation tabs.

# Product Detail Page (PDP)

The **Product Detail Page (PDP)** is the main page where buyers explore individual items, review vendor information, select product options, and make a purchase in the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace**.

Unlike a standard single-store shop, a multi-vendor marketplace connects customers with multiple independent sellers. The PDP gives customers full transparency by showing **who sells the product**, **how other buyers rate it**, and **how to report a listing** if there is an issue.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-overview.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-overview.png" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Product Detail Page Overview" /></a>

---

## Customer Discovery: How Buyers Find Vendor Products

Customers can discover vendor products through several marketplace touchpoints before reaching the Product Detail Page:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Storefront Navigation"] --> B["Header: Vendor Lists & Seller Central"]
    A --> C["Category / Shop Page: Seller List Filter"]
    A --> D["Product Card: Vendor Attribution Link"]
    B --> E["Product Detail Page (PDP)"]
    C --> E
    D --> E
    E --> F["Vendor Store Profile"]
    E --> G["Add to Cart / Buy Now"]
```

### 1. Header Navigation & Marketplace Menus

The marketplace storefront header provides dedicated navigation links for buyer-to-seller discovery:

- **Vendor Lists Menu**: A top navigation menu item with an interactive dropdown. Customers can view active marketplace sellers (for example, *Volt & Vine*, *Aurora Athletics*, *Maison Terra*) and click any seller name to visit their dedicated storefront.
- **Seller Central / Sell on Marketplace**: A direct header link for prospective sellers to learn about onboarding, commission rates, and registration.
- **Customer Account**: Quick access for buyers to manage orders, wishlists, and vendor communications.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-header-vendor-dropdown.png"><img src="./assets/customer-header-vendor-dropdown.png" alt="Storefront Header Vendor Lists Dropdown" /></a>

### 2. Seller List Filter on Category & Listing Pages

When browsing shop archives or categories (such as *Electronics*, *Home & Living*, or *Accessories*), customers can narrow down items by specific vendors:

- **Seller List Accordion**: Located in the sidebar filter area. Clicking the header expands the list of active marketplace sellers.
- **Product Count Badges**: Each seller name shows the number of available products in that category (for example, *Volt & Vine (7)*, *Aurora Athletics (2)*).
- **Instant Filtering**: Selecting a seller checkbox refreshes the product catalog to show only products sold by that merchant.
- **Clear Filters Button**: A convenient reset button appears as soon as a filter is applied, allowing buyers to return to the full catalog with one click.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-plp-seller-filter-widget.png"><img src="./assets/customer-plp-seller-filter-widget.png" alt="Sidebar Seller List Filter Widget" /></a>

### 3. Vendor Attribution on Product Cards

Every product card on listing pages clearly displays vendor information before the customer clicks through:

- **Vendor Name Link**: Labeled as `Vendor: [Vendor Name]` in a distinctive royal blue color. Clicking the vendor name opens the seller's profile page.
- **Add to Cart Tooltip**: Hovering over the cart button shows `Sold By: [Vendor Name]`, confirming the seller identity.
- **Quick Action Buttons**: Includes quick wishlist saving and product comparison alongside direct cart addition.

## Key Elements on the Product Detail Page (PDP)

Once a customer clicks on a product, the Product Detail Page provides all the information needed to evaluate and purchase the item.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-summary-vendor-info.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-summary-vendor-info.png" alt="Product Summary and Vendor Information" /></a>

### 1. Vendor Attribution & Store Link

Prominently located directly beneath the product title:

- Displays `Vendor:` followed by the seller's business name (e.g., **Volt & Vine**).
- The vendor name is a clickable link. Clicking it takes the buyer directly to the seller's storefront where they can view all items, store policies, and seller ratings.
- Transparent attribution builds buyer confidence and trust in multi-seller transactions.

### 2. Ratings & Review Summary

- Displays the average star rating (e.g., `4.5 Stars`).
- Displays total customer reviews (e.g., `(2 Reviews)`).
- Clicking the review count smoothly scrolls the page to the **Customer Reviews** section.

### 3. Pricing & Variants

- **Clear Pricing**: Displays standard pricing or discounted sale pricing with promotional badges.
- **Price Ranges**: For variable products with different options, displays the lowest to highest price range (e.g., `$189.00 – $201.00`).
- **Product Options**: Customers can select specific variations such as color, size, or material. When a variation is selected, the price, SKU, and stock count update in real time.

### 4. Live Stock Availability

- Real-time stock status badge displays whether the item is `IN STOCK` or out of stock.
- Shows remaining units (e.g., `36 in stock`), helping customers make timely purchasing decisions.

### 5. Short Description & Origin

- Summarizes key product features and materials.
- Highlights vendor craftsmanship details (e.g., *"Made in small batches by Volt & Vine in Austin, TX"*).

### 6. Purchasing Actions

- **Quantity Selector**: Buyers can select desired units using increment/decrement controls or direct input.
- **Add to Cart**: Adds the selected product to the buyer's cart while preserving vendor metadata for multi-vendor checkout.
- **Buy Now**: Bypasses the cart page and takes the buyer straight to checkout for instant purchasing.
- **Social Sharing**: Quick sharing icons for Facebook, Twitter/X, Pinterest, and LinkedIn.

---

## Buyer Safety: Report Product Feature

To protect customers and ensure marketplace quality, every product page includes a **Report Product** option. This allows buyers to alert marketplace administrators if an item has incorrect information or violates marketplace guidelines.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-modal.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-modal.png" alt="Report Product Modal Form" /></a>

### How to Report a Product:

1. Click the **Report Product** link located under the purchase actions.
2. An interactive popup modal window appears with pre-filled product and seller references.
3. Fill in your contact details:
   - **Your Name\***: Name of the person reporting the listing.
   - **Your Email\***: Email address for administrative follow-up.
4. Select an appropriate reason from the standard marketplace violation list:
   - *Misleading product photographs*
   - *Incorrect pricing or hidden charges*
   - *Prohibited or unsafe item*
   - *Copied listing or stolen imagery*
   - *Inaccurate product description*
   - *Prohibited or restricted item*
   - *Copyright or trademark violation*
   - *Other*
5. Add explanatory notes in the description field (**Briefly describe the issue / Write a reason to flag this product**).
6. Click **Submit**. Marketplace administrators review the flag and take appropriate action.

::: tip Safe Marketplace Guarantee
The Report Product feature helps keep marketplace listings honest, accurate, and safe. Reports are submitted directly to marketplace managers for review, ensuring independent seller accountability.
:::

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How can I tell which vendor is selling an item?
The vendor name is displayed right beneath the product title on the Product Detail Page (labeled `Vendor: [Vendor Name]`). On category and listing pages, each product card also displays the vendor name and features a `Sold By:` tooltip on the cart button.

### Can I view all products offered by a single seller?
Yes. Simply click the vendor's name on the Product Detail Page or on any product card. This opens the vendor's dedicated storefront, showing their complete product catalog, banner, and store policies.

### Can I purchase products from different vendors in a single order?
Yes. You can add items from multiple independent sellers into the same shopping cart. During checkout, the marketplace automatically organizes your order with transparent seller attribution for each item.

### What should I do if a product has misleading information?
Click the **Report Product** button on the product page. Select the reason that applies (such as misleading photos, inaccurate description, or copyright issues), enter your details, and submit. The marketplace admin team will investigate the listing.

### Can I leave a review for a vendor's product?
Yes. Scroll down to the **Customer Reviews** section on the Product Detail Page. Select your star rating (from 1 to 5 stars), write your review, and submit it to help future buyers.

# Multi-Vendor Cart

The **Multi-Vendor Cart** is a central shopping feature of the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace**. It allows buyers to add items from multiple independent sellers into a single shopping cart and complete their order in one smooth, unified checkout.

In a traditional online store, all products belong to one merchant. In a multi-vendor marketplace, items come from different shops, each with its own inventory, fulfillment timeline, and store policies. The Multi-Vendor Cart brings total transparency to this process by clearly showing **who sells each item**, providing **direct vendor store links**, and calculating totals accurately before the buyer proceeds to payment.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-overview.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-overview.png" alt="WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Cart Overview with Products from Multiple Sellers" /></a>

---

## How the Multi-Vendor Cart Journey Works

The following workflow diagram illustrates the entire customer shopping flow from product discovery through multi-vendor cart management to unified checkout:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Catalog & Shop Page"] -->|"Filter by Seller / Browse Items"| B["Product Cards with 'Vendor:' Attribution"]
    B -->|"Click Product"| C["Product Detail Page (PDP)"]
    B -->|"Quick Add"| D["Shopping Cart"]
    C -->|"Add to Cart"| D
    D --> E["Slide-Over Mini-Cart Drawer"]
    D --> F["Dedicated Cart Page (/cart/)"]
    E -->|"Click 'See Details'"| G["View 'Sold By: [Seller Name]' & Store Link"]
    F --> H["Review Line Items & Vendor Badges"]
    F --> I["Adjust Quantities / Remove Items"]
    F --> J["Apply Coupons & Check Shipping"]
    F --> K["Proceed to Checkout"]
    E --> K
    K --> L["Unified Multi-Vendor Checkout Page"]
```

---

## 1. Product Discovery & Adding Multi-Vendor Items

Before items arrive in the cart, customers can easily find and identify products belonging to specific marketplace sellers:

### Seller List Filter on the Catalog Page
On the main shop and category listing pages, buyers can use the **Seller List** filter in the sidebar to browse items from individual merchants:
- **Expandable Seller Accordion**: Click the **Seller List** header to expand the full directory of active sellers.
- **Product Count Badges**: Each seller name displays the total number of products they currently list (for example, *Aurora Athletics (14)*, *Copperleaf Kitchen (10)*, *Volt & Vine (9)*).
- **Multi-Select Filtering**: Customers can select one or more seller checkboxes to immediately filter the catalog.
- **Clear Filters Button**: A quick-reset button appears as soon as a filter is applied, allowing shoppers to return to the full catalog with a single click.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-seller-filter-expanded.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-seller-filter-expanded.png" alt="Sidebar Seller List Filter Accordion" /></a>

### Vendor Attribution on Product Cards
Every product card across the storefront clearly identifies the selling merchant:
- A blue **Vendor: [Seller Name]** tag appears directly above or below the product title.
- Clicking the vendor name opens that seller's dedicated marketplace storefront.
- When customers click **Add to Cart**, the item is added to their cart with that seller's metadata securely attached.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-seller-filtered-shop.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-seller-filtered-shop.png" alt="Filtered Shop Showing Vendor Attribution on Products" /></a>

---

## 2. Slide-Over Mini-Cart Drawer

Customers do not need to leave their current shopping page to check their cart contents. The marketplace header includes an interactive **Mini-Cart Drawer**:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-mini-cart-drawer.png"><img src="./assets/customer-mini-cart-drawer.png" alt="Slide-Over Mini Cart Drawer in Header" /></a>

### Key Mini-Cart Features:
1. **Header Cart Icon & Badge**: Displays the total count of items currently in the cart.
2. **Instant Slide-Out Drawer**: Clicking the cart button smoothly opens a side panel from the right edge of the screen.
3. **Item Overview**: Displays the product thumbnail, item name, unit price, and a quick quantity selector.
4. **"See Details" Expandable Toggle**:
   - Each item in the drawer features a **See Details** link.
   - Clicking **See Details** reveals the **`Sold By : [Vendor Name]`** attribution.
   - The vendor name links directly to the vendor's profile in a new tab so buyers can review seller ratings and policies without losing their place.
5. **Quantity & Removal Controls**: Customers can adjust item quantities (`+` or `-`) or click the trash can icon to remove an item immediately.
6. **Subtotal & Fast Action Buttons**: Displays the live cart subtotal alongside direct buttons for **View Cart** and **Proceed to Checkout**.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-mini-cart-expanded-details.png"><img src="./assets/customer-mini-cart-expanded-details.png" alt="Mini Cart Drawer with Expanded Sold By Details" /></a>

## 3. Dedicated Multi-Vendor Cart Page

Navigating to `/cart/` opens the full cart page. Powered by modern WooCommerce Cart Blocks, this page provides a clean, responsive layout optimized for multi-seller transactions:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-items-list.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-items-list.png" alt="Multi-Vendor Cart Line Items Table" /></a>

### Line Item Breakdown & Vendor Attribution

Each row in the cart table provides comprehensive item details:

| Element | Description | Customer Advantage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Product Image & Title** | Clear photo and clickable product link | Quick verification of ordered products |
| **Price & Discount Badges** | Shows regular price struck through with the discounted sale price and a green **Save $X.XX** badge | Immediate visibility into promotional marketplace savings |
| **Short Description** | A brief summary of key product specifications | Ensures correct selection before ordering |
| **Sold By Attribution** | Bold `Sold By : [Vendor Name]` label with a link opening the vendor store in a new tab | Complete seller transparency; builds customer confidence |
| **Interactive Quantity Stepper** | Stepper with `−` and `+` buttons and manual number input bounded by live seller inventory | Adjust quantities instantly without manual page refreshes |
| **Remove Button** | A trash icon button next to each item | One-click removal with immediate total recalculation |

::: tip Vendor Verification
Always verify the **Sold By** name if you are purchasing multiple complementary products (for example, accessories or matching items). Buying from the same vendor often combines packaging and simplifies shipping timelines.
:::

---

## 4. Quantity Adjustments & Real-Time Updates

Managing quantities in the Multi-Vendor Cart is fast and intuitive:

1. **Increasing Quantity**: Click the `+` button. The cart automatically recalculates the item total and the order subtotal via AJAX.
2. **Decreasing Quantity**: Click the `−` button. If the quantity reaches 1, the minus button disables to prevent accidental zeroing.
3. **Stock Ceiling**: The stepper automatically respects the maximum stock currently available from that specific vendor.
4. **Instant Total Recalculation**: Customers do not need to search for an "Update Cart" button—all line totals, shipping options, and estimated order totals update automatically.

---

## 5. Order Summary, Coupons & Shipping

The right-hand side of the cart page displays the **Order Summary** block:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-order-summary.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-order-summary.png" alt="Cart Order Summary, Shipping and Coupon Section" /></a>

### 1. Unified Subtotal
The subtotal aggregates all products across all sellers into one unified dollar amount. Customers pay once regardless of how many vendors are represented in the cart.

### 2. Promo & Coupon Code Drawer
- Customers can click the **Add coupons** toggle to reveal the coupon input field.
- Enter a valid coupon code and click **Apply**.
- If a vendor-specific or store-wide coupon is used, the discount automatically applies to qualifying items and reflects in the order summary.

### 3. Shipping Calculation
- Displays available shipping methods (such as **Free shipping** or **Flat rate**).
- When vendors have independent shipping configurations or rates, the cart aggregates the applicable delivery options for customer selection.

### 4. Estimated Total & Checkout Button
- Clearly lists taxes (if applicable), discounts, shipping fees, and the final estimated total.
- The prominent **Proceed to Checkout** button directs the customer to the secure checkout page.

---

## 6. Empty Cart Experience

If a customer removes all items or visits the cart before adding products, the cart displays a helpful empty state:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-cart-empty-state.png"><img src="./assets/customer-cart-empty-state.png" alt="Clean Empty Cart View with Return to Shop Prompt" /></a>

- A clear notification states: **"Your cart is currently empty!"**.
- Helpful marketplace category shortcuts or a direct link to return to the shop allow customers to quickly resume browsing.

---

## 7. Transition from Cart to Checkout

When the customer clicks **Proceed to Checkout**, all multi-vendor products carry over smoothly into the Checkout block:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-checkout-overview.png"><img src="./assets/customer-checkout-overview.png" alt="Multi-Vendor Checkout Order Summary Retaining Sold By Attribution" /></a>

### Continuous Seller Visibility
In the Checkout **Order summary** panel:
- Each product line item retains its distinct **`Sold By : [Vendor Name]`** attribution.
- Original and discounted pricing remains clear.
- Customers enter their billing and shipping details once, select their preferred payment gateway, and complete the order.

### Behind the Scenes: Split Order Processing
Once the order is placed:
- The customer receives a single consolidated order confirmation and receipt.
- The marketplace backend automatically divides the order into separate vendor-specific sub-orders.
- Each seller receives a notification in their vendor dashboard containing only their items, allowing them to package and ship goods independently.

---

## Comparison: Standard WooCommerce Cart vs Multi-Vendor Cart

| Feature | Standard Single-Store Cart | WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Cart |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Seller Transparency** | Not present (all items come from the site owner) | Prominent `Sold By : [Seller Name]` with direct store links |
| **Catalog Source** | Single merchant catalog | Multiple independent merchants |
| **Drawer Mini-Cart** | Generic product list | Includes expandable "See Details" with vendor attribution |
| **Stock Management** | Single warehouse / store inventory | Independent vendor-managed inventory per item |
| **Checkout Flow** | Standard single order | Single customer payment with automatic seller sub-orders |
| **Fulfillment** | Single shipment source | Independent shipping and fulfillment by each vendor |

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I purchase products from different vendors in a single order?
**Yes.** The Multi-Vendor Cart is specifically designed to allow customers to mix and match items from any number of marketplace sellers. You only need to enter payment details once during checkout.

### How do I know which vendor sells a product in my cart?
Every product row on the cart page displays a `Sold By : [Vendor Name]` label directly under the product description. In the slide-over mini-cart drawer, click **See Details** under any product to view its seller.

### What happens if I click on the seller's name in the cart?
Clicking the vendor's name opens their dedicated store page in a new browser tab. You can view all other products offered by that seller, check their overall ratings, or read their store policies without losing items in your cart.

### Will products from different sellers arrive in the same package?
Because marketplace sellers operate from different locations and manage their own inventory, items ordered from different vendors are typically packaged and shipped separately. You will receive tracking details for each package as vendors dispatch them.

### Can I apply coupons in the multi-vendor cart?
**Yes.** You can expand the **Add coupons** section in the Order Summary to apply eligible discount codes. The cart will automatically calculate and apply discounts to the corresponding products.

# Order Details & Seller Visibility

In a multi-vendor marketplace, a single customer order frequently contains products fulfilled by different independent merchants. Ensuring clear **Order Details & Seller Visibility** is essential for building buyer trust, reducing support inquiries, and maintaining smooth fulfillment operations.

The **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** provides end-to-end transparency:
- **For Customers**: Every order clearly identifies **who sells each item**, provides direct links to the merchant's storefront, and displays real-time carrier tracking information and store pickup updates.
- **For Vendors**: Each seller receives a private, secure view of **only their portion of the order**, showing their sold items, calculated marketplace commission, net earnings, and tools to update statuses, add shipments, issue refunds, and print invoices.

---

## Order Visibility & Fulfillment Architecture

The diagram below illustrates how an order moves from initial placement through customer tracking and isolated vendor fulfillment:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Customer Places Order at Checkout"] --> B["Unified Marketplace Order Generated"]
    B --> C["Order Received (Thank You) Page"]
    C --> D["Customer Account: My Account → Orders"]
    
    B --> E["Marketplace Splits Order into Vendor Slices"]
    
    D --> F["Customer Order View (/view-order/ID/)"]
    F --> F1["Line-Item 'Sold By: [Seller]' Store Links"]
    F --> F2["Real-Time Shipment Carrier & Tracking ID"]
    F --> F3["Store Pickup Verification & Instructions"]
    
    E --> G["Vendor 1 Dashboard (/vendor-orders/ID/)"]
    E --> H["Vendor 2 Dashboard (/vendor-orders/ID/)"]
    
    G --> G1["Views ONLY Vendor 1 Items"]
    G --> G2["Calculates Admin Commission & Net Payout"]
    G --> G3["Adds Courier & Tracking Number"]
    
    H --> H1["Views ONLY Vendor 2 Items"]
    H --> H2["Zero Access to Vendor 1 Data (Strict Isolation)"]
```

---

## 1. Order Confirmation (Order Received Page)

Immediately after completing checkout, the customer lands on the **Order Received** (Thank You) confirmation screen. This page provides immediate reassurance and details every vendor involved in the purchase.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-order-received-vendor-info.png"><img src="./assets/customer-order-received-vendor-info.png" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Order Received Confirmation with Vendor Attribution" /></a>

### Key Information Displayed:
1. **Order Identification Banner**:
   - Displays the permanent Order ID (e.g., `Your Order no. is #1192`).
   - Friendly greeting confirming receipt of the purchase.
2. **Order Metadata Grid**:
   - **Customer Email**: Billing and contact email registered to the order.
   - **Payment Method**: Displays the payment option chosen (e.g., *Direct bank transfer*, *Cash on delivery*, *Credit Card*).
   - **Order Date & Time**: Timestamp when the order was placed.
   - **Total Amount**: Final paid or due amount including taxes and shipping.
3. **Line-Item Vendor Attribution**:
   - **SKU**: Specific product identification code (e.g., `XL-ELE-05`, `XL-BEA-14`).
   - **Product Name**: Direct clickable link back to the product detail page.
   - **Sold By Badge**: Clear attribution label indicating the merchant responsible for fulfilling that item (e.g., **`Sold By: Aurora Athletics`**). Clicking the seller name opens the vendor's storefront profile.
   - **Unit Price & Quantity**: Clear item pricing and ordered quantity (`× 1`, `× 2`).
   - **Line Total**: Calculated line item amount.
4. **Totals & Address Blocks**:
   - Subtotal, selected shipping method, and full billing/shipping destination addresses.
   - **Return to Shop Button**: Convenient navigation link to return to the marketplace catalog.

---

## 2. Customer Order History (`My Account → Orders`)

Customers can review and track all current and historical orders at any time from their personal marketplace account dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-orders-history-list.png"><img src="./assets/customer-orders-history-list.png" alt="Customer Order History Table in My Account" /></a>

### How Customers Access Their Orders:
1. Log in to the marketplace using the header **Account** link.
2. Navigate to **My Account → Orders** in the sidebar navigation menu.
3. View the responsive **Orders Table**, which organizes purchases with the following details:

| Column | Information Provided |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Order** | Unique order number prefixed with `#` (e.g., `#1171`, `#1170`, `#1169`). |
| **Date** | Date and time the customer placed the order. |
| **Status** | Current processing state (e.g., `Processing`, `On hold`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`). |
| **Total** | Total order amount and the total count of purchased items (e.g., `$258.00 for 2 items`). |
| **Actions** | Direct **View** button to inspect complete order details, vendor stores, and tracking notes. |

---

## 3. Detailed Customer Order View (`/view-order/[id]/`)

Clicking the **View** button on any order opens the full **Order Details** screen. This page serves as the customer's central hub for delivery updates, vendor attribution, and store pickup management.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-order-details-vendor-attribution.png"><img src="./assets/customer-order-details-vendor-attribution.png" alt="Detailed Customer Order View with Line Item Vendor Attribution" /></a>

### 1. Order Header & Status Badge
- Displays the order number and formatted creation date.
- Highlights the current operational status with a clear badge (`Processing`, `On hold`, or `Completed`).

### 2. Live Order Updates & Shipment Tracking
When a seller dispatches an item or schedules a delivery, a dedicated **Order Updates** card appears automatically above the product table:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-order-tracking-updates.png"><img src="./assets/customer-order-tracking-updates.png" alt="Customer Order Tracking Updates and Shipment Details" /></a>

- **Fulfillment Status Notice**: Informs the customer about the fulfillment stage (for example: *"Your items from Aurora Athletics are scheduled for pickup / in transit"*).
- **Carrier Name & Title**: Identifies the exact logistics carrier or service handling delivery (e.g., *Fulfilment Carriers – Standard Express*, *FedEx*, *UPS*, *DHL*).
- **Tracking ID / Number**: Provides the exact tracking reference number (e.g., `Tracking ID: 2222`) that the customer can use to follow shipment progress.
- **Fulfilled Items Breakdown**: Lists which items from the order are contained in that specific shipment package.

### 3. Store Pickup & Local Collection Details
If the customer selected local store pickup during checkout:
- Displays the vendor store location (e.g., `Aurora Athletics · 1420 SE Water Avenue, Suite 3, Portland, OR 97214`).
- Shows the merchant's contact phone number with a direct click-to-call link (`tel:+15035550102`).
- Details specific collection instructions and store operating hours (e.g., *Collect at store desk*).
- Shows pickup readiness status (`Ready to Pickup`).

### 4. Line Items Table & Merchant Links
- **SKU & Product Name**: Clickable links leading back to individual product detail pages.
- **Sold By Attribution**: Prominently highlights the selling merchant for each line item. Clicking the vendor name opens their seller profile in a new tab, allowing buyers to verify seller policies or review other store offerings.
- **Quantity & Line Totals**: Explicit breakdown of individual item costs.

### 5. Order Actions & Reordering
- For completed or existing purchases, an **Order Again** button allows customers to reload identical items into their cart with one click for effortless repurchase.

---

## 4. Vendor Order Visibility & Security Isolation

A multi-vendor marketplace requires strict data isolation. Sellers should only see information relevant to the products they fulfill. The marketplace enforces automatic multi-tenant partitioning across all order views.

### Multi-Tenant Security & Access Control

When multiple sellers receive items within the same customer order, each vendor is granted access **strictly to their own portion**:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-order-security-isolation.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-order-security-isolation.png" alt="Multi-Tenant Security and Vendor Order Isolation" /></a>

::: tip Strict Data Protection
- **No Cross-Vendor Data Leaks**: A vendor cannot view products sold by other merchants, other merchants' customer messages, or other merchants' revenue shares.
- **Unauthorized Access Prevention**: If a merchant attempts to open an order that does not contain their products, the platform displays an access restriction message (*"Sorry, You can't access other vendor's orders"*).
:::

---

## 5. Vendor Order Management (`Vendor Dashboard → Order History`)

When a vendor navigates to **My Account → Order History** (or `/my-account/vendor-orders/`), they access a dedicated management workspace tailored specifically to their store's fulfillment duties.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-order-management-full-view.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-order-management-full-view.png" alt="Vendor Order Management Dashboard Full View" /></a>

### 1. Vendor Financial Breakdown & Commission Transparency
The vendor order details card provides transparent financial accounting for that specific order slice:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-order-detail-commission-slice.png"><img src="./assets/vendor-order-detail-commission-slice.png" alt="Vendor Order Commission Breakdown and Net Earning Slice" /></a>

- **Product Subtotal**: The total gross sales amount generated by the vendor's items in the order.
- **Admin Commission**: The marketplace fee automatically calculated according to admin commission rules.
- **Total (Net Vendor Earning)**: The exact payout amount credited to the vendor after commission deductions (e.g., Subtotal: `$360.00` − Admin Commission: `$43.20` = Vendor Net Total: `$316.80`).
- **Payment Method**: Indicates whether the customer paid via online gateway, cash on delivery, or direct transfer.

### 2. Customer Contact & Delivery Details
Vendors receive the necessary shipping and contact information to fulfill items promptly:
- **Customer Email**: Direct clickable `mailto:` link for order queries.
- **Telephone**: Click-to-call telephone link for urgent delivery coordination.
- **Billing & Shipping Addresses**: Formatted delivery destinations.

### 3. Order Status Controls
Vendors can independently manage their fulfillment lifecycle:
- Status options include `Pending payment`, `Processing`, `On hold`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`, and `Refunded`.
- Updating the status to **Completed** notifies the customer and updates delivery milestones.

### 4. Shipment Creation & Tracking Entry
- Vendors can attach fulfillment carriers and enter **Tracking Numbers**.
- Once saved, tracking details immediately publish to the customer's **Order Updates** section and trigger shipment notification emails.

### 5. Line-Item Refunds & Restocking
- Vendors can process manual or payment gateway refunds directly from the order view.
- Supports partial refunds on individual line items or full refunds.
- Includes an option to automatically **Restock Refunded Items** in the vendor's inventory.

### 6. Print Vendor Invoices
- Clicking **Print Invoice** generates a clean, printable PDF-ready invoice displaying only the vendor's products, tax breakdown, and store branding.

---

## Customer View vs. Vendor View: Feature Comparison

The table below contrasts what information is accessible to the buyer versus the selling vendor:

| Information / Feature | Customer View (`/my-account/view-order/`) | Vendor View (`/my-account/vendor-orders/`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **All Order Items** | Yes (sees items from all vendors in the order) | No (sees only products belonging to their store) |
| **Vendor Attribution (`Sold By`)** | Yes (prominent name with store profile link) | Yes (confirms seller brand identity) |
| **Carrier & Tracking Number** | Yes (visible in real-time Order Updates) | Yes (editable input to add courier & tracking code) |
| **Store Pickup Details** | Yes (pickup address, desk instructions, hours) | Yes (pickup verification code & customer check-in) |
| **Admin Commission Breakdown** | No (hidden from customer view) | Yes (shows fee deduction and net seller earnings) |
| **Competitor / Other Sellers' Data** | Visible only as public product listings in cart | Zero access (strictly isolated by vendor security) |
| **Order Status Updates** | Read-only status badge | Actionable dropdown to advance fulfillment status |
| **Print Invoice** | Standard customer order receipt | Vendor-branded itemized invoice |
| **Refund Request / Management** | Initiates refund query through seller support | Controls line-item refund totals and restocks |
| **Reorder Button (`Order Again`)** | Yes (one-click cart repurchase) | Not applicable |

---

## Best Practices for Customers and Vendors

### For Customers:
- **Check Vendor Profiles Before Inquiring**: Clicking the **Sold By** link on any order item takes you directly to that vendor's storefront, where you can find store policies, average ratings, and direct contact options.
- **Monitor the Order Updates Box**: Once your package is dispatched, check your order page for the **Carrier Name** and **Tracking ID** to track delivery transit in real time.
- **Keep Verification Codes Ready for Store Pickup**: If you selected local pickup, ensure you have your pickup notification or order confirmation handy when visiting the store desk.

### For Vendors:
- **Add Tracking Promptly**: Enter carrier titles and tracking IDs as soon as orders are handed over to couriers to keep buyers informed and avoid support tickets.
- **Keep Order Statuses Updated**: Transition orders from *Processing* to *Completed* once delivery is confirmed to maintain an accurate seller account health score.
- **Review Commission Deductions**: Regularly audit the commission line item on each order to reconcile your net payouts with marketplace payout statements.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can a customer order from multiple sellers in a single checkout?
Yes. The WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace supports multi-vendor carts. Customers can add items from different sellers and complete a single checkout transaction. The order confirmation and order details pages display clear `Sold By: [Seller Name]` tags for each item.

### Can a seller see the entire customer order if it includes other vendors' items?
No. For privacy, security, and competitive reasons, each seller can only view their own products, their own line-item totals, and their own calculated commission. Sellers cannot view products or revenue belonging to other merchants.

### How does a customer track their package?
When a vendor dispatches an order and adds shipment information, an **Order Updates** section appears on the customer's order view page (`My Account → Orders → View`). This section details the carrier name, carrier title, and tracking ID.

### Where can a customer find store pickup details?
If store pickup was chosen during checkout, the order details page displays the designated store address, store phone number, operating hours, and pickup desk instructions beneath the corresponding product.

### How does a vendor print an invoice for an order?
Vendors can open the order from **Vendor Dashboard → Order History**, click on the order number, and select the **Print Invoice** button at the top of the order details card. The invoice will only list items sold by that vendor.

# Follow Shop

The **Follow Shop** feature allows marketplace buyers to follow their favorite vendor stores with a single click. By following a shop, customers can easily keep track of trusted sellers, return to their product collections quickly, and receive direct email notifications about new arrivals, seasonal promotions, and special discounts.

---

## Why Follow a Vendor Shop?

Shopping in a multi-vendor marketplace gives you access to products from many independent merchants. Following your favorite stores provides several key benefits:

- **Quick Access to Trusted Sellers**: Save your preferred vendors in one place so you never have to search for them again.
- **Stay Updated on New Launches**: Receive announcements directly from sellers when they release fresh products.
- **Exclusive Deals & Discounts**: Get special discount codes and promotional emails sent directly by store owners to their follower community.
- **One-Click Management**: Add or remove shops from your personal favorites list at any time with complete control.

---

## Customer Follow Workflow

Follow this 6-stage journey to discover sellers, follow favorite stores directly from product pages, manage saved vendors, and stay notified of new offers:
