## Discovering Vendor Shops on the Marketplace

Before following a shop, customers can discover marketplace vendors through multiple storefront touchpoints:

### 1. Seller List Filter on the Shop Page

When browsing the product catalog, buyers can use the **Seller List** filter in the sidebar to view products from specific merchants:

- **Filter by Merchant**: Check any seller's box (e.g., *Aurora Athletics*, *Volt & Vine*, *Maison Terra*) to display only their catalog.
- **Product Counts**: Each vendor entry displays the count of currently available products.
- **Clear Filters**: Reset filters at any time to return to the full marketplace catalog.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-filter-by-seller-list.png"><img src="./assets/customer-filter-by-seller-list.png" alt="Seller List Filter Widget on Marketplace Shop Page" /></a>

### 2. Vendor Attribution on Product Cards

On catalog pages and search results, each item shows a clickable **Vendor:** link in the product summary. Clicking this link takes you directly to that vendor's dedicated storefront.

---

## How to Follow a Vendor Shop

Following a vendor store is quick and seamless directly from any vendor's single product page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-follow-vendor-product-page.png"><img src="./assets/customer-follow-vendor-product-page.png" alt="Customer Follow Vendor on Product Detail Page" /></a>

### Step-by-Step Instructions:

1. **Sign In to Your Account**:
   - Make sure you are logged in to your customer account.
   - *Note for Guests:* The follow heart icon is hidden for guest visitors. If you do not see the icon, log in to your account first.

2. **Open a Vendor's Product Page**:
   - Navigate to any product sold by the vendor you want to follow (for example, the *Aurora Pace Fitness Watch*).

3. **Locate the Heart Icon**:
   - Look directly below the product title in the seller attribution line:
   - You will see `Vendor: [Vendor Name]` followed by a **heart-shaped icon** (`♡`).
   - Hovering over the icon displays the tooltip: *"Add As Favourite Vendor"*.

4. **Click to Follow**:
   - Click the heart icon.
   - A brief loading spinner confirms your request.
   - The heart immediately turns solid/active (`♥`), confirming that the vendor has been added to your favorites list.

5. **Click to Unfollow**:
   - If you ever want to unfollow the vendor from the product page, simply click the active heart icon again.
   - The heart returns to its default outline state, and the vendor is removed from your favorites list.

::: tip Instant Update Without Page Reload
The follow action uses AJAX. You do not need to refresh the page—the icon updates its visual state instantly upon clicking.
:::

---

## Managing Followed Shops in "My Account"

All the stores you follow are organized inside your customer account portal. This gives you a single place to review your favorite sellers, jump straight to their collections, or remove stores you no longer wish to follow.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-favorite-vendors-list.png"><img src="./assets/customer-favorite-vendors-list.png" alt="My Favorite Vendors Dashboard in Customer Account" /></a>

### Accessing the Favorite Vendors Section

1. Log in to your marketplace account.
2. Go to **My Account** from the site header.
3. In the account navigation sidebar, click **My Favorite Vendors** (accessible at `/my-account/favorite-vendors/`).
4. The page displays a table listing all your followed marketplace stores.

---

### Understanding the Favorite Vendors Table

The table provides clear details and fast controls for every store you follow:

| Column / Element | Purpose & Function |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Select Checkbox** | Use the header checkbox to select all vendors on the page at once, or check individual rows for bulk removal. |
| **Vendor Profile** | Displays the seller's store logo or avatar thumbnail image. |
| **Vendor Name** | Shows the official business name of the vendor (e.g., *Aurora Athletics*). |
| **Vendor Collection** | Provides a direct link to the vendor's dedicated store collection page (e.g., `aurora-athletics`). |
| **Action (Trash Button)** | A trash icon button (`#wkmp_delete_single_fav_seller`) that allows you to instantly remove that single vendor from your favorites. |

---

### Removing Vendors from Your List

You can remove vendors individually or in bulk:

#### Method 1: Single Removal
1. In the **Action** column of the vendor row, click the **Trash icon** button.
2. A confirmation prompt appears asking:
   > *"Are you sure you want to delete favorite vendor(s)?"*
3. Click **OK** to confirm.
4. The vendor is immediately removed from your favorite list.

#### Method 2: Bulk Removal
1. Check the boxes next to the vendors you want to delete, or click the **top header checkbox** to select all vendors.
2. Click the **Bulk Delete button** (trash icon located above the table on the top-left).
3. Confirm the action in the prompt.
4. All selected vendors are removed simultaneously.

::: note Empty State
When you have no favorite vendors saved, the table displays a clear **"No Data Found"** message alongside a count of `Showing 0 to 0 of 0 (0 Pages)`.
:::

---

## Visiting Vendor Store Collections

Clicking any store name under the **Vendor Collection** column takes you directly to the vendor's dedicated storefront.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-store-collection.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-store-collection.png" alt="Vendor Store Collection Page" /></a>

On the vendor store page, you can:

- **Browse All Products**: View the seller's complete product catalog in one place.
- **Sort Items**: Use the sorting dropdown to order products by popularity, average rating, latest release, or price.
- **Search within Store**: Quickly find specific items offered by this merchant.
- **Check Seller Reputation**: Read customer reviews and view overall feedback ratings for the store.

---

## Receiving Email Updates from Followed Shops

When you follow a vendor, you join their community of valued customers. Vendors can send direct email broadcasts to their followers to keep them informed:

- **New Product Arrivals**: Be the first to know when a seller launches new inventory.
- **Exclusive Discount Coupons**: Receive subscriber-only coupon codes for your next purchase.
- **Flash Sales & Holiday Discounts**: Get timely reminders about seasonal promotions and limited-time savings.

::: tip Customer Privacy First
Vendors cannot see your sensitive personal details or payment data. They can only send store-related broadcast emails to their registered followers, and you can unfollow any shop at any time with one click.
:::

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I follow more than one vendor shop?
Yes. There is no limit to the number of shops you can follow. All your followed merchants will appear in your **My Favorite Vendors** table.

### Why don't I see the heart icon on the product page?
The follow icon is only visible to logged-in customers. If you are browsing as a guest, please sign in to your customer account or create a new account to enable the follow button.

### Does the vendor know when I follow their shop?
Yes, your name and email are included in the vendor's follower list within their seller console. This allows them to include you in follower-only email broadcasts and special announcements.

### What happens when I unfollow a store?
When you unfollow a store, the vendor is removed from your **My Favorite Vendors** list, and you will no longer receive broadcast emails from that seller.

### Is there any fee to follow a store?
No. Following shops is completely free for all registered customers on the marketplace.

# Customer Reviews & Ratings

In **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace**, customer reviews and star ratings empower buyers to share authentic shopping experiences, evaluate seller reliability, and make well-informed purchasing decisions. 

The marketplace separates customer feedback into two distinct, specialized levels:
1. **Vendor Store Reviews (Store-Level Feedback)**: Focuses on the seller's overall business service, customer support, dispatch speed, and fulfillment reliability across three dedicated criteria: **Price**, **Value**, and **Quality**.
2. **Product Reviews (Item-Level Feedback)**: Focuses on the physical item purchased, its specifications, build quality, usability, and real-life performance—complete with customer photo uploads and verified owner status.

---

## Why Customer Feedback Matters

Customer reviews create a transparent, community-driven marketplace ecosystem:

- **Unbiased Community Trust**: Real buyer testimonials help you gauge product authenticity and vendor responsiveness before spending your money.
- **Multi-Pillar Performance Scoring**: Rather than a single arbitrary number, vendor reviews break down scores across **Price**, **Value**, and **Quality** so you know exactly where a seller excels.
- **Visual Proof with Photo Attachments**: Customers can upload images of items they received, allowing fellow shoppers to inspect real product finishes and packaging.
- **Verified Buyer Authenticity**: Reviews by confirmed buyers receive an automatic **(verified owner)** badge, making it easy to spot genuine purchases.

---

## End-to-End Review & Rating Journey

The diagram and workflow table below illustrate how customers explore existing feedback, choose the appropriate review type, and submit detailed ratings:

<div class="wkmp-workflow-pipeline">
  <div class="wkmp-workflow-step">

  </div>
  <div class="wkmp-workflow-step">

    <div class="wkmp-workflow-step__title">Assign Ratings</div>
    <p class="wkmp-workflow-step__desc">Select 1&ndash;5 stars for Price, Value, and Quality (store review) or overall stars (product review).</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wkmp-workflow-step">
    <div class="wkmp-workflow-step__top">
      <span class="wkmp-workflow-step__number">STEP 05</span>
      <span class="wkmp-workflow-step__arrow">&rarr;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="wkmp-workflow-step__title">Add Details & Photos</div>
    <p class="wkmp-workflow-step__desc">Write a title and detailed comments. Attach product photos when reviewing an item.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wkmp-workflow-step">
    <div class="wkmp-workflow-step__top">
      <span class="wkmp-workflow-step__number">STEP 06</span>
    </div>
    <div class="wkmp-workflow-step__title">Submit & Publish</div>
    <p class="wkmp-workflow-step__desc">Submit your feedback. Your review is recorded and verified buyer badges are applied automatically.</p>
  </div>
</div>

| Stage | Process | Location | Customer Action |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | **Inspect Feedback** | Vendor Profile / PDP | Review aggregate ratings, star counts, and previous buyer comments. |
| **02** | **Select Review Scope** | Storefront or Product | Target the merchant's store experience or the specific item received. |
| **03** | **Open Write Modal** | Profile Header or PDP Accordion | Click the **Write a Review** button to trigger the feedback popup. |
| **04** | **Set Star Ratings** | Modal Dialog | Click interactive star icons (multi-criteria for sellers; 1–5 stars for products). |
| **05** | **Provide Feedback** | Modal Dialog | Enter a concise headline, write detailed comments, and upload product snapshots. |
| **06** | **Submit Feedback** | Modal Dialog | Click **Submit Review** or **Submit it** to publish your experience. |

---

## Part 1: Vendor Reviews & Ratings (Store-Level Feedback)

Store-level feedback assesses the merchant's overall reputation, communication, dispatch punctuality, and after-sales support.

### 1. Viewing Vendor Ratings on the Store Profile

When visiting any seller's storefront (e.g., `/vendor/aurora-athletics/`), the vendor banner displays key performance indicators at a glance:

- **Vendor Name & Avatar**: Identifies the independent merchant.
- **Aggregate Star Rating**: Displays visual filled star icons and the current average score (e.g., *4.78 Stars*).
- **Direct Merchant Contacts**: Provides phone and email touchpoints for pre-order questions.
- **Write a Review Button**: Appears for logged-in buyers right beside the star rating score.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-review-rating-header.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-review-rating-header.png" alt="Vendor Store Header with Star Rating and Write a Review Button" /></a>

::: tip Guest vs. Logged-in Customer View
Guests can browse store ratings and read feedback submitted by others. To leave a store review, you must be signed in to your customer account.
:::

---

### 2. How to Submit a Vendor Review

Leaving seller feedback is straightforward and takes less than a minute:

1. **Sign in to Your Account**: Ensure you are logged in as a registered marketplace customer.
2. **Navigate to the Vendor Store**: Open the merchant's profile page (e.g., `/vendor/aurora-athletics/`).
3. **Click "Write a Review"**: In the store header next to the rating display, click the **Write a Review** button (`#wkfashion-open-review-popup`).
4. **Rate Across the 3 Pillars**:
   - **Price**: Rate 1 to 5 stars on how competitive and fair the seller's pricing is.
   - **Value**: Rate 1 to 5 stars on whether the purchase lived up to expectations.
   - **Quality**: Rate 1 to 5 stars on product authenticity, safe packaging, and condition upon arrival.
5. **Enter Review Title**: Type a short, descriptive headline summarizing your experience (e.g., *"Outstanding service & fast fulfillment"*).
6. **Write Your Review**: Enter detailed comments in the textarea. Mention dispatch speed, product condition, or seller communication.
7. **Click "Submit Review"**: Click the submit button to save your feedback.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-write-review-modal.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-write-review-modal.png" alt="Customer Vendor Review Submission Modal with Multi-Pillar Ratings" /></a>

| Form Field | Type | Requirement | Purpose |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Price** | Star Rating (1–5) | Optional | Assesses pricing fairness and affordability. |
| **Value** | Star Rating (1–5) | Optional | Evaluates overall satisfaction relative to cost. |
| **Quality** | Star Rating (1–5) | Optional | Evaluates item craftsmanship, authentic condition, and packaging. |
| **Title** | Text Input | **Required** | A short, informative headline summarizing your store review. |
| **Review** | Textarea | **Required** | Detailed explanation of your buying and delivery experience. |

---

### 3. Exploring the Vendor Feedbacks Page

To read what other buyers have experienced with a merchant, click the **View All Reviews** link on the store profile. This opens the dedicated seller feedback archive at `/vendor/vendor-feedbacks/{vendor-slug}`.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-feedbacks-page.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-feedbacks-page.png" alt="Vendor All Reviews and Feedback Archive Page" /></a>

This archive page provides deep transparency into the merchant's service history:

- **Overall Score Summary**: Displays the average cumulative rating (e.g., *5.0 Based on 3 Reviews*).
- **Star Rating Distribution**: Visual progress bars showing the percentage of 5-star, 4-star, 3-star, 2-star, and 1-star ratings received.
- **Detailed Testimonial Cards**: Each review card shows:
  - The review headline.
  - Individual scores for **Price**, **Value**, and **Quality**.
  - Full customer review text.
  - Reviewer initials or name and date of publication (e.g., *Ella H. / August 10, 2026*).
- **Pagination**: Easy navigation through previous feedback pages as the vendor's community grows.

---

## Part 2: Product Reviews & Ratings (Item-Level Feedback)

Product reviews are specific to the individual catalog item. They help future shoppers evaluate sizing, durability, features, and everyday usability.

### 1. Expanding the Reviews Section on the Product Page (PDP)

On any single product page (e.g., `/product/aurora-pace-fitness-watch/`), scroll past the product description and specifications to find the collapsible **Reviews** accordion section:

1. Locate the **Reviews** accordion bar with the chevron toggle icon (`.wkfashion-section-toggle`).
2. Click anywhere on the bar to expand the reviews container.
3. The expanded section displays:
   - Overall product rating score (e.g., *5.00 Based on 1 Reviews*).
   - Rating distribution bar chart.
   - The prominent **Write a Review** button (`.wkfashion-review-rating-form-toggle`).
   - Customer review cards containing buyer impressions, star ratings, and verified owner tags.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-reviews-section.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-reviews-section.png" alt="Expanded Product Reviews Section on PDP with Rating Summary and Reviews List" /></a>

---

### 2. How to Submit a Product Review

Submitting a review for a product is quick and lets you add helpful real-life photos:

1. **Open the Product Page**: Navigate to the item you wish to review.
2. **Expand the Reviews Accordion**: Click on **Reviews** to reveal the feedback area.
3. **Click "Write a Review"**: Click the button to launch the **Write a review** modal popup (`#wkfashion-review-popup`).
4. **Attach Photos (Optional but Recommended)**:
   - Click the **Add Image** box (`#file-input`) with the camera icon.
   - Select photos from your device showing the product in use, unboxing details, or material close-ups.
5. **Select Your Star Rating**: Click on the star icons (1 to 5 stars). Logged-in accounts default to 5 stars for easy rating.
6. **Enter Review Title**: Type a clear headline summarizing your feedback (e.g., *"Superb battery life and seamless fitness tracking"*).
7. **Write Review Comments**: Describe your real experience with the product—comfort, battery longevity, sizing accuracy, or build quality.
8. **Guest vs. Logged-in Customer Fields**:
   - **Logged-in Customers**: Your name is automatically associated with your account profile (`Logged in as [Your Name]`). No manual email entry needed.
   - **Guest Visitors**: Enter your **Name** and **Email** address (your email address is kept private and will never be published publicly). You may also check the optional cookie consent box to save your details for future reviews.
9. **Click "Submit it"**: Submit your review.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-write-review-modal.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-write-review-modal.png" alt="Product Write a Review Modal with Photo Attachment and Star Rating" /></a>

| Form Field | Type | Requirement | Notes |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Add Image** | File Upload (`.jpg`, `.png`, `.webp`) | Optional | Attach real product images to show unboxing and usage. |
| **Rating** | Star Selector (1–5 Stars) | **Required** | Overall product satisfaction rating. |
| **Title** | Text Input | **Required** | A short, catchy headline for your review. |
| **Comment** | Textarea | **Required** | In-depth review detailing product quality, performance, and fit. |
| **Name** | Text Input | Required for Guests | Display name shown on your public review. |
| **Email** | Email Input | Required for Guests | Kept private; used for verification and notification only. |

---

### 3. Authenticity & The "(verified owner)" Badge

To prevent fraudulent feedback and ensure marketplace integrity, the system checks whether the reviewer has completed a purchase of that item through the marketplace:

- **Verified Owner Tag**: Reviews submitted by customers who purchased the product through their registered marketplace account automatically display the **(verified owner)** label next to their name.
- **Enhanced Buyer Trust**: When browsing products, looking for the `(verified owner)` badge ensures you are reading feedback from someone who actually ordered and received the item.

---

## Vendor Reviews vs. Product Reviews: Key Differences

Understanding the difference between store reviews and product reviews ensures your feedback goes to the right place:

| Feature / Aspect | Vendor Store Review | Product Review |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Review Target** | The merchant's overall business & service | A specific catalog item |
| **Where Displayed** | Vendor Profile (`/vendor/{slug}/`) & Feedbacks page | Single Product Page (`/product/{slug}/`) |
| **Rating Criteria** | Multi-pillar: **Price**, **Value**, **Quality** (1–5 each) | Overall 1 to 5 Stars |
| **Photo Upload** | No | **Yes** (Customer can upload real product photos) |
| **Login Requirement** | Requires customer login | Supported for both logged-in buyers and guests |
| **Primary Goal** | Evaluates shipping speed, communication, packaging | Evaluates product specs, build quality, usability |
| **Impact** | Influences vendor reputation and Account Health | Influences item sales and catalog search ranking |

---

## Best Practices for Writing Helpful Reviews

Writing thoughtful reviews benefits both other buyers and hardworking merchants:

- **Be Specific & Objective**: Mention specific details such as dimensions, battery life, fabric feel, or assembly ease rather than generic praise.
- **Include Helpful Photos**: A picture taken in natural daylight showing the item or packaging is often worth a hundred words to fellow buyers.
- **Separate Merchant and Product Issues**:
  - If a carrier delayed delivery or damaged a box, reflect that in the **Vendor Review**.
  - If the product's design or functionality differed from the description, reflect that in the **Product Review**.
- **Keep Feedback Respectful**: Constructive feedback helps merchants improve their products and services while maintaining a supportive marketplace atmosphere.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I leave a review as a guest customer?
Yes, for **product reviews**, guest visitors can submit feedback by providing their Name and Email address. However, **vendor store reviews** require logging in to a registered customer account to ensure authenticated merchant feedback.

### Can I upload multiple images in a product review?
Yes. The **Add Image** file uploader supports uploading photos showing different angles, unboxing condition, and practical usage of the item.

### What is the difference between Price, Value, and Quality in vendor reviews?
- **Price** reflects whether the merchant's items are fairly and competitively priced.
- **Value** measures whether the purchase was worth the money spent.
- **Quality** indicates how carefully the seller handled fulfillment, packing, and overall order condition.

### How do I get the "(verified owner)" badge on my review?
The `(verified owner)` badge is automatically granted when you submit a product review while logged into the customer account that purchased that exact item on the marketplace.

### Can vendors delete or modify my review?
No. Merchants cannot edit or delete customer reviews. Marketplace administrators hold moderation oversight to prevent abusive content, ensuring review scores remain authentic and trustworthy.

### Where can I see all reviews for a particular seller?
Visit the vendor's storefront profile and click **View All Reviews** to open their dedicated feedback archive at `/vendor/vendor-feedbacks/{vendor-slug}`.

# Report / Flag a Vendor

In an open multi-vendor marketplace, shoppers buy goods directly from independent merchants. To guarantee a trustworthy, safe, and transparent shopping environment, the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** provides a built-in **Customer Flag & Report** system.

As a customer or guest visitor, you can report suspicious stores or problematic product listings with a few clicks. Your reports go directly to marketplace administrators, helping maintain top-tier catalog standards, protect buyers against counterfeit goods, and hold sellers accountable to marketplace policies.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-profile-report-button.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-profile-report-button.png" alt="Report Vendor Button on Vendor Store Profile" /></a>

---

## Why Report a Vendor or Product Listing?

Marketplace reporting helps keep the shopping ecosystem clean and reliable. You should consider submitting a report when you encounter:

- **Misleading or Inaccurate Information**: Specifications, product descriptions, or photos that do not match the actual item.
- **Counterfeit or Resold Goods**: Products suspected of being unauthorized replicas, counterfeit items, or infringing upon copyright/trademarks.
- **Unresponsive or Poor Communication**: Sellers who fail to answer order inquiries, messages, or refund requests.
- **Repeated Late Dispatch or Cancellations**: Merchants who frequently delay order fulfillment or cancel orders without valid reason.
- **Prohibited or Unsafe Items**: Listings that violate marketplace terms, safety guidelines, or local consumer regulations.
- **Pricing Discrepancies**: Hidden charges, sudden price inflations, or deceptive promotional pricing.

::: tip Safe and Confidential Reporting
When you report a store or product listing, your report is sent directly to the marketplace moderation team. Your personal contact information is kept private and is never shared directly with the reported seller.
:::

---

## How to Report a Vendor (Store Profile)

When you experience problems with a seller's overall conduct, store information, or customer service, you can flag their store directly from their public vendor page.

### 1. Locate the "Report Vendor" Link
Visit the vendor's storefront (e.g., `/vendor/aurora-athletics/`). In the **About this Vendor** card on the right-hand side, look for the **Report Vendor** link marked with a flag icon (<span class="dashicons dashicons-flag"></span>).

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-profile-report-button.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-profile-report-button.png" alt="Report Vendor Button on Vendor Store Profile" /></a>

### 2. Open the Report Modal
Clicking **Report Vendor** opens an interactive modal centered on your screen.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-flag-modal.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-flag-modal.png" alt="Vendor Flag Reporting Modal Form" /></a>

### 3. Enter Your Details (Guest Shoppers)
- **Logged-in Customers**: Your user account is recognized automatically. The modal skips name and email fields and links your registered profile to the report.
- **Guest Shoppers**: Enter your full name in the **Your Name** input and your contact email in the **Your Email** input.

### 4. Choose an Appropriate Vendor Reason
Select the radio button that best describes your grievance:
- **Poor communication or unanswered messages**: The seller ignores messages or inquiries.
- **Repeated late dispatch**: Orders take an unusually long time to ship without explanation.
- **Item not as described**: Goods received from this seller differ significantly from store descriptions.
- **Unclear return or refund policy**: The seller refuses to honor stated refund guidelines or terms.
- **Repeated order cancellations**: Orders are abruptly cancelled after payment confirmation.
- **Suspected counterfeit or resold goods**: The seller appears to offer unauthorized replicas.
- **Misleading store or shipping information**: Inaccurate store location, processing times, or carrier information.
- **Unresponsive to customer messages**: Inquiries regarding active purchases receive no response.
- **Suspected counterfeit products**: Products listed across the store are suspected fakes.
- **Other**: Use this option when your concern does not fit any of the predefined categories.

### 5. Writing a Custom Reason
When you select the **Other** option, the modal automatically displays a text area with the placeholder: *Write a reason to report this seller.* Enter a brief explanation of the issue so marketplace managers can investigate effectively.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-vendor-flag-custom-reason.png"><img src="./assets/customer-vendor-flag-custom-reason.png" alt="Submitting Custom Reason in Vendor Flag Modal" /></a>

### 6. Submit Your Report
Click the primary **Report** button. 
- The system validates your submission (verifying that required fields are filled and a valid reason is picked).
- A notification toast confirms that your report was submitted successfully.
- The modal closes automatically, and the report button is hidden for that session to prevent duplicate submissions.

---

## How to Report a Product Listing (Product Detail Page)

If you find an issue with a single item—such as misleading photographs, incorrect pricing, or restricted products—report the listing directly from the Product Detail Page (PDP).

### 1. Locate the "Report Product" Button
Open any vendor product page (e.g., `/product/aurora-pace-fitness-watch/`). The **Report Product** button appears directly within the main product summary area next to the purchase options.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-button.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-button.png" alt="Report Product Button on Product Detail Page" /></a>

### 2. Open the Product Flag Form
Click **Report Product** to open the reporting popup modal.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-modal.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-modal.png" alt="Product Flag Modal Overview on PDP" /></a>

### 3. Complete Reporter Information
- For guest buyers, fill in **Your Name\*** and **Your Email\***.
- For signed-in users, your customer ID and username are attached in the background.

### 4. Select a Product Flag Reason
Select the radio option that best reflects the issue with the listing:
- **Misleading product photographs**: Images do not show the real item, or represent features not included in the purchase.
- **Incorrect pricing or hidden charges**: The price shown does not reflect reality or conceals unlisted mandatory fees.
- **Prohibited or unsafe item**: The item violates product safety regulations or marketplace catalog policies.
- **Copied listing or stolen imagery**: The seller has plagiarized another merchant's text or photos.
- **Inaccurate product description**: Key specifications (size, material, compatibility) are wrong.
- **Prohibited or restricted item**: Products that require permits or are banned from sale.
- **Copyright or trademark violation**: Counterfeit brand goods or unauthorized brand logo usage.
- **Other / Briefly describe the issue**: Any other product-related dispute.

### 5. Add Custom Product Notes
If you choose **Other** (or want to specify additional details), write a brief note in the text box explaining why the product listing should be investigated.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-custom-reason.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-report-product-custom-reason.png" alt="Product Report Modal with Custom Description Filled" /></a>

### 6. Submit the Product Report
Click **Report**. An inline confirmation message verifies that your submission was received, and the window closes automatically after a few seconds.

---

## Product Reviews vs. Flagging a Listing

It is important to understand when to write a **Product Review** and when to **Report / Flag** an item. Both features serve distinct roles in keeping the marketplace transparent:

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/customer-pdp-reviews-section.png"><img src="./assets/customer-pdp-reviews-section.png" alt="Product Reviews and Ratings Section on PDP" /></a>

| Consideration | Product Review & Rating | Flag & Report Submission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Goal** | Share personal consumer experience, opinions, and product feedback. | Report policy violations, illegal goods, fraudulent listings, or unsafe items. |
| **Visibility** | **Public**: Displayed publicly under the *Reviews* tab on the product page. | **Private**: Sent strictly to marketplace administrators for moderation. |
| **Typical Scenarios** | Product quality, comfort, fit, battery life, usability, and design. | Counterfeit brand items, stolen images, abusive behavior, and non-delivery scams. |
| **Who Evaluates It?** | Other shoppers reading reviews before making purchasing decisions. | Marketplace administrators and compliance officers conducting investigations. |
| **Customer Action** | Click **Write a Review** under the Reviews section. | Click **Report Product** or **Report Vendor** with the flag icon. |

::: tip Where to Share Honest Feedback
If a product arrived in working condition but did not meet your personal expectations (such as color tone or fit), use the **Write a Review** feature on the product page. Reserve the **Report Product** button for deceptive listings, policy infractions, or counterfeit merchandise.
:::

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/generate-product-content.html -->

# Generate Product Content

Generative AI (Magic AI) allows vendors to generate a complete, search-optimized WooCommerce product listing from a simple title, brief bullet points, or reference photos in seconds. Vendors can review each generated suggestion, apply the fields they want to the product form, and save the product as usual.

::: tip Non-Destructive Workflow
Magic AI is designed to be completely non-destructive. Generated suggestions are presented inside an interactive modal. Existing product details are not overwritten until the vendor explicitly clicks **Apply Selected**.
:::

---

## Before You Start

Ensure the following prerequisites are met before generating product content:

1. **Admin Enablement**: The marketplace administrator has enabled Generative AI in the marketplace settings and configured a valid AI provider API key.
2. **Product Ownership**: The product is one created by the vendor. Magic AI is available for the vendor's own catalog items on the Add Product and Edit Product screens.
3. **Staff Permissions**: If using vendor staff accounts, ensure the user's role includes the `Generate Content with Magic AI` capability. See [Vendor Staff](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-staff.html).
4. **Active Quota**: The vendor has remaining AI generations for the current billing or limit cycle. See [Usage Limits](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/usage-limits.html).

---

## Step-by-Step: Generating Product Content

### 1. Open the Product Form

From the vendor dashboard, navigate to **Products >> Add New Product**, or click **Edit** on an existing product in your catalog.

---

### 2. Enter a Brief Description or Working Title

In the product creation form, provide a short starting prompt or product summary:

- **Working Title**: E.g., `Ergonomic Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones with 40h Battery`.
- **Key Highlights**: Add 2 to 3 bullet points noting materials, intended audience, key technical specs, or unique selling points.
- The more specific your initial brief, the more accurate the resulting copy will be.

---

### 3. (Optional) Add Reference Photos

If using a vision-capable AI model (such as OpenAI GPT-4o or Google Gemini 1.5 Pro):

- Click **Upload Reference Photos** in the AI modal to attach up to 3 images of the product.
- The AI model visually scans the photos to detect colors, textures, ports, buttons, materials, and form factors.
- These detected visual attributes are automatically blended into the written description and specification tables.

---

### 4. Click "Generate with AI"

Click the **Generate with Magic AI** button located near the product title and description fields:

- A dedicated generation window opens, displaying your remaining monthly generation balance.
- Click **Generate Content** to send the request to the AI engine.
- Within 3 to 8 seconds, the generated fields appear formatted and ready for inspection.

---

### 5. Review & Refine Suggestions

The modal displays the generated content organized by product fields:

| Field | Description | Action Available |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Product Title** | Clean, keyword-focused, professional title | Edit inline or Regenerate |
| **Short Description** | Punchy 2–3 sentence overview for quick buyer scanning | Edit inline or Regenerate |
| **Full Description** | Comprehensive description formatted with HTML headings, bulleted feature highlights, and care/usage instructions | Edit rich-text or Regenerate |
| **Specifications Table** | Structured HTML table with technical specifications | Edit inline or Regenerate |
| **Suggested Categories & Tags** | Matches existing marketplace categories and creates popular search tags | Select or deselect tags |
| **SEO Meta Fields** | SEO Meta Title and Meta Description for search engine indexing | Edit inline or Regenerate |

- **Field-by-Field Regeneration**: If you want an alternative phrasing for a single section (e.g. only the short description), click the circular **Regenerate Field** icon beside that specific field without re-running the entire prompt.

---

### 6. Apply Suggestions & Save

1. Select the checkmarks next to the fields you wish to use.
2. Click **Apply Selected** to inject the generated text directly into the corresponding WooCommerce product form fields.
3. Review your regular pricing, sale pricing, inventory stock, and shipping classes as needed.
4. Click **Save Product** (or **Submit for Review** if admin moderation is active).

---

## What Can Be Generated

- **Product Titles**: Clean, marketable names free from vendor typos.
- **Short Summaries**: Catchy excerpts ideal for product grid listings and mobile storefront displays.
- **Detailed Descriptions**: Engaging long-form copy featuring key benefit breakdowns, compatibility notes, and material care tips.
- **Bulleted Feature Highlights**: Skimmable bullet points highlighting top benefits.
- **Taxonomy Recommendations**: Category selections and search tags.
- **SEO Snippets**: Custom meta descriptions that boost organic click-through rates on Google search results.

---

## When the AI Button Is Unavailable

- **Quota Depleted**: The vendor has reached their daily or monthly allocation limit. See [Usage Limits](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/usage-limits.html).
- **Select & Sell Products**: The button is not displayed when listing an offer against an existing marketplace master catalog product using the *Sell as Yours* / *Select & Sell* feature, as those items inherit the established master catalog description.
- **Missing API Configuration**: The marketplace administrator has not yet entered an active AI provider API key.

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/usage-limits.html -->

# AI Usage Limits

Every request a vendor makes to Generative AI (Magic AI) consumes one generation from their allocated balance. Marketplace administrators have comprehensive controls to define global quota allowances, configure custom per-seller limits, select reset cycles, and monitor token consumption to keep platform costs predictable.

::: tip Budget Protection
Setting usage limits protects marketplace owners from unexpected third-party API bills while still giving vendors sufficient capacity to list and refresh their product catalogs quickly.
:::

---

## How Generations Are Counted

Magic AI tracks vendor usage using clear, intuitive rules:

- **Full Product Generation**: Clicking **Generate** runs a full analysis across title, descriptions, specs, and SEO fields, consuming exactly **1 generation**.
- **Single-Field Regeneration**: Clicking the inline **Regenerate** button beside an individual field (e.g. asking for a different short description) consumes **1 generation**.
- **Failed or Dropped Requests**: If a third-party AI service is temporarily unavailable or returns an error, the request is **not counted** against the vendor's balance.
- **Concurrent Limits**: A vendor can run one active generation at a time to prevent duplicate concurrent API requests.
- **Reset Schedule**: Generation counts automatically reset to zero at midnight (for **Daily** limits) or on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC (for **Monthly** limits).

---

## Setting Global Limits for All Vendors

Marketplace administrators can configure global quota policies under **WordPress Admin >> WooCommerce Marketplace >> Settings >> Generative AI**:

1. **Per-Seller Limit**: Enter the maximum number of AI generations permitted per seller within each period (e.g., `50`).
2. **Limit Period**:
   - **Daily**: Best for continuous, steady inventory creation.
   - **Weekly**: Suitable for moderate catalog expansion.
   - **Monthly**: Recommended standard for marketplace operations.
3. **Unlimited Generations**: Leave the limit field blank or enter `0` to grant unrestricted AI generations to all sellers.

---

## Customizing Limits for Individual Vendors

Administrators can override global limits for specific merchants to reward high-volume sellers, support VIP vendors, or accommodate newly onboarded partners:

1. Navigate to **WordPress Admin >> Marketplace >> Vendors**.
2. Click **Edit** on the target vendor account.
3. Scroll down to the **Generative AI Settings** section:
   - **Inherit Global**: Uses the marketplace-wide default quota.
   - **Custom Quota**: Enter a bespoke generation allowance (e.g., `200` generations/month).
   - **Disable AI Access**: Toggle off AI generation completely for flagged, suspended, or unverified seller accounts.
4. Save the vendor profile to apply the change immediately.

---

## What Vendors See

Vendors always have full visibility over their remaining AI quota directly inside their dashboard:

- **Live Balance Meter**: The Magic AI modal displays a clear counter showing remaining generations (e.g., `Generations remaining: 42 of 50 this month`).
- **Low-Balance Warning**: When a vendor reaches 5 or fewer remaining generations, the meter highlights in amber to warn them that their quota is almost exhausted.
- **Quota Exceeded Notice**: When the limit is reached, the generate button is temporarily disabled, and an informative notice explains when the quota will reset:
  > *"You have reached your AI generation limit for this month. Your quota will automatically reset on the 1st of next month."*

---

## Administrator Best Practices

- **Start with a Baseline**: A default allowance of 30 to 50 generations per month is typically sufficient for most active merchants while keeping API costs minimal (often under $0.05–$0.15 per vendor per month on models like GPT-4o-mini or Gemini 1.5 Flash).
- **Offer Tiered Quotas**: If you charge vendor subscription fees or use vendor tiers, bundle higher AI generation limits into premium vendor membership plans.
- **Consider Local Ollama**: For marketplaces with high catalog volume, consider deploying a private, self-hosted Ollama instance (such as Llama 3 or Mistral) to provide completely free, unlimited AI generation with zero third-party token costs.
- **Monitor Third-Party Dashboards**: Regularly review your OpenAI, Google AI Studio, or Anthropic developer consoles to track token consumption and configure hard billing caps on the provider side.

---

The **Classic Transaction Management** section allows vendors to track payments received from the admin for completed orders where the admin has collected payments from buyers within the classic **My Account** interface.

# Commission Management

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/marketplace-settings.webp"><img src="./assets/marketplace-settings.webp" alt="Marketplace Commission Settings" /></a>

The **Commission Management** feature allows the admin to define how commissions are calculated and distributed between the admin and vendors.

---

## Global Commission Configuration

- The admin can set a **Fixed Commission** and a **Percentage Commission**.
- These commission rules apply to **all vendors** by default.
- Configuration path:
  - **Marketplace → Settings → General → Default Commission**

::: info Global Default Commission Configuration
To configure the platform-wide fallback commission structure (fixed flat amount, percentage rate, or combined model) and discount deductions, visit the [Default Commission Configuration](./configuration-general-settings.html#default-commission) in General Settings.
:::

---

## Commission Calculation Example

- Fixed Commission: **5 USD**
- Percentage Commission: **10%**
- Product Price: **100 USD**

### Calculation

- Percentage Commission: 10% of 100 USD = **10 USD**
- Fixed Commission: **5 USD**
- **Total Admin Commission:** 15 USD
- **Vendor Earnings:** 85 USD

---

## Order Management (Commission View)

The commission details are visible from the **Orders section** and not from the Commission settings page.

### Navigation Path

- Go to **Marketplace → Orders**
- This opens the **Marketplace Orders listing page**

### Commission Details in Orders

Under the **Orders** tab, the admin can view detailed commission-related information for each order.

#### Visible Columns

- Order ID
- Product
- Quantity
- Product Total
- Shipping
- Discount
- **Total Commission**
- **Total Vendor Amount**
- Action

This section helps the admin track:
- Commission earned per order
- Final payable amount to the vendor

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/sellers-orders-list.webp"><img src="./assets/sellers-orders-list.webp" alt="Seller Orders List" /></a>

---

## Vendor-Specific Commission

The admin can set a commission rate for an individual vendor from that vendor's own management view.

### Navigation Path

- Go to **Marketplace → Vendors**
- The list of all registered vendors is displayed
- Click the **Manage** button next to the vendor you want to update
- In the vendor's management view (their profile), open the **Commissions** section

For the full vendor management view, see [Manage Vendor](./vendor-management-and-product-assignment.html#manage-vendor).

### Vendor Commission Configuration

From the vendor's **Commissions** page, the admin can:

- Set a **vendor-specific fixed commission**
- Set a **vendor-specific percentage commission**
- Override the **global commission settings** for this vendor
- View the vendor's total sales and the admin commission earned

> **Note:** Vendor-specific commission settings take precedence over global commission settings.

---

# Get Google Analytics Measurement ID

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-get-started.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-get-started.webp" alt="Google Analytics Get Started" /></a>

This ID helps you track marketplace activity such as visitor traffic, product views, and user interactions, giving you better insights into how your marketplace is performing.
To get the **Google Analytics Measurement ID**, follow these steps:

---

## Steps to Get Google Analytics Measurement ID

1. **Sign in / Get Started**
   - Go to Google Analytics.
   - Click **Sign in to Analytics** or **Get started today**.

2. **Start Measuring**
   - Click **Start measuring**.
   - Enter account details and click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-start-measuring.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-start-measuring.webp" alt="Google Analytics Start Measuring" /></a>

3. **Create a Property**
   - Enter **Property name**, **Reporting time zone**, and **Currency**.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-create-property.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-create-property.webp" alt="Google Analytics Create Property" /></a>

4. **Describe Your Business**
   - Select the option that best describes your business.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-business-description.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-business-description.webp" alt="Google Analytics Business Description" /></a>

5. **Select Business Objectives**
   - Choose relevant business objectives.
   - Click **Next**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-business-objectives.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-business-objectives.webp" alt="Google Analytics Business Objectives" /></a>

6. **Accept Terms & Conditions**
   - Read and accept the **Terms & Conditions**.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-terms.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-terms.webp" alt="Google Analytics Terms" /></a>

7. **Choose Platform**
   - Select **Web** as the platform.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-platform-selection.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-platform-selection.webp" alt="Google Analytics Platform Selection" /></a>

8. **Set Up Data Stream**
   - Set up the web stream.
   - Click **Create & Continue**.
   - Click **Next** after creation.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-data-stream.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-data-stream.webp" alt="Google Analytics Data Stream" /></a>

9. **Copy Measurement ID**
   - Copy the **Measurement ID** shown on screen.
   - Paste it into the WooCommerce Marketplace module configuration.
   <a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/google-analytics-measurement-id.webp"><img src="./assets/google-analytics-measurement-id.webp" alt="Google Analytics Measurement ID" /></a>

**Note:**
You can add the Google Analytics Measurement ID at a later stage as well, after the marketplace setup and testing are completed. This step is optional during the initial configuration.

# Seller Panel Overview

The **Seller Panel** is where sellers and their team run their shop. It opens at `/seller/` on your store's address (for example, `https://your-domain.com/seller/vendor-dashboard/`), and you sign in on the **Seller Login** page.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/dashboard.webp"><img src="./assets/dashboard.webp" alt="WooCommerce Marketplace Seller Panel Overview" /></a>

---

## The Header

The header bar stays at the top of every page so you can quickly search, check notifications, and open your account settings:

- **Sidebar Toggle:** Click the menu icon at the top left to hide or show the sidebar. Hiding it gives you more room to view wide tables and charts.
- **Shop Logo & Name:** Shows your shop logo and store name (such as *Aurora Athletics*).
- **Mega Search:** Type to find your **Products**, **Orders**, and **Customers**:
  - Click any product or order in the results to open it right away.
  - Use **Explore all** to see the full list of matches.
  - Customer results cannot be clicked directly, so click **Explore all** to view them in your customer list.
- **Home Page:** Opens the store's main home page.
- **Visit Shop:** Opens your public shop page in a new tab so you can see how customers view your store.
- **Toggle Theme:** Switch between light and dark look. Your choice is saved in your browser.
- **Notifications Bell:** Shows alerts for new orders, low stock items, and messages from the admin.
- **Profile Menu:** 
  - **My Profile:** Opens your shop details, opening hours, policies, and KYC verification.
  - **Account Settings:** Change your password and account email.
  - **Logout:** Signs you out of your shop.

::: tip Subscription Countdown
When the store uses vendor subscription plans and your plan ends within nine days, the header also displays **"Subscription expires in: X days"** with a countdown. Click it to choose and renew your plan.
:::

---

## The Sidebar

The sidebar organizes all your daily tasks into clear menus:

| Menu | What you do there |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Follow sales, view orders, check your profile score, and see what needs your attention. |
| **Store Edit** | Upload your shop logo and banner, set opening hours, and add your store policies. |
| **Catalog** | Add new products, view your items, upload products in bulk, and print barcode labels. |
| **Inventories** | Update stock counts inline, and set standard prices or scheduled sales. |
| **Sales** | View customer orders, schedule carrier deliveries, and verify Store Pickup codes. |
| **Performance** | Check your account health score and read customer reviews. |
| **Reporting** | See sales, product, and customer reports, and export them as CSV or PDF files. |
| **Customers** | See everyone who bought from you, and send updates to your shop followers. |
| **Communication** | Send messages to the store admin and read marketplace news. |
| **Vendor Staff** | Add team members and choose which menus they can use. |
| **Vacation** | Pause your shop and notify buyers when you take time off. |
| **Settings** | Update your password, pick product form layouts, and customize chart colors. |

---

### Collapse the Sidebar
Click **Collapse** at the bottom of the sidebar to show icons only. When collapsed, hover over any icon to see its sub-pages. This gives you maximum screen space for big tables.

---

### Top Navigation Tabs
When you open any menu (such as **Catalog** or **Inventories**), its pages also appear as tabs at the top of the screen. You can switch between them with one click without opening the sidebar again.

---

## Switch Between Dashboard Views (Classic View)

The marketplace gives you two ways to view your dashboard:

1. **Dedicated Seller Panel (`/seller/`):** The clean, full-screen workspace explained in this guide.
2. **Classic My Account View (`/my-account/`):** Displays your vendor tools inside the regular WooCommerce account page, matching your store's WordPress theme.

You can switch between them whenever you like:
- To switch to the theme view, click **Classic view** at the bottom of the sidebar.
- To return to the full-screen panel, click **Go to Seller Dashboard** inside your My Account menu.

---

## What Team Members See

If you have helpers or warehouse staff, you can add them under **Vendor Staff** (`/seller/vendor-staff/`):

- **Same Login Page:** Team members sign in on the same Seller Login page using their own username and password.
- **Allowed Menus Only:** They only see the menus you allow. For example, a packing assistant can see orders and shipping, but not your financial reports or earnings. Learn more in our [Vendor Staff Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-staff.html).
- **Owner-Only Sections:** Team members cannot open **My Profile**, request payouts, or see your profile score. Those settings remain private to the shop owner.

---

## Change Panel Language and Preferences

You can customize your seller tools under **Settings**:

- **Language & Password:** Go to **Settings > General** to change your login email or password. The panel uses the language set for your user account.
- **Product Form Layout:** Go to **Settings > Site Setting** to choose how you like to edit products:
  - *Horizontal Tabs:* Tabs across the top.
  - *Vertical Tabs:* A side menu on the left.
  - *Stacked Form:* All sections in one long scrollable page.
- **Graph Colors:** Go to **Settings > Graph Setting** to pick custom colors for your sales charts and performance graphs.

---

# Vendor KYC Verification

The **Vendor KYC (Know Your Customer) Verification** feature allows admins to securely verify the identity of their vendors. It ensures marketplace compliance and builds trust with customers.

---

## KYC Verification Workflow

### Admin Configuration
Admins have full control over the KYC process:
- A master toggle to enable or disable KYC verification globally.
- Admin-managed document types (e.g., Passport, ID Card, Driver's License).
- Configurable allowed file formats and maximum file size limits for document uploads.



### Vendor Document Upload
Vendors can easily upload their KYC documents to get verified. This can be done at two stages:
1. **At Registration**: During the vendor registration process.
2. **From My Profile**: After registration, from the "My Profile" tab in their Vendor Dashboard.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/upload-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/upload-kyc.png" alt="Vendor KYC Upload" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png"><img src="./assets/seller-kyc-page.png" alt="Vendor KYC Upload from Profile" /></a>

### Admin Review and Action
Admins can review submitted documents from the admin vendor list. A dedicated KYC column and row action are available to streamline this process.

Clicking to review a vendor's KYC opens a review screen offering three actions:
- **Approve**: Mark the vendor's KYC as verified.
- **Reject (with reason)**: Reject the document and provide a reason, allowing the vendor to re-upload.
- **Hard Reject**: Permanently reject the vendor's KYC application.

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-pending.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-pending.png" alt="Admin Vendor List - KYC Pending" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-verify-vendor-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/admin-verify-vendor-kyc.png" alt="Admin Verify Vendor KYC" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-approve-vendor-kyc.png"><img src="./assets/admin-approve-vendor-kyc.png" alt="Admin Approve Vendor KYC" /></a>

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-approve.png"><img src="./assets/admin-vendor-list-kyc-approve.png" alt="Admin Vendor List - KYC Approved" /></a>

### Email Notifications
To keep vendors informed, automatic emails are sent out during the process:
- Vendor email on **KYC Approval**.
- Vendor email on **KYC Rejection** (including the admin's reason).
- Vendor email on **KYC Hard Rejection**.

Additionally, a vendor email is sent automatically if the admin completely **deletes their account**.

# Vendor Notification

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/notifications.webp"><img src="./assets/notifications.webp" alt="Vendor Notifications" /></a>


The **Vendor Notification** section keeps vendors informed about important activities and updates in the marketplace.

---

## Vendor Notifications Overview

- Vendors receive notifications for various marketplace actions such as:
  - New orders placed by customers.
  - Changes in order status (processing, completed, refunded, etc.).
  - Product approval or rejection by the admin.
  - Other important marketplace-related updates.

---

## Notification Display

- All notifications are displayed in the **Notification area** of the vendor dashboard.
- Vendors can quickly review updates without navigating to different sections.

**Reference Media:**

<a class="doc-image-link" href="./assets/vendor-notification.webp"><img src="./assets/vendor-notification.webp" alt="Vendor Notifications" /></a>

---

## Benefits

- Keeps vendors informed in real time.
- Helps vendors take quick action on orders and product updates.
- Improves communication between admin and vendors.

# What are the requirements?

Before installing, confirm your site meets these minimums. Our support team checks these first.

| Requirement | Minimum / Recommended |
|---|---|
| WordPress | 6.7 or higher |
| WooCommerce | 10.0 or higher |
| PHP | 7.4 or higher |
| Memory limit | 256 MB or higher |
| SSL | Enabled (recommended) |

**Where to check:** *WooCommerce → Status → Server environment* shows your PHP version and memory limit; *Dashboard → Updates* shows WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

::: tip Still need help?
A memory limit under 256 MB is the top cause of activation errors. See [Fatal error when activating](../troubleshooting/fatal-error-on-activation.html). Otherwise [open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/).
:::

**Related:** [Install & activate](./install-and-activate.html) · [Update permalinks](./update-permalinks.html) · [Full installation guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/installation.html)

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/getting-started/install-and-activate.html -->

# How do I install and activate the plugin?

Three short steps. For screenshots, see the full [Installation guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/installation.html).

## Install

1. In WordPress, go to **Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin**.
2. Choose the plugin **ZIP** (do not unzip it) and click **Install Now**, then **Activate**.

## Activate your license

1. Go to **Marketplace → Settings**. The activation wizard appears.
2. Enter your **License Key** and click **Activate License**.

## One required step after activating

Go to **Settings → Permalinks**, choose **Post Name**, and save. This prevents 404s on vendor pages. See [Update permalinks](./update-permalinks.html).

::: tip Still need help?
If the license won't activate, see [License activation failed](../troubleshooting/license-activation-failed.html), or [open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/).
:::

**Related:** [Requirements](./requirements.html) · [Update permalinks](./update-permalinks.html) · [License Management & Activation](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/admin-license.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/getting-started/update-permalinks.html -->

# Do I need to update permalinks?

**Yes, it's mandatory.** The plugin adds vendor, shop, and Seller Central pages that only work once the rewrite rules are refreshed.

## What to do

1. Go to **Settings → Permalinks**.
2. Set the structure to **Post Name**.
3. Click **Save Changes** (this refreshes the rules even if the setting already looked correct).

Skip this and vendor pages return **404 Not Found**.

::: tip Still need help?
Already seeing 404s? See [Vendor pages return 404](../troubleshooting/vendor-pages-404.html), or [open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/).
:::

**Related:** [Install & activate](./install-and-activate.html) · [Vendor pages return 404](../troubleshooting/vendor-pages-404.html)

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/getting-started/pre-sale-faqs.html -->

# Pre-sale FAQs

Short answers to the questions people ask before buying.

## What does the plugin do?

It turns a standard WooCommerce store into a **multi-vendor marketplace**: vendors register, open shop pages, list and manage products, handle their own orders, and request payouts, while you control approval, commissions, and settings. More in [About](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/about.html) and [Features](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/features.html).

## What kind of marketplace can I build?

Any multi-seller marketplace modeled on the big platforms. You supply the vendors, catalog, and branding. Common builds include:

- **Amazon**-style general marketplace (many vendors, one catalog)
- **eBay**-style listings marketplace
- **Etsy**-style handmade / creator marketplace
- **Souq / Noon**-style regional marketplace
- **Flipkart**-style multi-category marketplace

The plugin provides the vendor onboarding, shop pages, commissions, and payouts; the look and niche are yours.

## Is there a live demo?

Yes. Try the [live marketplace demo](https://wpdemo.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/) before buying.

## Can I extend it with add-ons?

Yes. Payment gateways, shipping, tax, mobile apps, POS, split cart, quote system and more are sold separately on the [Webkul store](https://store.webkul.com/).

## Is support included?

Yes. Support comes with your purchase through [uvDesk](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/). Please read [Before you open a ticket](../billing-support/before-you-open-a-ticket.html) first.

::: warning ⏳ Pending verified answer
**Pricing, what a license includes, and the refund policy** will be added from your official policy. See [Pricing, refunds & support](../billing-support/pricing-refunds-support.html).
:::

**Related:** [Requirements](./requirements.html) · [Install & activate](./install-and-activate.html)

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/marketplace-menu-missing.html -->

# Marketplace menu is missing after activation

You activated the plugin but there's no **Marketplace** item in the WordPress admin sidebar. Usually the plugin isn't fully active or the license step isn't complete.

## Fix

1. Open **Plugins** and confirm both *WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace* **and** *WooCommerce* are **Active**.
2. Go to **Marketplace → Settings** and finish the license wizard. See [Install & activate](../getting-started/install-and-activate.html).
3. Still nothing? Deactivate and reactivate the plugin, then reload the admin.

::: tip Still need help?
[Open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/), and read [Before you open a ticket](../billing-support/before-you-open-a-ticket.html) first.
:::

**Related:** [License activation failed](./license-activation-failed.html) · [Requirements](../getting-started/requirements.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/vendor-pages-404.html -->

# Vendor / marketplace pages return 404

Vendor dashboard, shop, or Seller Central URLs show **404 Not Found**. This means the permalink rewrite rules haven't been refreshed since installation.

## Fix

1. Go to **Settings → Permalinks**.
2. Set the structure to **Post Name**.
3. Click **Save Changes**. This flushes the rules even if the setting already looked right.

::: tip Still need help?
If pages still 404 after this, [open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/) with the exact URL that fails.
:::

**Related:** [Do I need to update permalinks?](../getting-started/update-permalinks.html) · [Installation guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/installation.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/fatal-error-on-activation.html -->

# Fatal error or white screen when activating

Activation produces a fatal error, a blank white screen, or a memory-limit message. The usual cause is a **PHP memory limit below 256 MB** (or an environment under the minimums).

## Fix

1. Check **WooCommerce → Status → Server environment** for **PHP Memory Limit** and **PHP Version**.
2. Confirm you meet the [Requirements](../getting-started/requirements.html).
3. Raise the memory limit (or ask your host). If you edit `wp-config.php`:
   ```php
   define( 'WP_MEMORY_LIMIT', '256M' );
   ```
4. Retry activation.

::: tip Still need help?
If it still fails, [open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/) and paste the exact error text.
:::

**Related:** [Requirements](../getting-started/requirements.html) · [Before you open a ticket](../billing-support/before-you-open-a-ticket.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/license-activation-failed.html -->

# License activation fails

Entering your key in **Marketplace → Settings** doesn't activate, or returns an error. Usually it's a mistyped key, a domain mismatch, or the server blocking the validation request.

## Fix

1. Re-copy the **full license key** with no leading or trailing spaces.
2. Confirm the site **domain matches the license** (staging and live domains are often licensed separately).
3. Follow our step-by-step [License Management & Activation Guide](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/documentation/admin-license.html) or the official [Webkul License Validator](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/license-validator/).
4. Still failing? [Open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/) with the exact error text.

::: tip Still need help?
Include your WordPress, WooCommerce, and plugin versions in the ticket. See [Before you open a ticket](../billing-support/before-you-open-a-ticket.html).
:::

**Related:** [Install & activate](../getting-started/install-and-activate.html) · [Marketplace menu missing](./marketplace-menu-missing.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/troubleshooting/shop-url-already-exists.html -->

# Shop URL always shows "Already Exists" at registration

During vendor registration the **Shop URL** field reports *Already Exists* for every value. The field uses a live **AJAX availability check**. So a real duplicate, or a request that can't reach `admin-ajax.php`, will report the URL as unavailable.

## Fix

1. Try a clearly unique Shop URL to rule out a genuine duplicate.
2. Confirm permalinks are set (see [Vendor pages 404](./vendor-pages-404.html)) and that no security plugin or firewall blocks `admin-ajax.php`.
3. Review the expected behavior in [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html).

::: tip Still need help?
[Open a ticket](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/) and mention any security/firewall plugins you run.
:::

**Related:** [How vendors register](../vendors/how-vendors-register.html) · [Vendor pages return 404](./vendor-pages-404.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/vendors/how-vendors-register.html -->

# How do vendors register?

Sellers can become vendors in a few ways. The store owner controls approval.

- **Vendor menu** → *Register* on the vendor registration page.
- **Seller Central page** → **Become a Seller**.
- **My Account sign-up** (if the admin enables it) → choose **"I am a Vendor"** to reveal vendor fields.
- **Existing customer** → **Become a Vendor** from the My Account panel.

The form collects email, password, name, **Shop Name**, **Shop URL** (checked live for availability), phone, and terms acceptance. Full walkthrough: [Vendor Registration Process](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-registration-process.html).

::: tip Still need help?
Shop URL rejected for every value? See [Shop URL "Already Exists"](../troubleshooting/shop-url-already-exists.html).
:::

**Related:** [Commission basics](./commission-basics.html) · [Vendor dashboard](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/vendor-dashboard.html)

---

<!-- source: https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/knowledge-base/vendors/commission-basics.html -->

# How are commissions handled?

You set the marketplace commission from the admin, and per-vendor rules are supported. When an order is placed, each vendor's earning is the sale amount minus your commission.

- Configure it under the plugin's commission settings. See [Commission Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/documentation/commission-management.html).
- For rules beyond a single marketplace-wide rate, the [Advanced Commission add-on](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multi-vendor-commission.html) adds tiered and category-based rules.

::: warning ⏳ Pending verified answer
Exact **calculation examples and edge cases** (tax handling, refunds, coupons) will be added from real support cases so nothing here is guessed.
:::

# Before you open a ticket

A minute of prep gets you a faster, more accurate answer.

## 1. Check self-service first

Search the [Help Center](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/customer-help-center/), or scan [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting/marketplace-menu-missing.html) and [Getting Started](../getting-started/requirements.html).

## 2. Run the quick checks

- Confirm the [Requirements](../getting-started/requirements.html) (WooCommerce → Status).
- Confirm the plugin **and** WooCommerce are active.
- Re-save **Settings → Permalinks** as **Post Name** (fixes most 404s).

## 3. Include this in the ticket

- WordPress, WooCommerce, and **plugin versions**
- **PHP version** and **memory limit**
- The **exact steps** and the **exact error text** (or a screenshot)
- Whether it happens as **admin, vendor, or customer**

## Open a ticket

- **Portal:** [webkul.uvdesk.com](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/)
- **Email:** [support@webkul.com](mailto:support@webkul.com)

**Related:** [Pricing, refunds & support](./pricing-refunds-support.html) · [Contact](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/contact.html)

# About

This site is the official user documentation for the **WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace** plugin, published and maintained by Webkul Software.

## About the plugin

WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace is a WordPress plugin that converts a standard WooCommerce store into a multi-seller marketplace. It lets independent vendors register, open their own shop pages, list and manage products, process their own orders, track earnings, and request payouts, while the store owner keeps administrative control over vendor approval, commission rates, withdrawal rules, and marketplace-wide settings. It is used to build marketplaces comparable in structure to Amazon, Etsy, Flipkart, or eBay on top of WooCommerce.

The plugin is sold through the [Webkul store](https://store.webkul.com/woocommerce-multivendor-marketplace.html) and a working [live demo](https://wpdemo.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/) is available. A large catalogue of add-ons extends it with payment gateways, shipping methods, tax integrations, mobile apps, point of sale, and vendor management features.

## About Webkul

Webkul Software is an eCommerce software company founded in **2010** by Vipin Sahu, Vinay Yadav, and Prakash Sahu, headquartered in **Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India**. Webkul builds B2B and B2C eCommerce, marketplace, hyperlocal, and mobile application products, and develops extensions for platforms including WooCommerce, Magento, Shopify, Odoo, Bagisto, and UnoPim.

Webkul is a CodeCanyon Featured Author at Author Level 10 and contributes to WooCommerce core. Company details, the full product catalogue, and corporate information are published at [webkul.com](https://webkul.com/).

## About this documentation

These guides cover installation, configuration, vendor workflows, and administrator workflows for the plugin. They are written for store owners setting up a marketplace and for developers integrating it into an existing WooCommerce site.

The documentation is a static site. Every page is also published as raw markdown for AI agents and automated tools — append `.md` to any page URL, or start from [llms.txt](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/llms.txt).

For questions about the plugin, see [Contact](./contact.html). For how this site handles data, see [Privacy](./privacy.html).

# Privacy

This page describes how **this documentation site** (`wpdoc.webkul.com/woocommerce-marketplace/`) handles data. It does not describe the WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace plugin itself, which runs on your own WordPress installation and stores its data in your own database, under your control.

## What this site collects

This documentation is a **static website**. It has no accounts, no login, no comment system, no contact form, and no newsletter signup. There is nothing on these pages that asks you to submit personal information, and nothing that transmits information about you to Webkul.

**No analytics or advertising trackers are loaded.** These pages do not include Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, session recording, or any third-party tracking script.

## Browser storage

The site stores exactly one value in your browser's `localStorage`, under the key `vuepress-color-scheme`. It records whether you chose the light or dark theme so your preference survives page navigation. It stays in your browser, is never transmitted anywhere, and you can clear it at any time through your browser's site-data settings. No advertising or identification cookies are set.

## Server logs

The site is served through standard web hosting and content delivery infrastructure. As with any website, those providers process ordinary technical request data — IP address, timestamp, requested URL, user agent, and referrer — for the purpose of delivering pages, caching, and protecting against abuse. Webkul does not use these logs to build a profile of you.

## Links to other sites

These pages link to external sites including the Webkul store, the live demo, the support portal, and CodeCanyon. Once you follow a link, the privacy practices of that destination apply. This page does not cover them.

## Plugin data

If you install the plugin, all marketplace data — vendor accounts, products, orders, commissions, payouts — is created and stored on **your** WordPress site. Webkul does not receive or have access to that data through the plugin. Responsibility for handling your customers' and vendors' personal data under applicable law, including GDPR, rests with you as the site operator.

## Company privacy policy

Webkul Software's corporate privacy policy, covering purchases, support tickets, and other direct interactions with Webkul, is published at [webkul.com/privacy-policy](https://webkul.com/privacy-policy/).

## Questions

Privacy questions about this documentation site or about Webkul's handling of your data can be sent to [support@webkul.com](mailto:support@webkul.com) or raised through the [support portal](https://webkul.uvdesk.com/). Postal address: Webkul Software, H-28, ARV Park, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India.
